notes.title: Upcoming Changes to Referral Seasons
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1bfdee615565758e254bb4806e14a097c2084c3d.jpeg[/img]

With the next Referral Season, we’re making a change to the way referrals work in Albion Online. From [b]October 1, 2025[/b], only Premium time purchased with real money from the [url=https://albiononline.com/shop/subscriptions][b]Albion Online Web Shop[/b][/url] or [b]ingame store[/b] will count towards referral rewards (30 days of Premium or more). This means that Premium purchased with Gold or Silver will no longer earn rewards for the referrer. In making this change, our aim is to encourage organic referrals, while we also hope to see a downward effect on Gold prices as a result of this and will be observing developments there.

If you have any questions or feedback about these changes, you can visit this [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/216263][b]dedicated forum thread[/b][/url]. For more on Referral Seasons, and to find your referral link, see [url=https://albiononline.com/profile/referral/overview][b]this page[/b][/url] (login required).

notes.title: Changelog: Abyssal Depths Patch 5
notes.notes:
[h3]Economic Adjustments[/h3]

[quote][i]In response to the recent Gold Market price increases, we are making several economic adjustments to bring the market back in line.[/i]

[i]While we are primarily targeting rewards that are generated [b]in addition[/b] to normal gameplay (e.g. Albion Journal Rewards), it’s also necessary that we make some targeted adjustments to gameplay rewards if we hope to have a substantial effect on the Gold Market. These changes are all only slight decreases, as we hope to make gradual changes over time rather than introducing too many changes all at once.[/i]

[i]We will continue to monitor all of these changes closely, as well as the impact they have on the accessibility of Premium for Silver.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Many Albion Journal missions that award Silver have had their rewards changed[/*]	[*]Roaming Mobs now take slightly longer to charge up into more powerful mobs	[list]		[*]We will be monitoring this change closely to see how this impacts gameplay, but we expect the change to be minimal as it’s only a 10% change to the upgrade frequency[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Loot Region Modifier for high-quality Black Zones now increases by +20% instead of +30% from Quality 4 to Quality 6	[list]		[*]This makes the increase purely linear, as is already the case with the Silver bonuses from the same Region Modifier[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The chance that loot is generated for a Territory Activity Chest from activity in local and neighboring regions has been slightly decreased	[list]		[*]This chance now increases by ~1.25% per level rather than 1.5% per level[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The price of Conqueror’s Chests has been increased from 5,500 Favor to 6,750 Favor	[list]		[*]The influx of Silver from Favor has steadily increased over time as Favor has become more readily available – this aims to restore the influx to values seen prior to the Rogue Frontier update[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Chests in Avalonian Dungeons have had their loot decreased by 10%[/*]	[*]Small, Medium, and Large Treasures now spawn 10% less frequently[/*]	[*]While we’re happy with the experience of finding a Boss Lair Map, the influx of Silver from Boss Lairs is significant. Rather than reducing the value of Boss Lairs, Lair Maps instead spawn 25% less frequently[/*]	[*]Hardcore Expeditions remain too competitive for their non-lethal nature, and have had their loot bonuses decreased by 10%[/*]	[*]While the Depths is minimally impactful to the overall economy, very successful players are still able to draw competitive loot. To prevent the feature from competing with higher-risk lethal features, the following changes have been made:	[list]		[*]Chests at the Altar of Greed in The Depths have had their loot output decreased by ~9.1%[/*]		[*]The following chests within The Depths now yield ~25% less loot when looted by solo players:		[list]			[*]The reward chest at the end of a room[/*]			[*]The chests at the Altar of Greed[/*]			[*]Miniboss and Boss chests[/*]			[*]The keyed Treasure Vaults on Level 3[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]While we like that The Depths offers an avenue for the advancement of the Conqueror’s Challenge, we feel the income is too competitive with Lethal activities as player kills occur more frequently than expected – as a result the Might generated by player kills and Soul deliveries has been reduce[/*]	[*]We will continue to monitor the Depths and make incremental changes if necessary. Our goal is to make certain they feel rewarding while preserving the balance between non-Lethal, partially Lethal, and fully Lethal activities[/*][/list]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Crystal Offhand Artifacts can now be crafted from Crystal Shards[/*]	[*]Adjusted Mists instance management to improve upon the changes previously made in Patch 4[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Spell Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Freezing Wind (Frost Staffs): Fixed issue where enemies could be rooted after less than one second inside the area[/*]	[*]Blood Ritual (Demonfang): Now correctly deals 20% of the caster’s max health as true damage to the caster after the 3rd cast[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where the entrance UI to the Depths would not show[/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog: Abyssal Depths Patch 3
notes.notes:
[quote][i]This patch introduces Season 26 statues and changes to the Vanity Merchant, along with various other adjustments.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Season 26 Winner Statues Unveiled[/h3]

The statues to the victorious guilds from Season 26 have been unveiled in each server’s Conqueror’s Hall. Congratulations once again to [i]IFures[/i], [i]Peony Flower[/i], and [i]Heralds of Valhalla[/i]!

[h3]Changes[/h3]

[b]Depths Changes[/b][list]	[*]The duration of each level has been reduced by 3 minutes[/*]	[*]Players now display a ghostly animation upon death, making it easier to distinguish them from those turning invisible[/*]	[*]The time between entering the Depths and being allowed to reenter has been reduced	[list]		[*]This means that players who die soon after entering can enter another Depths instance quickly[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Vanity Merchant Changes[/b][list]	[*]Tabs in the Vanity Merchant UI have been reorganized to better match those in the Appearance UI, as follows:	[list]		[*]Wardrobe, Mount Skins, Victory Emotes, Avatars, Furniture & Consumables[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The price of Victory Emotes purchased with Community Tokens has been doubled, but they now grant five times as many charges[/*]	[*]Adventurer Tokens can no longer be crafted	[list]		[*]These can be salvaged for 100 Community Tokens[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Any Adventurer’s Challenge Avatar or Avatar Ring can now be crafted with Community Tokens	[list]		[*]These can be salvaged for 40% of their Community Token value[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Mob Changes[/b][list]	[*]Damage dealt by bosses and minibosses in Hunter Corrupted Dungeons has been reduced[/*]	[*]The number of tracks in Tier 5+ blue and yellow zones has been increased to match the amount in Tier 3 and 4 blue zones[/*]	[*]Avalonian Raid bosses are now immune to silence effects[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b][list]	[*]The following items can now be sold at the Tutorial Marketplace in the Cove:	[list]		[*]Tier 1 equipment[/*]		[*]Carrot Soup[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]In Streamer Mode, region names are now hidden in region queues	[list]		[*]This applies to the HUD tracker, overhead messages, and notifications[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Cooldown for /whisper, /faction, and /factionlocal chat has been reduced to 0.5 seconds[/*]	[*]Trading in Corrupted Dungeons has been disabled[/*]	[*]The Journal missions 'Get 150,000 Infamy in Corrupted Dungeons' and above have had their rewards reduced[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Axes[/b]

[quote][i]Halberd now reduces enemies’ CC resistance, giving it a utility role and making it more attractive to bring one to group fights.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Tear Apart (Halberd)	[list]		[*]Added: enemy CC resistance decreased by 0.2 for 4s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Crossbows[/b]

[quote][i]Sweeping Bolt is now slightly easier to hit with, and has a cooldown that better matches ally CC. Its damage has also been increased to help Heavy Crossbow find a place in the meta.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Sweeping Bolt (Heavy Crossbow)	[list]		[*]Improved hit detection, including a slightly larger hitbox[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 15s → 20s[/*]		[*]Damage: 192 → 225[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Cursed Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Haunting Screams now travels more slowly across the ground, allowing it to hit crowd-controlled targets more often and more reliably, benefiting both solo and group play.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Haunting Screams (Cursed Skull)	[list]		[*]Max duration: 5.3s → 5s[/*]		[*]Distance covered: 12m → 10m[/*]		[*]Damage per tick: 28 → 31[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shapeshifter Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Pulse Shock has continued to be favored over Reality Fissure, even for 1v1 combat with ranged shapes. To make it a more attractive option in those situations, its cast time has been reduced to improve reliability.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Reality Fissure (all Shapeshifter Staffs)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 0.4s → 0.3s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Swords[/b]

[quote][i]Mighty Blow’s stand time and ending distance from the target have been reduced, making it easier for Heroic Strike to follow up on fleeing enemies despite its recent range reduction.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Mighty Blow (Broadsword)	[list]		[*]Dash stand time: 0.3s → 0.1s[/*]		[*]End position offset: -2.5m → -2m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Helmets[/b]

[quote][i]Now that purges like those from Knight Armor are common, Displacement’s cooldown has been reduced to keep it a reliable answer to forced movement effects.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Displacement Immunity (Knight Helmet)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 30s → 25s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Energizing Shield has provided slightly too much energy security in 1v1 content. Increasing its cooldown gives opponents a larger window to punish energy-hungry builds that rely on it as their sole sustain.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Energizing Shield (all Helmets, Caps and Cowls)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 20s → 25s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b]

[quote][i]Mistwalker has been slightly too strong in both 2v2s and ZvZ bombing. To rein it in, its dash range has been reduced by one meter to match Cleric Sandals’ Blink.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]After Image (Mistwalker Shoes)	[list]		[*]Dash range: 11m → 10m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Ethereal Form’s invincibility duration has been reduced from 4.5s to 4s, so solo ZvZ bombers who are CC’d during the two-second vulnerability window can now be more reliably punished.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ethereal Form (Feyscale Sandals)	[list]		[*]Maximum Duration: 6.5s → 6s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b][list]	[*] Inner Shadow (Shadowcaller)	[list]		[*]Improved visual indication of the area affected by Plate Armor’s effect[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3][list]	[*]Fixed resource filters not working correctly in the Bank Overview[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where changing regions with an overcharged item equipped would cause health to display its base value[/*]	[*]Fixed rare issue in the Depths where two teams could spawn in the same location[/*][/list]

notes.title: Dev Talk: Development Update July 2025
notes.notes:
The [b]Abyssal Depths[/b] update has been live for a few weeks, bringing fresh life to Albion’s instanced PvP and new player experience. In this [b]Dev Talk[/b], Game Director [b]Moritz Bokelmann[/b] looks at how the update is performing so far and offers an early look at the upcoming Faction Warfare rework.

[previewyoutube=qgv9CAx_WQc;full][/previewyoutube][h3]Abyssal Depths[/h3]
[b]Instanced Content[/b]
[list]	[*][b]The Depths[/b] have seen strong engagement from both competitive and casual players	[list]		[*]Over [b]4 million sessions[/b] have already been played[/*]		[*]Players spent over [b]100 years of collective playtime[/b] in the first few weeks[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]The [b]risk-reward balance[/b] seems just right, keeping a wide range of players involved[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/15c3dcafc8d06b3ca4d3e61617910f0a393a3cee.png[/img][list]	[*]The [b]Antiquarian’s Den[/b] is working well as a hub for hell-themed PvP content	[list]		[*][b]Increased population[/b] across all modes in Hellgates and Corrupted Dungeons[/*]		[*]Players appreciate the cohesive feel of the entire hell-themed experience[/*]	[/list][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/85c6411193856d7b1ba90dd575e7ed0b2154c433.png[/img]

[b]New Player Experience[/b]
[list]	[*]Quality-of-life changes are helping new players settle in more smoothly with:	[list]		[*][b]Clearer progression[/b] paths[/*]		[*][b]Better onboarding[/b] experience[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]Early signs suggest [b]improved retention[/b], though it’s still too soon for long-term data[/*][/list]Overall, the update has largely been met with a positive response, and we’ll continue to pay attention to your feedback as we move forward.

[h3]What’s Next: Faction Warfare Rework[/h3]
Planned for release this fall, the next major update will bring a significant rework to [b]Faction Warfare[/b]. This core PvP system plays a key role in Albion’s open-world activity, and the team aims to build on its foundation to make it more engaging, accessible, and rewarding.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/41e3099e9bceec2effead1d378b66ac8da2297c4.png[/img]

[b]Faction Warfare’s Role[/b]
[list]	[*]Acts as a [b]stepping stone[/b] between casual open-world content and high-stakes guild warfare[/*]	[*]Supports meaningful, repeatable PvP activity across the map[/*]	[*]Drives [b]regional conflict[/b] and[b] player circulation[/b], enriching Albion’s dynamic economy[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8f3c36576525681e6902b337a1adf32f1562b97a.png[/img]

[b]Current Issues[/b]
[list]	[*]The [b]frontline system[/b] isn’t consistently bringing opposing groups into conflict[/*]	[*][b]Long travel times[/b] to conflict zones create friction and missed opportunities	[list]		[*]Many players bypass each other, and fights often fizzle out before others can arrive[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*][b]Gameplay variety[/b] is limited, with most activity focused solely on capturing Outposts[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1f2d95fb3927d9ff220671bd128af9889c405759.png[/img]

[b]Areas of Improvement[/b]
[list]	[*][b]Refocus fighting[/b] into clearer hotspots to encourage more frequent and predictable PvP	[list]		[*]This includes [b]reducing travel time[/b] and making active zones easier to reach[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]Introduce a wider [b]variety of objectives[/b] to prevent repetition and deepen tactical play[/*]	[*]Improve [b]accessibility [/b]for solo players and pickup groups	[list]		[*]Without requiring guild membership, players should still be able to find allies and jump into the action[/*]	[/list][/*][/list]The update is still in early development, but we’ll share more details as soon as we’re able. As always, your feedback is important, so we’re eager to hear your ideas. Watch the full [b]Dev Talk[/b] above and share your thoughts in the comments!

notes.title: Changelog: Abyssal Depths Patch 2
notes.notes:
[quote][i]This patch adds further improvements and polish to the Abyssal Depths update, including a Marketplace to the Antiquarian's Den, adjustments to the Depths, and several bugfixes.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Changes[/h3]

[b]Antiquarian’s Den Changes[/b][list]	[*]Antiquarian’s Dens now contain a Marketplace vendor for the corresponding city’s Marketplace[/*]	[*]The Antiquarian now shows its pet’s name, as chosen by the community[/*][/list]
[b]The Depths Changes[/b][list]	[*]Opening a small chest after completing a room now grants a Demonic Ferocity stack to all party members in range[/*]	[*]In the final level of the Depths, an additional key will appear after ten minutes, and every 3 minutes after that, if the Treasure Vault has not yet been opened[/*]	[*]Minimap icons for Coffers and Chests have been made larger[/*]	[*]Treasure Coffers now only appear on the minimap when in proximity[/*]	[*]There are now PvE and PvP Fame categories for the Depths category in the Player, Guild, and Alliance Rankings[/*]	[*]Timer in the entrance UI now displays seconds when less than 1 minute remains[/*][/list] [b]Albion Journal Changes[/b][list]	[*]The following missions have had their rewards adjusted:	[list]		[*]Get a Weapon Generalist Node to level 30[/*]		[*]Get a Weapon Specialist Node to level 30[/*]		[*]Unlock Tier 5 Reaver[/*]		[*]Unlock Tier 7 Reaver[/*]		[*]Reach Level 30 in any Weapon Generalist Node[/*]		[*]Reach Level 30 in any Weapon Specialist Node[/*]		[*]Apply a Chest, Shoe and Helmet skin[/*]		[*]Unlock x Wardrobe or Mount Skins[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]UI Changes[/b][list]	[*]Updated icons for Generalist and Specialist nodes in the Quick Learn node management UI[/*]	[*]To minimize notification spam, players will now receive fewer notifications when multiple Destiny Board nodes are leveled up simultaneously[/*]	[*]10v10 Hellgate stats have been archived in the player stats UI[/*]	[*]Kill Details UI now displays a full timestamp for each kill[/*]	[*]Appearance UI filters now persist after switching tabs or closing the UI[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b][list]	[*]Mobs and mob groups in the open world and the Depths now have shorter leash ranges when not attacked	[list]		[*]This change has been made to make open-world travel more comfortable and to help players in the Depths stay focused during ongoing PvP encounters[/*]	[/list]	[/list] [list]	[*]Book Chests and Hidden Treasures have been removed from Corrupted Dungeons	[list]		[*]Treasure spawns that were previously either Book Chests or Treasure Chests will now always spawn Treasure Chests[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Fame shrines have been removed from Hellgates[/*]	[*]All Captured Smugglers’ guards are now Tier 6[/*]	[*]Duels are no longer possible within Hellgates[/*]	[*]Gathering tools can no longer be swapped while in combat[/*]	[*][CONTROLLER] Implemented basic HUD Tracker support[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Axes[/b]
[quote][i]Blood Bandit has been consistently punching above its weight, so its projectile speed has been reduced to give enemies at maximum range a more realistic chance to dodge it. However, its hitbox accuracy at extremely close and very long ranges has been improved.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Blood Bandit (Battleaxe)	[list]		[*]Reduced projectile speed (~9%) and increased hit detection reliability[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Cursed Staffs[/b]
[quote][i]Great Cursed Staff has been mostly pushed out by the Rotcaller Staff in small group content. To help it succeed in its role of maintaining DoT pressure, Area of Decay’s cooldown has been reduced.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Area of Decay (Great Cursed Staff)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 25s → 20s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Fire Staffs[/b]
[quote][i]Flamewalker Staff has been highly effective in solo content. Its survivability has been reduced with a longer base cooldown, while its cooldown refund for hitting enemy players has been increased to reward aggressive play.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Spontaneous Combustion (Flamewalker Staff)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 30s → 40s[/*]		[*]Cooldown refund: 25% → 40%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Frost Staffs[/b]
[quote][i]Frostbite and Ice Shard have been often superseded by Frozen Surge in most content. Rather than nerfing Frozen Surge directly, the alternatives have been adjusted to make them more attractive.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Frostbite (all Frost Staffs)	[list]		[*]Removed: 4% bonus damage[/*]		[*]Added new effect: Frostbite		[list]			[*]Stack duration: 2.5s[/*]			[*]3-stack effect: Stuns for 0.8s[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Ice Shard (all Frost Staffs)	[list]		[*]Cast range: 13m → 14m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b]
[quote][i]Lifetouch Staff has been too strong in Corrupted Dungeons, but underwhelming in group play, so it’s getting a higher cooldown, farther range, less burst healing, and a new buff for allies.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Holy Touch (Lifetouch Staff)	[list]		[*]Healing per tick: 76.8 → 55[/*]		[*]Tick count: 5 → 7[/*]		[*]Max channel duration: 2s → 3s[/*]		[*]Range: 9m → 11m[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 15s → 20s[/*]		[*]Added: Increases all damage the targeted ally deals by 15%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Following recent buffs, Smite has become too strong in both PvE and PvP. Its damage has been reduced, while the improved cooldown is being retained.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Smite (all Holy Staffs)	[list]		[*]Instant damage: 151 → 136[/*]		[*]Mark damage: 43 → 38[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Maces[/b]
[quote][i]Dreadstorm Monarch has been given some quality-of-life improvements to help it compete, including a shorter cooldown between casts and increased slow strength.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Eye of the Storm (Dreadstorm Monarch)	[list]		[*]Cooldown between uses: 2s → 1.5s[/*]		[*]Slow strength: 20% → 25%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Quarterstaffs[/b]
[quote][i]Black Monk Stave has seen increasing use in ZvZs, while being one of the most demanding weapons in terms of visual and combat clarity. Its tick interval and maximum area duration have been reduced, while its damage reduction strength per stack has been increased to compensate.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Fatal Blade (Black Monk Stave)	[list]		[*]Area duration: 5s → 3s[/*]		[*]Damage per tick: 25 → 80[/*]		[*]Damage reduction per stack (vs players): 30% → 40%[/*]		[*]Maximum stack count: 4 → 3[/*]		[*]Damage and debuff interval: 0.75s → 1.25s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Hurricane’s damage to players has been increased to match its damage to mobs, and it has been given bonus resistances to help Iron-clad players escape safely after sowing chaos among their enemies.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Hurricane (Iron-clad Staff)	[list]		[*]Damage per tick: 32 → 55[/*]		[*]Added: 0.15 armor and magic resistance for 5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shapeshifter Staffs[/b]
[quote][i]Crystalburst has been given a significant damage boost to ensure the Crystal Cobra transformation remains deadly.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Crystalburst (Stillgaze Staff)	[list]		[*]Tick count: 3 → 4[/*]		[*]Tick interval: 1s → 0.8s[/*]		[*]Damage per tick: 18 → 27 (Total damage: 54 → 108)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Hellspawn Imp’s passive has been offering too much safety in 2v2 and 3v3. To get a second life, it now requires transforming with sufficient stacks and giving up Hellfire Barrage.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Return from Hell (Hellspawn Staff)	[list]		[*]Respawn always → Respawn requires at least 3 shift charges[/*]		[*]Heal based on shift charges → 18% of max health[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Spears[/b]
[quote][i]Corrupting Steel has had its recent area damage-over-time nerf reverted to preserve its viability as a DPS contributor.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Corrupting Steel (Spirithunter)	[list]		[*]Returned damage over time[/*]		[*]Damage per tick: 32[/*]		[*]Tick interval: 0.5s (8 ticks total)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]War Gloves[/b]
[quote][i]Forcepulse Bracers now use the ‘speed’ auto-attack pattern, and have received cooldown reductions, including a new refund based on the time elapsed between the initial cast and recast.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Unstoppable Rush (Forcepulse Bracers)	[list]		[*]Auto-attack pattern changed to ‘speed’ variant (from three-hit combo to two-hit combo)[/*]		[*]Single cast cooldown: 20s → 15s[/*]		[*]Recast cooldown: Refunds time elapsed before recasting[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Helmets[/b]
[quote][i]Following the recent quality-of-life change that prevents Hellion Hood from silencing allies, players have been stacking Hellion Hoods to keep mobs permanently silenced, trivializing some PvE encounters.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Smoke Bomb (Hellion Hood)	[list]		[*]Mobs can no longer be consecutively silenced[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Armors[/b]
[quote][i]Specter Jacket’s aura radius has been increased to better match its visuals. [/i][/quote][list]	[*]Self Ignition (Specter Jacket)	[list]		[*]Aura radius: 6m → 7m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Albion Journal Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Apply a Chest, Shoe and Helmet Skin’ stated that all needed to be applied simultaneously[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where ‘Participate in x Raids’ missions would not track progress correctly[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Hunt a Rare Creature’ would not count higher-tier Tracking targets[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Catch 5 fish’ could progress from unrelated items[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the missions ‘Defeat any Crystal Cobra’ and ‘Defeat any Crystal Beetle’ displayed the wrong icons[/*]	[*]Progress bars for combat specialization leveling missions now display the number of achieved nodes[/*][/list]
[b]Mob Fixes[/b][list]	[*]In the Living Legacy event, the mob Eastern Titan of the Nineteenth Age’s Separator spell now knocks players into the air[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Royal Guard Towers outside Royal Cities would not attack players from enemy factions[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Sir Bedivere would not perform auto-attacks when affected by Smokebomb[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Shadow Panther would not spawn additional panthers within its Silencing Mist[/*][/list]
[b]UI Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where available Learning Points in the Destiny Board were rounded in a misleading way[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Caerleon’s Antiquarian’s Den entrance displayed the wrong minimap icon[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where default item sorting would not follow Marketplace categorization[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where ‘Home’ button would erroneously display as a respawn option[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where clicking a chat link would move the character if ‘Lock Window’ was enabled[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Death Recap would display a spell’s full CC duration, even if death occurred before this duration was elapsed[/*]	[*]Fixed various HUD Tracker display issues[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the toggle to hide/show Vanity Sources was missing its icon[/*]	[*]Quick Thinker (Leather Jackets, Hoods, and Shoes): Fixed issue where an incorrect Cooldown Rate was displayed in the item details[/*]	[*][CONTROLLER] Fixed issue where hovering over a node on the Destiny Board would sometimes cause it to open and close repeatedly[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where the carry weight bonus from shoe passives would be reduced by Item Power caps[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where players could enter the next Hellgate without defeating the enemy team, and would not receive a reward chest after doing so[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the rarity VFX of Treasure Vaults in the Depths would not display once opened[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where Group Dungeon entrances in the Mists could sometimes not be used[/*]	[*]Various fixes and improvements to tutorial missions[/*]	[*]Various additional graphical, animation, terrain, audio, UI, and localization fixes[/*][/list]

notes.title: The Crucible: Week Two Update
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b068114e708e9f986e1a32972f38794b1789e23a.png[/img]

[b]The Crucible [/b]is now halfway through, and a fierce battle is unfolding at the top of the leaderboard. [b]Zizaran[/b] has narrowly overtaken [b]Zerator[/b] after a week of relentless grinding, with both creators trading blows as their guilds fight to stay ahead. [b]Diables & ZWIERZAAK[/b]’s team has surged into third, while former frontrunner [b]Quin69[/b] now sits in sixth. [b]Metashi[/b] is holding on in the top 10, with [b]Knekro[/b] just outside it. But determined challengers like [b]REVENANT[/b], [b]Nozadah[/b], [b]ZeusGhostz[/b], [b]CAHOS_GAMING[/b], and [b]NorgannonHH[/b], are making sure every spot is hard-won.

The first half of the contest has made one thing clear: these first-time Albion players are diving headfirst into every corner of the game. From leading warbands in the Outlands to grinding the Depths for hours on end, they’re making the most of every opportunity to climb the ranks.

And don’t forget: this weekend is your last chance to guarantee the exclusive [b]Brown Alpaca[/b] mount skin! Until [b]Sunday, July 20[/b] at [b]09:30 UTC[/b], simply gift 2 subs on Twitch to any [b]Crucible participant[/b], [b]AOCP Creator[/b], or [url=https://www.twitch.tv/albiononline][b]AlbionTV[/b][/url] to claim this fluffy companion instantly. Just look for the Alpaca icon on top of the chat during their [b]Albion livestreams[/b] to know you’re in the right place!

The Crucible runs until [b]August 2[/b]. Keep an eye on the [url=https://albiononline.com/crucible/][b]leaderboard[/b][/url] and your favorite creators’ streams as the contest barrels toward an epic finish.

notes.title: The Crucible: Week One Update
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4399d02fa33957a74d6c5cab3dc113b9682939ad.png[/img]

We’re one week into [b]the Crucible[/b] now, and things are already shaping up nicely! The [url=https://albiononline.com/crucible/][b]leaderboard[/b][/url] shows [b]Zerator[/b] and [b]Zizaran[/b], both on the Albion Europe server, making the early running, with [b]Quin69[/b], on Albion Americas, in a strong third place. [list]	[*]A maximum of five creators can team together[/*]	[*]Any agreement on sharing prizes must be communicated by email to each creator’s campaign manager[/*]	[*]You can only team up by joining an existing participating guild; you cannot create a new guild[/*]	[*]It is not possible to merge guilds' points[/*]	[*]Upon reaching 300 guild members after teaming up, you will be required to create and manage a second guild for members of your communities that are not able to join the original guild[/*]	[*]Ingame alliances (using the Alliance feature) remain strictly prohibited[/*]	[*]Possible exceptions to any of these rules must be discussed with your campaign manager[/*][/list]

And don’t forget: a special Twitch Drop is available too. Until [b]July 20 [/b]at [b]09:30 UTC[/b], gifting 2 subs to any Crucible participant, AOCP Creator, or [b]AlbionTV ([/b][url=http://twitch.tv/albiononline][b]twitch.tv/albiononline[/b][/url][b])[/b] will guarantee you the exclusive Brown Alpaca mount skin. Tune in today!

notes.title: Changelog: Abyssal Depths Patch 1
notes.notes:
[quote][i]This patch focuses on making adjustments to new features introduced with the Abyssal Depths update, along with important fixes to a few gameplay issues.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Changes[/h3]

[b]The Depths Changes[/b][list]	[*]Gift of Wrath, Dominion, and Cruelty buff durations have been extended from 5 minutes to 10 minutes[/*]	[*]Demonic Ferocity stacks now persist after death and resurrection[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b][list]	[*]Antiquarian Standing has been adjusted for all features accessible through the Antiquarian’s Den. We aim to keep all features competitive for earning standing, while also preserving the prestige and accomplishment of unlocking higher-level rewards:	[list]		[*]Standing gained through most Hellgate modes and the Depths has been reduced[/*]		[*]Standing gained through Corrupted Dungeons and Lethal 2v2 Hellgates has been increased[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Custom match cancellations are now shown as system messages instead of popups[/*]	[*]Hellgates now have a 10 minute PvP knockdown timer[/*]	[*]Elite mobs in World Boss areas now give 34% less Fame[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]The Depths Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where Soulgates would not be properly distributed[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Item Power in the entrance UI could be miscalculated when having trashed items equipped[/*]	[*]Fixed some missing or duplicated tooltips[/*][/list]
[b]Quick Learn Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where Quick Learn would be automatically enabled after maintenance without notifying the player[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where right-clicking Quick Learn toggles would change the setting without updating its visual state in the Destiny Board[/*][/list]
[b]Spell Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Soulspindle Pounce (Soulspinner): Fixed issue where the immunity effect would not be applied[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where certain spells incorrectly delayed auto-attacks[/*][/list]
[b]UI Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where relogging during the Destiny Board tutorial would cause display issues[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Destiny Board progress filter in the HUD Tracker would not work[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the progress counter for the ‘Catch 5 fish’ Albion Journal mission would not update[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where some spell tooltips appeared larger than intended[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where Resource Wisps would spawn too often[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where opening the Destiny Board via hotkey when it was hidden in the HUD would cause the game to crash[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where incorrect Might requirements and rewards were set for the Conqueror’s Challenge[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Tier 8 Truebolt Hammer could not be listed on the Marketplace[/*]	[*]Various additional graphical, animation, terrain, audio, UI, and localization fixes[/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog: Abyssal Depths Update
notes.notes:
[quote][i]This update focuses on instanced PvP content and on introducing new players to Albion. It brings a brand-new PvP mode, a new staging ground for Hell-themed instanced content, a reworked early-game experience, a new Albion Journal category, and much more.[/i][/quote]
[h3]The Depths[/h3]

The Depths are an entirely new type of dungeon aimed at small groups of players. Players must battle mobs and each other to earn loot, and escape before the dungeon collapses. The Depths have three levels, with greater risk and rewards available the deeper you venture.

[b]Entering and exiting the Depths[/b][list]	[*]The Depths can be played in two-player or three-player modes	[list]		[*]Players can choose to enter either mode with fewer players, if they desire[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Entrances are located in the Antiquarian’s Den in each city on the Royal Continent	[list]		[*]These entrances open periodically, meaning players enter in waves[/*]		[*]Groups entering from different cities can encounter each other in the Depths[/*]		[*]An individual group must enter from the same city to play together[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Item Power restrictions	[list]		[*]Access to the dungeon requires a minimum Base Item Power of 900[/*]		[*]There is a 1200 Item Power softcap, with 20% scaling above this threshold[/*]		[*]All healing in the Depths is reduced by 30%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Once inside, players cannot leave for a limited period[/*]	[*]After a time, exits open within the Depths	[list]		[*]Some exits lead out of the dungeon, allowing players to escape with their loot[/*]		[*]Some exits lead to a deeper level		[list]			[*]There are three levels in total[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]After the exits appear, the dungeon level begins to collapse progressively	[list]		[*]Players inside receive an increasing amount of damage from this as the collapse advances[/*]		[*]Collapse can be escaped by either leaving the dungeon or descending to a deeper level that has not started to collapse yet[/*]		[*]A countdown warns when final collapse is near[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Any players still within the Depths when they collapse, or knocked out while they are collapsing, are killed[/*][/list]
[b]Orange PvP[/b][list]	[*]The Depths introduce Orange Zones, with new PvP rules[/*]	[*]On death, inventory is lost but equipped gear is not	[list]		[*]Equipped gear takes durability damage equivalent to a Yellow Zone knockdown[/*]		[*]Inventory items have the same trash rate as a death[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Kills in Orange Zones count as regular PvP kills and appear in the Kills List	[list]		[*]PvP Fame is awarded, excluding the value of the victim’s equipped items[/*]		[*]Kill Trophies are awarded, but exclude the value of equipped items when calculating their drop chances[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Content in the Depths[/b][list]	[*]Within the Depths, players can fight mobs and other groups of players[/*]	[*]Clearing all mobs in a room will unlock a reward, which can grant either loot or a buff	[list]		[*]The buffs persist for the time that the recipient is within the Depths[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Killed mobs and players can drop Souls	[list]		[*]Enemy players drop Hostile Souls (red), allies drop Friendly Souls (blue), and mobs drop Neutral Souls (white)[/*]		[*]A killed player always drops a Soul, while a mob will only sometimes drop a Soul[/*]		[*]While dead, a player will observe their own Soul within the Depths		[list]			[*]During this time, the dead player can decide to leave the Depths, forfeiting their Soul[/*]			[*]If the dead player decides to leave the Depths, their Soul will turn into a Neutral Soul for all parties[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Souls can be carried to Altars within the Depths	[list]		[*]Any Soul can be offered to an Altar of Greed in exchange for a loot reward[/*]		[*]Friendly Souls can be offered to an Altar of Awakening to resurrect the dead player[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Some rooms contain Soulgates, which can be opened with a Soul to exit the Depths	[list]		[*]These remain open for 30 seconds[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The deepest level contains a Treasure Vault containing valuable loot	[list]		[*]After a time, the Treasure Vault becomes marked on the map[/*]		[*]At this point, Keys appear within the Depths[/*]		[*]Keys must be picked up and carried to the Vault in order to open it		[list]			[*]In two-player mode, three Keys are required[/*]			[*]In three-player mode, five Keys are required[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Once the Treasure Vault is unlocked, an exit from The Depths opens for 60 seconds[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Antiquarian’s Dens[/h3]

Antiquarian’s Dens are new staging grounds for Albion’s hell-themed instanced PvP content. They allow players easier access to this content, offer a space to meet and gear up, and facilitate larger matchmaking pools.[list]	[*]Entrances to Antiquarian’s Dens can be found in every city on the Royal Continent[/*]	[*]Antiquarian’s Dens contain:	[list]		[*]Entrances to the Depths, Hellgates, and Corrupted Dungeons[/*]		[*]A Bank connected to the corresponding city[/*]		[*]A Repair Station[/*]		[*]The Antiquarian NPC (more on the Antiquarian below)[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Players from different Antiquarian’s Dens can encounter each other within its dungeons; however, groups can only enter a dungeon from the same location[/*][/list]
[h3]The Antiquarian[/h3]

The Antiquarian is a new NPC located within Antiquarians Dens. The following rewards can be purchased from the Antiquarian with Favor:[list]	[*]Two new baby spiders, which can be raised into mounts on an island:	[list]		[*]Tier 5 Hellspinner[/*]		[*]Tier 8 Soulspinner		[list]			[*]The Soulspinner has a unique spell, Soulspindle Pounce, which lifts it into the air and allows it to jump to a different location[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Demon Cape Crests[/*]	[*]Hell-themed Avatar and Avatar Ring[/*][/list]Antiquarian Standing is required to purchase these items, with more valuable items requiring higher Standing. Antiquarian Standing can be earned from PvP activity in Hellgates, Corrupted Dungeons, and the Depths.

[h3]Hellgate and Corrupted Dungeon Changes[/h3]

This update makes some adjustments to Hellgates and Corrupted Dungeons to make them more accessible, more rewarding, and improve matchmaking.

[b]Hellgates[/b][list]	[*]Hellgates are now accessible via an entrance in the Antiquarian’s Den	[list]		[*]They can no longer be entered from the open world[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]PvP activity in Hellgates contributes to Antiquarian Standing[/*]	[*]Hellgate Map item salvage value has been increased from 20% → 100%	[list]		[*]Hellgate Maps are now unusable[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Item Power entry requirements have been adjusted:	[list]		[*]2v2 Non-Lethal: 800 → 700[/*]		[*]5v5 Non-Lethal: 800 → 700[/*]		[*]2v2 Lethal: 900[/*]		[*]5v5 Lethal: 1000 → 900[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Item Power softcap:	[list]		[*]2v2 Non-Lethal: 900 (10% scaling)[/*]		[*]5v5 Non-Lethal: 900 (10% scaling)[/*]		[*]2v2 Lethal: 1100 (20% scaling) → 1100 (35% scaling)[/*]		[*]5v5 Lethal: 1200 (35% scaling) → 1100 (35% scaling)[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]PvP knockdown time in Hellgates is now unlimited[/*]	[*]Lava now breaks shields only on molten lava, not already cracked ground[/*]	[*]Both Loot and Fame have been increased	[list]		[*]Loot no longer scales with Infamy[/*]		[*]Fame Scaling from Infamy has been reduced from 50% to 20%[/*]		[*]Our intent with these changes is to make sure that these features are rewarding from the onset, rather than only rewarding for players at the top end – to accomplish this, the Loot and Fame bonuses more than compensate for the loss of the bonuses previously provided by Infamy[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]2v2 Hellgates:	[list]		[*]Hell buff now adds an additional 10% damage increase[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Removed line-of-sight blocker from various elements inside Hellgates[/*]	[*]After a victory, players now heal and have any negative effects removed[/*]	[*]10v10 Hellgates have been removed	[list]		[*]Related Albion Journal missions have been moved to a new category called “Archive”		[list]			[*]This is only visible if you have completed an archived mission[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Rewards can still be claimed from the Archive category[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b][list]	[*]Corrupted Dungeons are now accessible via an entrance in the Antiquarian’s Den	[list]		[*]Their entrances can still be found in the open world as well[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]PvP activity in Corrupted Dungeons contributes to Antiquarian Standing[/*]	[*]Corrupted Dungeon Map item salvage value has been increased from 20% to 100%[/*]	[*]Entry requirements now use base Item Power, rather than average Item Power	[list]		[*]These have been adjusted for Hunter and Slayer Corrupted Dungeons:		[list]			[*]Hunter: 800 → 700[/*]			[*]Stalker: 900[/*]			[*]Slayer: 1200 → 1100[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Matchmaking has been accelerated[/*]	[*]Both Loot and Fame have been increased	[list]		[*]Loot no longer scales with Infamy[/*]		[*]Maximum Fame scaling from Infamy has been reduced from 50% → 20%[/*]		[*]Our intent with these changes is to make sure that these features are rewarding from the onset, rather than only rewarding for players at the top end – to accomplish this, the Loot and Fame bonuses more than compensate for the loss of the bonuses previously provided by Infamy[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]After a victory, players now heal and have any negative effects removed[/*][/list]
[h3]New Player Experience[/h3]

A reworked early-game experience offers a more structured and streamlined introduction to Albion, while guiding new players through a broad range of available content.

[b]Albion Journal Category[/b][list]	[*]A new First Steps category has been added to the Albion Journal, continuing the guided experience beyond the initial tutorial	[list]		[*]All previous post-tutorial quests and their associated NPCs have been removed[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Upon receiving the Journal from Captain Tia, players choose from three starting Paths that reflect different playstyles:	[list]		[*]Adventurer: PvE-focused, introduces players to different PvE activities and the Marketplace[/*]		[*]Duelist: Emphasizes early PvP with supporting PvE to unlock and equip combat gear[/*]		[*]Gatherer: Centers on gathering and fishing, without combat[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Your chosen Path can be changed at any time[/*]	[*]Once a starting Path has been completed, the full Journal becomes accessible	[list]		[*]Progress made in other categories during the starting Path will be visible once the Journal is fully unlocked[/*]		[*]New characters can choose to skip the First Steps category and access the full Journal immediately[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Players who complete all three Paths are awarded with a scholarly vanity hat to mark their graduation[/*][/list]
[b]Improved Tutorial[/b][list]	[*]Shortened tutorial, with less gathering and crafting involved[/*]	[*]Text in tutorial quests shortened, and objective lists in quest UIs reduced[/*]	[*]Improved tutorial pacing to gradually introduce players to information[/*]	[*]Various smaller improvements[/*][/list]
[b]UI Improvements[/b][list]	[*]Improved readability of tutorial HUD hints[/*]	[*]Several UI and guidance improvements to the Journal system[/*]	[*]New Starter Town selection screen for players who have completed the tutorial and new characters who have skipped the tutorial[/*]	[*]All buildings and various NPCs now display a tooltip that explains their function[/*]	[*]The warning popup when entering a Yellow Zone for the first time has been removed[/*]	[*]The warning popup when purchasing an item from the Marketplace has been removed[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b][list]	[*]A new Showroom Island has been added	[list]		[*]This is a mockup island which players can visit to preview available features and amenities[/*]		[*]Accessible via the Island Merchant[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]An Arena Master has been added to all Starter Towns, replacing the Expedition Master[/*][/list]
[h3]New Crystal Weapons[/h3]

This update introduces the final two Crystal Weapons, with their own unique spells:[list]	[*]Truebolt Hammer (Hammer): Hyperstatic opens a vein of magical energy, protecting allies while stunning and damaging enemies[/*]	[*]Stillgaze Staff (Shapeshifter Staff): Transforms you into a Crystal Cobra, able to both spit at your enemies and petrify them with your gaze[/*][/list]
[h3]New Albion Journal Category[/h3]

This update introduces a new Albion Journal category: Character Progression. This is the final Albion Journal category currently planned.[list]	[*]This category rewards progression on the Destiny Board, encouraging players to explore different equipment and playstyles[/*]	[*]Unique rewards embody themes of enlightenment, wisdom, and mysticism[/*][/list]In addition, two new subcategories have been added: ‘The Depths’ under the PvP category, and ‘Antiquarian’s Den’ under Exploration.

[h3]Learning Point Changes[/h3]

The way Learning Points function has been overhauled to be smoother and more intuitive. The amount of Learning Points it costs overall to complete a node remains unchanged, however.[list]	[*]Destiny Board nodes no longer have a 20% threshold at which Learning Points can be spent to complete them[/*]	[*]A new Quick Learn system has been introduced, replacing Auto-Learn	[list]		[*]Fame earned for nodes on which Quick Learn is active is multiplied by five, with Learning Points spent as this boosted Fame is earned[/*]		[*]Nodes on which Quick Learn is active are visually highlighted on the Destiny Board[/*]		[*]There is an overview UI which shows all categories on which Quick Learn is active[/*]		[*]If the global Quick Learn option (at the top of the Destiny Board) is active, Learning Points are spent whenever Fame is earned for any active node[/*]		[*]Nodes which are unlocked through Quick Learn also have Quick Learn applied to them by default[/*]		[*]Auto-Learn settings that were active before the update are now applied to Quick Learn instead[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Progress made on nodes before the update has been multiplied by five within their current level. If a node had 20% or more progress, that level has been automatically completed at no LP cost.[/*][/list]
[h3]Tracking Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Tracking mobs in the open world no longer change regions during a hunt[/*]	[*]Blue and Yellow Zones now feature Tier 3 Tracking mobs, designed as more accessible, entry-level encounters than Tier 4:	[list]		[*]Undead and Keeper Rare Quarries[/*]		[*]Panther, which drops Rare Animal Remains used for crafting the Journeyman's Prowling Staff[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]These are not affected by player crowding and remain available even with multiple players nearby[/*]	[*]Starting a new hunt now clears the markers of other tracks on the Minimap and Region Map, making it easier to focus on the current target	[list]		[*]A white circle quest marker now highlights the target during hunts[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]UI Changes and Improvements[/h3]

[b]Combined HUD Tracker[/b][list]	[*]All active quests, challenges, Destiny Board nodes, and tracked Albion Journal missions are now visible in a single HUD element[/*]	[*]Additional trackers such as the Party Finder, Arena Queue, or Region Queue also appear here when active[/*]	[*]The tracker automatically adjusts based on what’s most relevant to the player’s current state and stage of progression, ensuring key objectives are visible without overwhelming the interface[/*]	[*]The Combined HUD Tracker can be configured via an integrated Settings menu, and in the HUD Editor[/*][/list]
[b]Item Categorization[/b][list]	[*]Searching for items by category has been improved in all UIs which support this (eg. Marketplace, Bank Overview, Loadouts, etc.)[/*]	[*]This now uses more intuitive categories and subcategories, making it easier to find and compare items within these UIs[/*][/list]
[b]Vanity Sources[/b][list]	[*]Vanity item icons now display an indicator of their source (e.g. Albion Store, events, referrals, etc.) in both the Appearance UI and Inspect UI[/*]	[*]Within the Appearance UI, vanity items can now be filtered by source [/*][/list]
[b]Death Recap[/b][list]	[*]Duration of combat displayed extended from 10 seconds to 3 minutes[/*]	[*]A dedicated tab has been added to display crowd control effects	[list]		[*]This tab allows zooming in and out for a detailed view[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Other UI Changes[/b][list]	[*]Albion Journal opening performance has been improved[/*]	[*]Minimap skull indicators are now hidden for 1v1 kills, unless the player directly witnessed the kill[/*]	[*]Improved the food supply UI for crafting buildings to more accurately reflect Silver rewards	[list]		[*]It now shows the Silver available and the actual Silver paid, in addition to the potential reward[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Kill Details in the Kill Trophy UI are now disabled in contexts where kill data isn’t available (e.g. Chat, Trade Window, Bank Overview)[/*]	[*][CONTROLLER] D-Pad can now be held down to continuously move between elements[/*][/list]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3]

[b]Blue and Yellow Zone Changes[/b][list]	[*]Blue and Yellow Zones in the open world (and Static Dungeons in these zones) have an Item Power softcap	[list]		[*]Softcap: 1200 IP[/*]		[*]Item Power & Awakened Weapon Trait scaling: 20%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Yellow Mists and Knightfall Abbeys mirroring the open world have the same softcap[/*]	[*]Randomized Dungeons are not affected by the Item Power softcap[/*]	[*]Durability damage on knockdown now scales down when the Base Item Power of an item is affected by an Item Power Cap	[list]		[*]Repair Costs are also scaled down as a result of this change[/*]		[*]In these cases, the repair cost of an item is equivalent to an item of equivalent Item Power		[list]			[*]E.g. if a T8 item is scaled to T6 values and you are knocked down, then the Repair Cost will be the same as a T6 item[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]This change affects all content that scales Item Power[/*]		[*]Bonuses that provide extra Item Power are not included in this calculation (e.g. from Quality and Destiny Board bonuses)[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Knockdown duration after being defeated in PvP in Yellow Zones has been reduced from 180 to 90s[/*][/list]
[b]Reaver Line[/b][list]	[*]Rewards from this line are now limited to Expedition and Avatar unlocks[/*]	[*]Removed bonus damage and defense against mobs from Reaver	[list]		[*]Mob Power has also been reduced accordingly, so players with Tier 8 Reaver will notice no difference, and new players are no longer gated by Reaver unlocks[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Given the significance of these changes, their impact and player feedback will be monitored closely[/*][/list]
[b]Resource Mists[/b][list]	[*]Legendary Resource Mists are now always Tier 8[/*]	[*]Resource Wisps are now slightly rarer but have a much higher fill rate[/*][/list]
[b]Melding[/b][list]	[*]Multiple artifacts can now be melded at once[/*]	[*]Melding is now quicker[/*][/list]
[b]Other[/b][list]	[*]The Fame buff from World Bosses has been reduced from 1% to 0.5% per stack[/*]	[*]Faction-flagged players now receive a protection bubble at the threshold of the city for which they are flagged[/*]	[*]Players now retain their Faction Flag after participating in the Arena and Expeditions[/*]	[*]Standard Arena entry requirements have been lowered from 700 to 600 IP, and equipment is now hardcapped at 600 IP[/*]	[*]Carried items dropped near exits are now pushed back to ensure they remain accessible[/*]	[*]Maps to Randomized Dungeons now can only locate dungeons within regions of the same type	[list]		[*]This means that maps can no longer be used from cities or Hideouts[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]A short delay has been added between allowed gate interactions, to prevent players from accidentally entering and immediately exiting castle gates when double-clicking[/*]	[*]Outlands player count estimates now show 16 - 30 and 31 - 50 ranges, instead of a single 16 - 50 range[/*]	[*]Bleed damage dealt by Morgana arbalists has been reduced[/*]	[*][CONTROLLER] Improved targeting of area target spells[/*]	[*][CONTROLLER] The targeting speed of area target spells should now be consistent on all frame rates	[list]		[*]As a result, the speed may feel different than before for some players[/*]		[*]Players can adjust Spellmarker Stick Sensitivity in the settings[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Arcane Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Astral Staff has been hard to deal with in large group fights, so its resilience penetration has been reduced to keep its top-end damage potential comparable to alternatives.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Starfall (Astral Staff)	[list]		[*]Resilience Penetration: 50% → 35%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Time Freeze has continued to be a very powerful utility option for groups, so its Energy cost and cooldown at lower Item Powers have been increased in order for it to require a bit more investment for its impact (cooldown is reduced after 1466 IP).[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Time Freeze (Great Arcane Staff)	[list]		[*]Energy Cost: 15 → 27[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 50s → 72s[/*]		[*]Cooldown reduction per 100 IP: 1s → 2.5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Axes[/b]

[quote][i]Bloody Reap had fallen out of the meta after its previous nerfs, so some of those changes have been reverted to bring it back into contention.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Bloody Reap (Infernal Scythe)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 25s → 20s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Razor Cut is a great option for players who want to brawl. As a bug has been fixed that resulted in lower healing than expected, its lifesteal strength has now been reduced to compensate.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Razor Cut (Bear Paws)	[list]		[*]Lifesteal strength: 20% → 15%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Bows[/b]

[quote][i]Following the previous buff that significantly reduced its cooldown, Deadly Shot has been highly effective. To keep its range in line with the rest of the field, a previous buff has been reverted to limit some of its low-cooldown offscreen poke.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Deadly Shot (all Bows)	[list]		[*]Range: 20m → 18m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Enchanted Quiver has struggled to find a place since its rework. Alongside a shorter cooldown, the number of enchanted arrows has been reduced, while their damage has been increased to make each shot more impactful.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Enchanted Quiver (Bow)	[list]		[*]Amount of initial arrows: 6 → 4[/*]		[*]Additional arrows on recast: 4 → 3[/*]		[*]Maximum arrows: 6 → 5[/*]		[*]Physical attack bonus Strength: 230% → 280%[/*]		[*]Physical attack bonus with enemy player within 6m: 185% → 235%[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 12s → 10s[/*]		[*]Energy cost: 19 → 11[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]In addition to a more generous hitbox, Multishot’s mini knockback has been removed and replaced by a slow, and its damage has been increased significantly to make it both more attractive to play with, and less frustrating to play against.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Multishot (all Bows)	[list]		[*]Removed knockback[/*]		[*]Added: 30% slow for 1s[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 5s → 3s[/*]		[*]Damage: 115 → 127[/*]		[*]Cast time: 0.3s → 0s (Stand time remains 0.2s)[/*]		[*]Hit delay: 0s → 0.2s[/*]		[*]Range: 12m → 13m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Raging Storm’s initial hit now counts as direct damage, which means Bloodlust (Mercenary Jacket) will now heal once per target hit, and Counter (all War Gloves) will be a working counter, among other new interactions. [b]Crossbows[/b]

[quote][i]Divine Engine has picked up in play following its recent buffs. Its performance is being monitored but, in the meantime, an energy cost has been added.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Divine Engine (Energy Shaper)	[list]		[*]Energy cost: 0 → 29[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Cursed Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Armor Piercer has received an AoE escalation in addition to its resistance reduction debuff, but as it already performs well, its damage output has been reduced to compensate.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Armor Piercer (all Cursed Staffs)	[list]		[*]Damage: 130 → 110[/*]		[*]Added missing AoE escalation to resistance reduction[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Daggers[/b]

[quote][i]Deadly Swipe has had its range reduced to keep its mobility potential under control.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Deadly Swipe (all Daggers)	[list]		[*]Range: 5m → 4.5m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Frost Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Avalanche has been picking up some play, but to give it another small push, its slow can no longer be cleansed while in the snowball’s trail.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Avalanche (Hoarfrost Staff)	[list]		[*]Slow no longer cleansable[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Glacial Prison did not have a clear range indicator for the size of its damage, so its damage size has been unified with its vfx for better readability, and its damage increased to compensate.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Glacial Prison (Chillhowl)	[list]		[*]Damage radius: 8m → 6m[/*]		[*]Damage: 230 → 249[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Hammers[/b]

[quote][i]Seismic Tremor’s final hit has been sped up to improve its gameplay feel.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Seismic Tremor (all Hammers)	[list]		[*]Channel time: 1.8s → 1.6s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Sacred Pulse’s heal has been changed to single target in order to help Holy Staff players feel more secure in PvE.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Sacred Pulse (all Holy Staffs)	[list]		[*]Heal: 40 → 94[/*]		[*]No longer heals in a 5m radius around the target[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Smite has had its cooldown and damage increased to help Holy Staff PvE.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Smite (all Holy Staffs)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 2s → 3s[/*]		[*]Direct damage: 100 → 151[/*]		[*]Mark damage: 30 → 43[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Sanctify’s area removal pool has been expanded slightly to include two spells that contain buffing components in addition to their hostile effects. [quote][i]Gravitas has received a cooldown reduction to reduce Morning Star’s downtime.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Gravitas (Morning Star)	[list]		[*]Recast cooldown: 45s → 40s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

[quote][i]Thorn Growth’s area now has a larger initial radius to make it easier to land in PvP against moving targets.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Thorn Growth (all Nature Staffs)	[list]		[*]Initial area radius: 0m → 1m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Well of Life’s cooldown has been reduced to give Wild Staff players a faster second cast if the initial cast didn’t provide sufficient healing.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Well of Life (Wild Staff)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 25s → 20s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

[quote][i]Mystic Rocks’ aura radius has been increased slightly to help Staff of Balance players better control the battlefield.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Mystic Rocks (Staff of Balance)	[list]		[*]Healing reduction and slow aura radius: 6m → 6.5m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

[quote][i]As Hellspawn Imp continued to dominate at the top end of 2v2s, a disruption factor has been added to Hellfire Barrage, which reduces the channel duration if hit to give opponents a clear option to fight back. [quote][i]Corrupting Steel’s area damage often felt like a tacked-on afterthought. [quote][i]Swords’ passive move speed has been reworked to preserve their high movement speed bonus in active combat while reducing their escape potential if there are no targets nearby.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Heroic Charge (all Swords)	[list]		[*]Removed: 9% Movement speed per stack[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Heroic Cleave (all Swords)	[list]		[*]Added 20% movement speed buff for 5s on hit[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Heroic Strike (all Swords)	[list]		[*]Added 20% movement speed buff for 3s on hit[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Iron Will (all Swords)	[list]		[*]Movement speed buff: 10% → 30%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Limit Breaker had been taking over as a ZvZ powerhouse, offering high damage and utility. notes.title: Changelog: Rogue Frontier Patch 8

[quote][i]This small patch addresses some combat balance issues and improves underused spells, alongside some minor bug fixes.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Arcane Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]To make Magic Shock a more reliable tool for dealing damage and interrupting enemy casts, its cast time has been significantly reduced.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Magic Shock (all Arcane Staffs)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 0.5s → 0.35s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

[b]Quarterstaffs[/b]

[quote][i]Cartwheel’s cooldown has been reduced to help Quarterstaff tanks find more success, but to maintain a consistent total mobility, the movement speed buff on hit has been removed.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Cartwheel (all Quarterstaffs)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 8s → 6s[/*]		[*]Removed: 20% movespeed bonus when hit[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

[quote][i]This is a small patch focused on further polishing for select weapon lines, and some bugfixes.[/i][/quote]

Therefore, its movement speed buff per stack has been reduced.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Throwing Blades (all Daggers)	[list]		[*]Movement speed buff per stack: 25% → 15%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Frost Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]With the cast time removed, its high range, and low cooldown, Frost Lance’s damage was too high and has now been reduced.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Frost Lance (all Frost Staffs)	[list]		[*]Damage: 160 → 148[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Hail now has a small slow to help Great Frost players provide some utility to their allies and help land follow-up casts.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Hail (Great Frost Staff)	[list]		[*]Added: 10% slow for 2s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shapeshifter Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Unstable Projectile has received a slight increase to the front of the cone’s width, allowing the caster to hit enemies adjacent to their target more often, and also has some more power behind each blast.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Unstable Projectile (all Shapeshifter Staffs)	[list]		[*]Cone splash damage: 40 → 44[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Armors[/b]

[quote][i]Requite has been a dominant item in 1v1 content, offering defenses, damage, and CC. We want to keep its high impact defenses and CC, but have reduced its damage to reduce its power in high hit-count cases.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Requite (Armor of Valor)	[list]		[*]Damage: 31 → 27[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Miscellaneous[/b][list]	[*]Judgment (Lightcaller)	[list]		[*]Visuals have been updated to be more readable in large-scale fights[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]These abilities no longer require line of sight:	[list]		[*]Cursed Tar (all Cursed Staffs)[/*]		[*]Explosive Bolt (all Crossbows)[/*]		[*]Explosive Mine (Weeping Repeater)[/*]		[*]Fatal Blade (Black Monk Stave)[/*]		[*]Seedling’s Bloom (Rootbound Staff)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]UI Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where the Kills and Deaths tabs in Player Stats UI would show all results after reopening regardless of the selected filter[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where some account-wide Avatar and Avatar Ring rewards would not appear as unlocked[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where repairing an item after moving Siphoned Energy in the inventory could prevent it from being overcharged[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where taking a filled Journal manually from a Mercenary could prevent Silver from being collected and the Mercenary from being sent to work again[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Marketplace offers could not be sorted by lowest price after sorting by item and then reopening the UI[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue in Timbertop Wood where players and mobs could fall through the ground in a Dynamic Encampment[/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog: Rogue Frontier Patch 6
notes.notes:
[quote][i]This light patch brings a handful of balance tweaks, background optimizations, and minor fixes.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Arcane Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Evensong and Locus have fallen out of favor as Great Arcane has grown increasingly valued. Their cooldowns have been adjusted to promote variance in the arcane support slot.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Dark Sphere (Evensong)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 42s → 38s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Void (Malevolent Locus)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 68s → 62s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Time Freeze (Great Arcane Staff)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 45s → 50s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Frost Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]As most Frost players have shifted toward Frozen Surge and sustain builds, some damage has been added back to Ice Shard to better reward cast speed-focused setups.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ice Shard (all Frost Staffs)	[list]		[*]Damage vs players: 125 → 130[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Spears[/b]

[quote][i]Cripple’s damage has been increased, as it was too conservative for a low-range, single-target ability that requires users to hold it for the right moment.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Cripple (all Spears)	[list]		[*]Damage: 106.03 → 120[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Swords[/b]

[quote][i]Hamstring’s first cast has felt underwhelming for players, so its base slow duration has been increased, the time window to cast Heroic Leap extended, and the cooldown when not multicasting reduced.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Hamstring (all Swords)	[list]		[*]1st cast cooldown: 10s → 8s[/*]		[*]Time window duration: 3s → 4s[/*]		[*]Slow duration: 3s → 4s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]War Gloves[/b]

[quote][i]Create Opening’s restrictive range has limited its effective output, so its baseline damage and resistance reduction have been increased to improve its overall value.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Create Opening (all War Gloves)	[list]		[*]Damage: 72 → 80[/*]		[*]Pierce: 0.1 → 0.12[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

To keep the potion attractive, its healing reduction has been increased.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Hellfire Potion	[list]		[*]Damage vs players (700 IP): 42.4 → 36[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (800 IP): 64.5 → 54.8[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (900 IP): 82.5 → 70.1[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (1000 IP): 98.2 → 83.5[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (1100 IP): 112 → 95.2[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (1200 IP): 126 → 107[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (1300 IP): 138 → 117[/*]		[*]Damage vs players (1400 IP): 149 → 126[/*]		[*]Healing received reduction: 35% → 50%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

(Command Mammoth)	[list]		[*]Buffs are now applied via an aura, and are removed when leaving this area[/*]		[*]Buffs are no longer purgeable[/*]				[*]High Command now correctly increases their effects for the full duration[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
