notes.title: Changelog: Rogue Frontier Patch 5
notes.notes:
[quote][i]This patch focuses on Guild Season content, introducing the next batch of Crystal Weapons and several balance changes to shake up the ZvZ meta ahead of the new season.[/i][/quote]
[h3]New Crystal Weapons[/h3]

This patch introduces three brand-new Crystal Weapons, craftable from Artifacts awarded in Conqueror’s Chests at the end of Season 26. Each Crystal Weapon has its own unique, powerful spell:[list]	[*][b]Flamewalker Staff[/b] (Fire Staff): [b]Spontaneous Combustion [/b]transforms you into a raging fireball, flying towards your enemies and dealing damage to those in your path[/*]	[*][b]Forgebark Staff [/b](Nature Staff): [b]Dual Nature[/b] allows you to switch between fortifying your allies and ensnaring your enemies[/*]	[*][b]Arclight Blasters[/b] (Crossbow): [b]Flickershots [/b]unleashes a barrage of energy bolts as you spin through the air, dealing damage and increasing your resistances[/*][/list]
[h3]Season 27 Changes[/h3]

The following categories in the Conqueror's Challenge have had their Might requirements per level reduced, while their Season Point output for each level has also been reduced to maintain overall Season Point payouts:

[b]Treasures[/b][list]	[*]Might needed per Level: 13,000 → 10,400	[list]		[*]Season Points per Level: 20 → 16[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Crystal Creatures[/b][list]	[*]Might needed per Level: 6,000 → 4,000	[list]		[*]Season Points per Level: 30 → 20[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Smugglers[/b][list]	[*]Might needed per Level: 34,000 → 27,200	[list]		[*]Season Points per Level: 20 → 16[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]Gathering has also had its Might requirement per level reduced, to make it easier for smaller guilds to earn Season Points from this activity:

[b]Gathering[/b][list]	[*]Might needed per Level: 3,500 → 2,700[/*][/list]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Smuggler Crates are now visible on the minimap to everyone in the same region[/*]	[*]Players can now send only one message every two seconds in the following chat channels:	[list]		[*]Say[/*]		[*]Whisper[/*]		[*]Help[/*]		[*]Faction[/*]		[*]Faction Local[/*]		[*]All language channels[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The following automated chat message has been changed:	[list]		[*]“Player x has committed suicide.” → “Player x has died.”[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Text entered in the Marketplace UI search box now carries over when switching between the Buy and Buy Order tabs[/*]	[*]The Kills and Deaths tabs in the Player Stats UI now remember the previous dropdown selection on opening[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Axes[/b]
[quote][i]Despite multiple nerfs, Infernal Scythe has continued to dominate as the ZvZ damage dealer of choice, crowding out alternatives. The damage of the second swing has been increased but converted into a DoT to disincentivize zergs from running five per party.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Bloody Reap (Infernal Scythe)	[list]		[*]2nd swing now deals damage in 3 ticks over 2 seconds (doesn’t stack)[/*]		[*]Damage per tick below 40%: 85 (total damage 220 → 255)[/*]		[*]Damage per tick above 40%: 47 (total damage 120 → 141)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Raging Blades has been a powerful component of axes’ domination in ZvZs, so its area has been reduced to limit its effectiveness in the largest fights.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Raging Blades (all Axes)	[list]		[*]Radius: 6m → 5m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Crossbows[/b]
[quote][i]Energy Shaper has remained a niche pick in ZvZs. Its total channel duration has been reduced, while the damage per tick has been increased to make accurate beams deadlier in a shorter time.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Divine Engine (Energy Shaper)	[list]		[*]Channel duration: 3.3s → 2.6s (Total ticks 11 → 9)[/*]		[*]Damage per tick (vs players): 96 → 117[/*]		[*]Damage per tick (vs mobs): 57 → 70[/*]		[*]Initial tick: 0.2s → 0.1s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Daggers[/b]
[quote][i]Because Demonfang has been a menace in ZvZ, it has received multiple nerfs to damage and resilience penetration over previous patches. Some of that damage has now been restored.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Blood Ritual (Demonfang)	[list]		[*]Damage per cast: 106 → 112[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Due to the significant setup required for Ring of Death, its penalty for misexecution has been softened, giving Twin Slayer players more opportunities to land the one-shot.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ring of Death (Twin Slayers)	[list]		[*]1st cast cooldown: 25s → 15s[/*]		[*]Energy cost: 12 → 10[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Fire Staffs[/b]
[quote][i]Raging Flare’s damage has been condensed and increased to provide Fire users with a quicker, more impactful long-range damage option.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Raging Flare (all Fire Staffs)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 0.6s → 0.4s[/*]		[*]Impact damage: 186 → 205[/*]		[*]DoT ticks: 6 → 3 (1s interval unchanged)[/*]		[*]DoT damage per tick: 7.2 → 21.4[/*]		[*]Total DoT damage: 43.2 → 64.2[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Frost Staffs[/b]
[quote][i]Frost’s spell stack requirement has been reduced, as it felt too high on builds using less spammable abilities like Frozen Surge and Frost Nova. This will help Frost players keep enemies locked down more consistently.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Frost (all Frost Staffs)	[list]		[*]Stack requirement: 5 → 4[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Icicle Staff has remained a niche defensive tank option in ZvZs, but its dramatic hit delay has made it feel outdated in modern Albion, so this has been reduced to improve responsiveness.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Frozen Hell (Icicle Staff)	[list]		[*]Hit delay: 0.7s → 0.3s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Permafrost has been a strong ZvZ option, but its crowd control when stacked as an 8-man bomb squad has left too little room for reaction. With such a consistently valuable long-range stun, its damage has been reduced to compensate.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ice Crystal (Permafrost Prism)	[list]		[*]Damage: 184.69 → 173[/*]		[*]Stun duration now ignores diminishing returns (but does not apply it)[/*]		[*]Stun duration no longer refreshes by consecutive Ice Crystal stuns[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Hammers[/b]
[quote][i]Grovekeeper has fallen out of favor as both an engage and peel tank option. The bonus resistances for hitting targets have not felt impactful to Grovekeeper players, so they have been removed in favor of an instant knock-up, making engages more deadly, even against enemy cleanses.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ground Pound (Grovekeeper)	[list]		[*]Removed: Increased resistances per targets hit[/*]		[*]Added: Knocks up all targets for a duration based on the amount of enemies hit		[list]			[*]1, 2, or 3 enemies hit: 0.4s knock up[/*]			[*]4, 5 or 6 enemies hit: 0.8s knock up[/*]			[*]7 or more enemies hit: 1.2s knock up[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b]
[quote][i]To help Exalted Staff feel more responsive and succeed in its intended role of clearing hostile ground areas, its long cast time has been reduced.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Sanctify (Exalted Staff)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 1s → 0.6s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Maces[/b]
[quote][i]Dreadstorm Monarch has struggled to find a strong foothold in the meta. As a result, the value of Eye of the Storm’s uncleansable resistance reduction has been increased, to help it compete with alternative pierce options.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Eye of the Storm (Dreadstorm Monarch)	[list]		[*]Resistance reduction: 0.15 → 0.18[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Vendetta’s pull hit delay has felt overly generous to opponents, so it has been shortened to help Camlann compete with other clump tank options.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Vendetta (Camlann Mace)	[list]		[*]Hit delay: 1.5s → 1.2s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Nature Staffs[/b]
[quote][i]Protection of Nature has been a strong defensive tool with a very high uptime. Its high damage reduction, paired with the bonus healing received, has resulted in targets having too much survivability too often in smaller-scale group fights, so its resistance has been reduced somewhat.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Protection of Nature (all Nature Staffs)	[list]		[*]Resistance: 0.24 → 0.2[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Quarterstaffs[/b]
[quote][i]To help Fatal Blades counter fast ZvZ engages, its damage reduction now stacks higher and faster, but with reduced duration.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Fatal Blade (Black Monk Stave)	[list]		[*]Damage reduction (vs. players): 22% → 30%[/*]		[*]Duration: 6s → 5s[/*]		[*]Initial tick: 0.25s → 0.1s[/*]		[*]Projectile speed: 30 m/s → 35 m/s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Soul Shaker has fallen out of favor as a viable defensive tank option in ZvZs. To help players better protect their team’s flanks, its root duration has been increased to match its area duration.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Soul Shaker (Grailseeker)	[list]		[*]Area duration: 4s → 3.5s[/*]		[*]Root duration: 3s → 3.5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Soulscythe has remained a niche shotcaller option in ZvZs, so its standtime has been reduced to make it feel more responsive and return control to its users more quickly.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Tornado (Soulscythe)	[list]		[*]Standtime: 0.7s → 0.4s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Spears[/b]
[quote][i]While Cripple has been a good tool to counter swords, adjustments have been made to help it feel powerful in more situations, more often.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Cripple (all Spears)	[list]		[*]Damage type: magical → physical[/*]		[*]Added: Auto-attack speed is reduced by 25% for 4s[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 20s → 18s[/*]		[*]Move speed buff duration: 5s → 4s[/*]		[*]No longer gives bonus damage when purging a sprint[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Swords[/b]
[quote][i]The previous buff to Blade Cyclone has been reverted, as it became the default option and outperformed all other options, particularly for Carving and Infinity Blade players.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Blade Cyclone (all Swords)	[list]		[*]1 charge damage: 70 → 60[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]War Gloves[/b]
[quote][i]To help Ursine Maulers find more success, the damage reduction from a previous nerf, originally paired with a significant resilience penetration decrease, has been reverted.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Hundred Striking Fists (Ursine Maulers)	[list]		[*]Damage per tick: 32.4 → 36 (vs players)[/*]		[*]Delayed damage: 27 → 30 (per stack)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Some of Infernal Boulder’s instant damage has been moved into its DoT component, to both reward skilled players for hitting all three boulders and to limit its effectiveness when stacked in ZvZs.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Infernal Boulder (Hellfire Hands)	[list]		[*]1st boulder damage: 199.5 → 177[/*]		[*]2nd boulder damage: 133 → 126[/*]		[*]3rd boulder damage: 66.5 → 76[/*]		[*]DoT tick damage: 14 → 18[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Armors[/b]
[quote][i]To make Protection of the Fiends more risky, its negative resistance penalty has been increased, making it more important to combo with allies or cancel the channel early.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Protection of the Fiends (Demon Armor)	[list]		[*]Caster resistance reduction: 0.34 → 0.37[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Taunt has been simplified to apply the same effects regardless of the selected target, while increasing its value as a short-cooldown damage option for Plate Armor users.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Taunt (all Plate Armors)	[list]		[*]No longer distinguishes between target types[/*]		[*]Bonus Damage vs All: 10% → 20%[/*]		[*]Defense vs Players: -10% → -20%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Capes[/b]
[quote][i]The Fort Sterling Cape has had its cooldown significantly reduced at higher tiers to justify its price increase and enable players to rely on it as a consistent cleanse option.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Untouchable (Fort Sterling Cape)	[list]		[*]Base cooldown: 139 → 168[/*]		[*]Cooldown reduction per 100 IP: 3s → 8s (118s → 112s at 700 IP, 91s → 40s at 1600 IP)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Potions[/b]
[quote][i]Invisibility Potion’s damage reduction has not been significant enough or lasted long enough to give opponents a fair chance to react to fully undetectable engages. Damage reduction has now been changed to reduce all damage dealt by players, making it harder to bypass the penalty with stacked damage buffs. The effect also lingers for 2 seconds after exiting stealth, rather than starting from the moment of use, giving players a chance to fight back if revealed early.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Invisibility Potion	[list]		[*]Ability damage reduction → Damage vs All reduction (-50% value is unchanged)[/*]		[*]Duration: Fixed time on cast → While Invisible, and remaining for 2s once revealed[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Other[/b][list]	[*]Judgment (Lightcaller) visuals have been updated to be more readable in large-scale fights[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Spell Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Spinning Blades (Dual Swords): Fixed issue where immunity to Crowd Control persisted after impact[/*]	[*]Holy Beam (Holy Staffs): Fixed issue where stacks persisted after casting was interrupted[/*]	[*]Razor Cut (Bear Paws): Fixed issue where the same enemy could be hit multiple times[/*]	[*]Time Freeze (Great Arcane Staffs): Fixed issue where frozen enemies could still receive healing from lifesteal effects[/*][/list]
[b]UI Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where the Arena queue timer would not reappear if a player canceled the match invitation[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where combat logs in the Death Recap would be overwritten by new actions performed on the player when switching tabs in the UI[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the ‘Take All’ button on the Marketplace would reset filters without resetting the filter text	[list]		[*]The text is now reset along with the filters[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where main dynamic action button on the virtual controller could appear to remain in motion after use[/*]	[*][CONTROLLER] Fixed issue where ‘Select Next Party Member’ keybinding option was missing from the Settings menu[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed Faction Warfare “connection bug”; it is now always possible to capture Outposts in a region if at least one adjacent frontline or backline region is owned by your Faction[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where it was possible for players to buy their own items at the Marketplace[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Rock Giant’s Aspect would not pursue players or use melee attacks[/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog: Rogue Frontier Patch 4
notes.notes:
[quote][i]This patch improves the Conqueror's Challenge reward system with better tracking and reward claiming for past seasons. It also includes combat balance changes, bug fixes, and gameplay improvements.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Changes[/h3]

[b]Conqueror’s Challenge Changes[/b]

A new Conqueror’s Challenge History Tab has been added, allowing players to track their past seasons and claim rewards more easily.[list]	[*]Players can now view their stats and rewards from previous seasons by selecting them from a dropdown menu[/*][/list]Within this new tab, rewards can be claimed through an improved UI:[list]	[*]Conqueror’s Chest rewards now appear as a list of claimable items instead of a single chest	[list]		[*]Players can claim items individually or use ‘Claim All’ to collect as much as their inventory space allows[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Knight’s Vows and Avatars are sent directly to the inventory when claimed[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b][list]	[*]Personal and Guild tabs within a Guild Bank are now visually distinguished[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Frost Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]To increase the consistency of Arctic Volley, each icicle has been adjusted to slow all targets hit, making it easier to land multiple volleys.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Arctic Volley (Arctic Staff)	[list]		[*]Slow per hit: 10% for 1s (stacks up to 6 times)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]As Holy Staff has been a dominant option in the 2v2 meta, the energy cost of Desperate Prayer has been increased to make energy denial a possible counter.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Desperate Prayer (Holy Staff)	[list]		[*]Energy cost: 12 → 15[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Nature Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Since Druidic Staff has fallen out of the meta following previous nerfs, the additional cooldown for recasting Spiritual Seed has now been removed to increase its healing output in group play.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Spiritual Seed (Druidic Staff)	[list]		[*]Recast cooldown: 25s → 20s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shapeshifter Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Bloodmoon continues to be a problem for larger groups to deal with. To give enemies a better chance at bursting a Werewolf down, their max health while transformed has been reduced.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Werewolf Transformation (Bloodmoon Staff)	[list]		[*]Transformation health: 1100 → 1000[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Swords[/b]

[quote][i]Infinity Blade’s popularity has increased since Limit Breaker stopped consuming its damage buff. To reduce its brawling power somewhat, its long buff duration has been reduced.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Limitbreaker (Infinity Blade)	[list]		[*]Damage buff duration: 7s → 5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Helmets[/b]

[quote][i]Smokebomb has been adjusted to no longer silence party members, as this behavior was difficult to control and led to frustrating gameplay experiences.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Smokebomb (Hellion Hood)	[list]		[*]No longer silences group members[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b]

[quote][i]The stun duration for Crush Charge – a highly telegraphed ability – has been increased to make it more rewarding, especially since it takes the place of a traditional mobility option.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Crush Charge (Duskweaver Boots)	[list]		[*]Stun: 2.35s → 2.5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Capes[/b]

[quote][i]Capes that primarily scale their cooldowns with Item Power have not provided enough value to warrant their increasing cost per tier. With significantly shorter cooldowns at higher tiers, these capes can now become a more reliable build component.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Berserk (Keeper Cape)	[list]		[*]Base cooldown: 112.5 → 150[/*]		[*]Cooldown reduction: 2.5s → 7.5s (95s → 98s at 700 IP, 73s → 30s at 1600 IP)[/*]		[*]Buff duration: 6s → 5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Devious Trap (Heretic Cape)	[list]		[*]Base cooldown: 112.5 → 150[/*]		[*]Cooldown reduction: 2.5s → 7s (95s → 101s at 700 IP, 73s → 38s at 1600 IP)[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Mark of the Raven (Morgana Cape)	[list]		[*]Cooldown reduction: 3.1s → 6s (98s → 78s at 700 IP, 70s → 24s at 1600 IP)[/*]		[*]Buff duration: 8s → 5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog: Rogue Frontier Patch 3
notes.notes:
[quote][i]This patch brings important refinements and bug fixes but primarily focuses on combat balance changes.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Changes[/h3]

[b]Destiny Board Changes[/b][list]	[*]The Reaver line bonus has been reworked to prevent unintended interactions with spells and other effects	[list]		[*]Bonus defense/damage vs mobs should now work as intended for higher-tier enemies[/*]		[*]Armor and magic resistance reduction effects are now more effective against higher-tier enemies[/*]		[*]Aside from these interactions, there should be no noticeable difference when fighting mobs[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Corrupted and Solo Randomized Dungeon Changes[/b]

[quote][i]With the introduction of the Gold Market Stabilization system, Common Chests that typically dropped a single Bag of Silver could sometimes be empty. To prevent this without altering the stabilization system, we have moved Silver from Common Chests to higher-value chests, and replaced them with Tomes of Insight to ensure a guaranteed reward.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Common Chests now drop Beginner’s Tomes of Insight instead of Bags of Silver[/*]	[*]Uncommon, Rare, and Legendary Chests now contain more Bags of Silver          [/*][/list]
[b]UI Changes[/b][list]	[*]To standardize Cast Time and Cooldown Rate modification values, they now always display a positive value to indicate longer durations and a negative value to indicate reductions	[list]		[*]The item stat 'Cast Time Reduction' has been renamed to 'Cast Time' to align with this system[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Reduced chat frequency for /HCE, /LFG, /TR, and /REC by increasing message cooldown from 30 seconds to 2 minutes[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Arcane Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Evensong has offered powerful offensive utility but is almost always used with plate armor. Its base damage has been increased to help players who want to lean more into being a DPS threat.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Dark Sphere (Evensong)	[list]		[*]Damage: 100 → 112[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Axes[/b]

[quote][i]Axe players in ZvZs have been overperforming, frequently hitting more than 10 enemies. To address this, the damage and complexity of Raging Blades have been reduced.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Raging Blades (all Axes)	[list]		[*]Removed: Targets within 2 meters take no damage[/*]		[*]Damage per tick: 26 → 22[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Hammers[/b]

[quote][i]Giant Steps has been far from its previously overwhelming state. A portion of its slowing aura has been restored to reinforce Forge Hammers as a tanky disruptor.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Giant Steps (Forge Hammers)	[list]		[*]Slow: 20% → 35%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Great Holy Staff has been underperforming, so part of its resistance increase has been restored.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Holy Explosion (Great Holy Staff)	[list]		[*]Resistance increase: 0.12 → 0.16[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]To give Lifetouch Staff a unique role, Holy Touch’s target is now immune to Crowd Control for the channel's duration (unless self-targeting). In addition, its range has been increased to improve its reliability in modern Albion.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Holy Touch (Lifetouch Staff)	[list]		[*]Added: Target is immune to all crowd-control (unless self-targeting)[/*]		[*]Range: 6m → 9m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Spears[/b]

[quote][i]Fling has struggled to find success. To improve its effectiveness, its stand time and cooldown have been reduced, making it easier to confirm an Impaler hit.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Fling (Glaive)	[list]		[*]Standtime: 0.85s → 0.6s[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 20s → 18s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Swords[/b]

[quote][i]Swords already have strong chase potential due to their passive movement speed bonuses. To balance this, Heroic Strike’s above-average range has been reduced.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Heroic Strike (all Swords)	[list]		[*]Range: 4m → 3.5m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]War Gloves[/b]

[quote][i]Fleet Footwork has provided War Gloves users with a solid mobility option while also serving as an exceptional DPS tool. Its damage output has been reduced to bring it more in line with alternatives.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Fleet Footwork (all War Gloves)	[list]		[*]Auto-attack damage buff: 150% → 125%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Armors[/b]

[quote][i]Ambush has remained a top-tier damage boost while also offering great defensive capabilities. Its maximum damage bonus has been reduced to allow other aggressive chest armors to be more competitive.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ambush (Assassin Jacket)	[list]		[*]Damage buff per stack: 4% → 5%[/*]		[*]Max buff stacks: 10 → 6 (max damage bonus 40% → 30%)[/*]		[*]Stack rate: 0.5s → 1s (time to max stacks: unchanged)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b]

[quote][i]A few underused shoe abilities with restrictive conditions and mobility trade-offs have been improved. [/i][/quote][quote][i]Giant’s cooldown and uptime have been adjusted to make Guardian Boots a more available defensive option.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Giant (Guardian Boots)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 60s → 40s[/*]		[*]Duration: 8s → 6s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Mark of Sacrifice, Shield Charge, and Swift Cut have been standardized to a 15m range with below-average cooldowns, as their target requirements have been too limiting.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Mark of Sacrifice (Hellion Shoes)	[list]		[*]Range: 12m → 15m[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Shield Charge (Knight Boots)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 20s → 18s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Swift Cut (Assassin Shoes)	[list]		[*]Range: 11m → 15m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Spell Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Holy Beam (Holy Staffs) no longer adds a spell effect icon to the target’s buff bar[/*]	[*]Hamstring (Swords): Fixed issue where the tooltip displayed an incorrect cooldown[/*]	[*]Ambush (Assassin Jacket): The damage buff can now be purged and no longer persists if the caster does not deal damage within the first 7 seconds[/*][/list]
[b]UI Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where icons on the Region Map could duplicate over time[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where some tooltips would remain visible and follow the cursor[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Medium Treasure Chests were not visible on the map for players in a neighboring region[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where Elite Cursed Harvester did not count towards the Albion Journal mission ‘Defeat any Reaper or Harvester’[/*]	[*]Various additional graphical, animation, terrain, audio, UI, and localization fixes[/*][/list]

notes.title: Dev Talk: Development Update Feb 2025
notes.notes:
The [b]Rogue Frontier[/b] update launched in early February, and it’s made Albion’s open world busier than ever, with players diving into Smuggler’s Dens and planting their Kill Trophies all over the world. In this new Dev Talk, Head of Production [b]Moritz Bokelmann[/b] looks at the impact of that update and offers a taste of what we’re cooking up for you next.

[previewyoutube=9YDq8y3U5xs?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Rogue Frontier[/h3]
The Rogue Frontier update has so far been a success, and activity levels are looking good.
[list]	[*]The [b]Bank Overview[/b], [b]Personal Island Chests[/b], and [b]Kill Trophies[/b] have all been very popular[/*]	[*][b]Smuggler’s Dens[/b] and [b]Smuggler’s Activities[/b] have made the Outlands more lively than ever[/*]	[*]Solo players and all sizes of groups are thriving in the [b]open world[/b][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/16fbe461a7ef4ff8e855aeecea195fdec138cca9.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Albion’s Next Update[/h3]
Work is underway on the next major game update, which will focus on instanced PvP and the new player experience.

[b]Instanced PvP Content[/b]
[list]	[*]The next update will address community concerns with [b]Corrupted Dungeons [/b]and [b]Hellgates[/b]	[list]		[*]Additionally, these will be made directly [b]accessible from major cities[/b][/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]A [b]new PvP dungeon[/b] aimed at 2-3 player groups will be introduced	[list]		[*]This is inspired by Knightfall Abbey, but with fewer exits, deeper levels, and greater consequences[/*]		[*]Players can weigh up whether to escape with their loot, or dive deeper for more rewards[/*]	[/list][/*][/list][url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1d06279be159d411d7848b5b951b95f9472d13a5.jpeg][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/6bd1715d7c1c8c105dd88f24a2fc721e43fe6ed8.jpeg[/img][/url]

[b]Early Game Improvements[/b]
[list]	[*]The next update also aims to help [b]new players[/b] once they’ve finished the tutorial[/*]	[*]A new, dedicated [b]Albion Journal[/b] category will offer structured milestones	[list]		[*]These start simple, and gradually encourage self-sufficiency[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]There will be additional improvements aimed to help [b]early-to-mid level players[/b][/*][/list]The new update will also, of course, bring additional quality-of-life and gameplay improvements, and a new batch of Crystal Weapons.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0f0e4fb9f65b9d4990681ce890db0db85cce1d99.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Looking Further Ahead[/h3]
Beyond the next update, we want to continue improving [b]Royal Continent[/b] gameplay for early-to-mid level players. One particular area of focus will be [b]Faction Warfare[/b]. Faction Warfare is an important and popular feature, but several issues need to be addressed, for instance:
[list]	[*]High repair costs[/*]	[*]Difficulty finding consistent action[/*]	[*]Lack of variety in objectives[/*][/list]We’re currently working on addressing these problems, as well as finding ways to make Faction Warfare activities more rewarding and engaging for everyone.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1c88917cf3eea7781919b0efb3fcc990133f102f.jpeg[/img]

We’ll also have had a few [b]Guild Seasons [/b]with the new, shorter format by then, and we’ll want to take another look at them – in particular to make them more attractive to mid-range guilds, while offering new goals for high-level guilds. We’re eager to hear your suggestions for improvements here and for other parts of the game, so if you have any ideas, let us know by [b]commenting on the video above[/b]!

notes.title: Changelog: Rogue Frontier Patch 2
notes.notes:
[quote][i]This patch adds further polish to the Rogue Frontier update, along with several combat balance changes and additional fixes.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Season Winner Statues Added[/h3]

The statues to honor the winners of Season 25 are now viewable in each servers’ Conqueror’s Hall. Congratulations to the triumphant guilds – PIVAS, Upper Class, and Take Care!

[h3]Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Portal Towns can now be set as Home	[list]		[*]Players now receive a warning when leaving a Portal Town for the Outlands if the Homesick debuff will be triggered[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The cooldown on Hideout Headquarters Boosters has been reduced from 90 days to 60 days, reflecting the new, shorter Guild Season duration	[list]		[*]Guilds which have already used their Booster this season will find its current cooldown also reduced by 30 days after this patch[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Smuggler Coins no longer leave trash when destroyed[/*]	[*]Trash once again has a 100% destruction rate when killed or ejected from the Roads of Avalon (as was the case before the release of Rogue Frontier)[/*]	[*]Added new Albion Journal missions for Kill Trophies in the Social & Guild category, under the Player Interactions subcategory[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Arcane Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Astral Staff had been too powerful in group fights, so Starfall’s damage output has been reduced to bring it more in line with other AoE pressure weapons.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Starfall (Astral Staff)	[list]		[*]Damage per tick: 66 → 63[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Axes[/b]

[quote][i]Razor Cut’s lifesteal effect has been significantly buffed to increase its impact.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Razor Cut (Bear Paws)	[list]		[*]Lifesteal: 10% → 20%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Bows[/b]

[quote][i]Bows had fallen out of the meta following previous nerfs, so a portion of their power has been restored.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Enchanted Quiver (Bow)	[list]		[*]Attack damage increase: 220% → 230%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Daggers[/b]

[quote][i]Twin Slayers have been performing well, but since it never feels good to be unable to recall your daggers due to a lack of energy, the entire energy cost is now paid up front.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ring of Death (Twin Slayers)	[list]		[*]Cast energy cost: 6 → 12[/*]		[*]Recast energy cost: 6 → 0[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Fire Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Infernal Staff has struggled to find its place in the meta. As a result, its fear duration has been increased to allow more set-up time on the primary target, and require enemies to pay more attention to its fiery trail.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Combustion (Infernal Staff)	[list]		[*]Fear duration: 0.75s → 1.25s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shapeshifter Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Fireflash Orb’s damage bonus has been increased to further reward Hellfire Imp players for hitting targets from greater distances.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Fireflash Orb (Hellspawn Staff)	[list]		[*]Bonus damage per tick: 30 → 33[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Swords[/b]

[quote][i]Clarent Blade had been affected by multiple tangential nerfs, so in order to revitalize it, the value of its secondary effect has been increased across all stack counts.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Crescent Slash (Clarent Blade)	[list]		[*]1 stack slow duration: 2s → 2.25s[/*]		[*]2 stack silence duration: 2s → 2.25s[/*]		[*]3 stack damage: 155 → 160[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Soulless Stream’s long casting time has struggled in modern Albion. It has now been reduced slightly, but not so much that it loses its identity.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Soulless Stream (Galatine Pair)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 1.1s → 0.9s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]War Gloves[/b]

[quote][i]Earth Crusher’s knock-up duration has been extended to further highlight its utility. [/i][/quote][list]	[*]Earth Crusher (Ravenstrike Cestus)	[list]		[*]Knock-up duration: 1s → 1.2s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]In addition to some hitbox and hit detection improvements, Shockwave's damage has been significantly increased to better accommodate mid-range fighting builds.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Shockwave (all Gloves)	[list]		[*]Damage: 106 → 122[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Helmets[/b]

[quote][i]While Firebreath is a popular solo PvE item, its damage has been increased to improve its success in PvP encounters.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Firebreath (Mage Cowl)	[list]		[*]Damage per tick: 33 → 36[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]All Gathering Caps now have the Emergency Shield spell to help gatherers remove lingering DoTs before consuming an Invisibility Potion or mounting up.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]All Gathering Caps	[list]		[*]Additional ability: Emergency Shield (same as the Guardian Helmet ability)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b]

[quote][i]While the adoption of Demon Boots following its previous buffs has been satisfying, they now offer too much mobility at higher health percentages. Therefore, their buff duration and move speed bonus per stack have been reduced slightly.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Vengeful Sprint (Demon Boots)	[list]		[*]Move speed bonus per stack: 25% → 22%[/*]		[*]Duration: 6s → 5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Mounts[/b]

[quote][i]Toxic Reaction has been removed, as it had the potential to put the mount's rider into combat unintentionally, hindering their ability to flee.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Toxic Reaction (Pest Lizard) has been removed[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Spell Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Dodge (all T4+ Shoes): Fixed issue where immunity could be purged[/*]	[*]Interrupt (Swords): Fixed issue where the buff icon did not match the spell icon[/*]	[*]Toxic Cloud (Pest Lizard), Energy Cloud (Tower Chariot), Boulder Crash (Earthrune Staff), Sky’s Fury (Skystrider Bow), and Infernal Boulder (Hellfire Hands) now have more accurate spell indication areas[/*]	[*]Fixed several spell tooltips with more accurate descriptions[/*][/list]
[b]UI Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where sorting options in the Guild Rights Management UI behaved incorrectly[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where filtering the Bank Overview by all tiers would filter out all tiers, rather than including them[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where several categories in the Rankings UI were not displaying in the correct order[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where some T3 weapons had their abilities displayed in the wrong order on the Item Details UI[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Hellion Hood spells were displayed in the wrong order on the Item Details UI[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where hovering over an item’s Average Price or Market History at the Marketplace would not display the exact amount[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where different travel costs could be displayed for the same journey, depending on the UI[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the region map would not display City Plot details if opened while changing regions[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Arena Match invitation pop-up could be closed with the ESC key without canceling the match, preventing entry[/*]	[*][CONTROLLER] Fixed issue where Marketplace category filters could not be changed[/*][/list]
[b]Albion Journal Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where missions to free Captured Smugglers would not grant progress to party members[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where missions to defeat Ghouls and Brawlers did not count all types[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where defeating Archers within Avalonian Dungeons counted towards the wrong Albion Journal mission[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where items recovered to a city bank could not be accessed from a corresponding island bank[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Smuggler’s Den and Hideout Fame buffs could stack[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where having an Awakened Item in equipment or inventory would trigger spell cooldowns when changing regions[/*]	[*]Various additional graphical, animation, terrain, audio, UI, and localization fixes[/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog: Rogue Frontier Patch 1

notes.title: Changelog: Rogue Frontier Update
notes.notes:
[quote][i]This update expands the Outlands with the introduction of Smuggler’s Dens, the Smuggler’s Network, and the Smuggler Faction, providing new tools and activities for solo and small group players. [h3]Gold Market Stabilization[/h3]

With this update, we are introducing a self-regulating economic system to the game that will help stabilize the price of Gold and Premium when purchased with Silver. This system automatically makes minor adjustments on each server as needed, to gradually stabilize prices without the need for large-scale economic intervention.

As a result, players may notice changes in the amount of Silver received for some activities – such as killing mobs –, and in the Silver cost for certain actions. These changes will be quite subtle, however, and will slow down over the long term, thus avoiding any economic shocks.

[/quote][list]	[*]Threatening Smash (all Maces)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 6s → 4s[/*]		[*]Damage: 146 → 135[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Nature Staffs[/b][quote]Thorn Growth is one of the strongest Q-slot damage abilities against multiple enemies in PvE, on a weapon line that also offers very high sustain. Its area damage has therefore been reduced against mobs, while its damage output and usability has been increased in PvP.
[/quote][list]	[*]Thorn Growth (all Nature Staffs)	[list]		[*]Damage vs mobs: 30 → 24[/*]		[*]Damage vs players: 25 → 30[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Quarterstaffs[/b][quote]Forceful Swing had been able to shut down builds that rely on auto-attacks, but otherwise unreliable. Its duration has therefore been reduced, but the power of its debuff increased significantly to allow Quarterstaff tank players to better protect their allies.
[/quote][list]	[*]Forceful Swing (all Quarterstaffs)	[list]		[*]Damage reduction: 20% → 50%[/*]		[*]Duration 8s → 5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote]Mystic Rocks no longer removes healing-over-time effects as a separate mechanic. [/quote][list]	[*]Adapting Matter (all Shapeshifter Staffs)	[list]		[*]Energy cost: 16 → 10[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote]Tether Shift’s shield duration has been extended to give its users a longer protection window.
[/quote][list]	[*]Tether Shift (all Shapeshifter Staffs)	[list]		[*]Shield Duration: 1.5s → 2s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Swords[/b][quote]Blade Cyclone’s Heroic Stack removal creates a significant cost, so its damage output has been increased to justify this.
[/quote][list]	[*]Blade Cyclone (all Swords)	[list]		[*]1 stack damage: 60 → 70[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote]Swords have high mobility, and Limitbreaker adds another unconditional move speed buff that can be used to engage and disengage. This made its overall mobility somewhat too effective in the Mists, so that buff has been reduced.
[/quote][list]	[*]Limitbreaker (Infinity Blade)	[list]		[*]Move speed buff while channeling: 40% → 30%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote]Heroic Cleave has had its hit delay reduced to improve its feel and hit more reliably.
[/quote][list]	[*]Heroic Cleave (all Swords)	[list]		[*]Hit delay: 0.3s → 0.2s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Potions[/b][quote]To ensure Poison Potions are not too powerful as ganking tools in combination with the new Smuggler Cape, their damage against mounted players has been halved.
[/quote][list]	[*]Poison Potions	[list]		[*]Damage against mounted players reduced by 50%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

[b]Diminishing Return Changes[/b][quote]Increased Diminishing Returns have helped solo players against multiple enemies, but in large-scale battles where cleanses are widely available, this change nerfed crowd control-focused tank builds more than intended. To make these tanks more viable in large-scale fights, cleanses now significantly reduce Diminishing Returns, resulting in longer crowd control durations, especially in fights with multiple cleanses available.
[/quote][list]	[*]Cleansing Crowd Control now partially resets the Diminishing Returns value of the removed CC effect, setting it to 0.3[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Spell Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Requite (Armor of Valor): Channel effects can no longer be purged[/*]	[*]Intoxicating Breath (Venom Basilisk): Fixed issue where defense debuff was not removed by debuff cleanses[/*]	[*]Fear Aura (Fiend Robe): Affected targets now display an icon to show their immunity to further Fear Aura[/*]	[*]Enigma Blade (Arcane Staff): Fixed issue where its effect did not match the size of its indicator[/*]	[*]Crescent Slash (Clarent Blade): Fixed issue where its effect did not match the size of its indicator[/*][/list]
[b]UI Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where the Completed Transactions tab would reset to default when a buy order was fulfilled during a search[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where freshly spawned treasures and resources would not display on an already opened Travel Mode map[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Upgrade UI would not reopen if closed by clicking the X icon while stationary[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where HUD elements were not clickable with the Albion Journal open[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Kill Details UI displayed incorrect item salvage values[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Rankings UI would display incorrect values[/*]	[*]Fixed issues where duplicate entries appeared in some Albion Journal mission checklists[/*]	[*]Fixed a regression where the default sorting for resources (and some other item types) would handle enchantment levels incorrectly[/*][/list]

[i]For the complete list of changes, see our website: [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog][b]https://albiononline.com/changelog[/b][/url][/i]

notes.title: Big Changes are Coming with Season 26!
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cce8b5e9ab7439b9ba58a0be0f6be676744087ce.jpeg[/img]

With the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/rogue-frontier][b]Rogue Frontier[/b][/url] update arriving February 3, the Outlands are poised to be more vibrant than ever. This sets the stage for a faster-paced Guild Season, where every guild member, from fierce warriors to diligent gatherers, has a critical role in the pursuit of glory. Let's dive into some of the changes coming with Season 26.

[h3]Guild Season Changes[/h3]
Beginning with Season 26, seasons will be reduced to [b]59 days[/b], with a faster-paced, more intense dynamic. Major content updates will now arrive every four months instead of three, allowing for two full seasons within the same update cycle.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8cc626cbb8ec775c91887cf84d4e43687666bd54.png[/img]

Territories will reset [b]three times[/b] during a season: at the start, in the middle, and on the final weekend. The mid-season Invasion Day introduces the [b]double point-scoring [/b]period, meaning this high-stakes phase now covers half the season (previously it was a third). This heightens the need for sharp strategic planning, with greater opportunity for guilds to dramatically change the course of a season. Off-seasons will alternate between twelve and five days.

[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3]
Several balance adjustments accompany the shorter season:
[list]	[*][b]Might requirements[/b] for Guild Challenges are being reduced[/*]	[*]Territories will generate [b]50% more Fortification Points[/b] each day[/*]	[*]Season Points are being rebalanced:	[list]		[*]Significant boosts to [b]PvE[/b], [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b], and [b]gathering[/b], encouraging open-world exploration and enhancing the value of non-PvP contributions[/*]		[*][b]Energy Crystals[/b] will offer 20% less Season Points, to account for the double scoring phase now covering half the season[/*]		[*]The overall [b]Season Point[/b] output should remain much the same, so Headquarters Hideout requirements are unchanged[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]Might, Favor and Loot from [b]Crystal Creatures[/b] is being doubled, but they will respawn 50% less frequently​[/*]	[*][b]Crystal Arena[/b] promotion and demotion values are being adjusted for faster rank progression[/*]	[*][b]Conqueror's Challenge Chest [/b]values are being scaled in proportion to the reduced season length[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8f3026da394dba42efdf4c4e7e89f7a28f8c8cc0.jpeg[/img]

Full details can be found in this [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/207076-Season-26-Schedules/][b]Forum post[/b][/url], and the upcoming patchnotes accompanying the launch of Rogue Frontier.

[h3]Smuggler Activities and Challenges[/h3]
The Rogue Frontier update introduces the [b]Smuggler Faction[/b] to the Outlands, giving solo players and smaller guilds new opportunities to earn Might and Favor by freeing captured smugglers and recovering crates from ambushed wagons.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/275895a4059e4c2e3fdf0b547f82ecb3ae2a934f.jpeg[/img]

These activities contribute to a new [b]Guild Challenge[/b] category, offering fresh opportunities for guild members to support their teams.

[h3]Get Ready for the Action[/h3]
Guild Seasons lie at the heart of Albion's competitive scene, where guilds vie for territories, Season Points, and top rankings. Participating allows you to contribute to your guild’s success through diverse activities – even if PvP isn’t your focus, there are plenty of ways to help secure rewards and climb the ranks. Ready to get started? Use the [url=https://albiononline.com/guides/article/Guild-Finder+106][b]Guild Finder[/b][/url] to connect with a guild and embark on your journey to guild glory.

These changes promise a faster, action-packed season, keeping the competition intense and every moment engaging. Good luck, and may your efforts lead your guild to glory. See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Changelog: Horizons Patch 4
notes.notes:
[quote][i]This patch follows up on previous combat balance changes, enhances some less prominent weapons and abilities, and introduces additional changes and fixes.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Dropped banners no longer reduce Fortification protection[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Stack and Sort buttons have been restored to the main Inventory menu[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Bows[/b]

[quote][i]Wailing Bow has been underperforming in ZvZs despite being the only ability with custom AoE escalation. We have increased the damage escalation per target hit to bring Wailing Bow back to its glory days.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Demon Arrow (Wailing Bow)	[list]		[*]Damage to 1st target: 189 → 189 (unchanged)[/*]		[*]Damage to 2nd target: 236 → 256[/*]		[*]Damage to 3rd target: 283 → 323[/*]		[*]Damage to 4th or more targets: 331 → 391[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Cursed Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]While Dark Matter has high damage potential, it has been too easy to counter. We have decreased its cooldown to improve reliability but have also increased the energy cost to keep the ability's spam potential in check.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Dark Matter (all Cursed Staffs)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 20s → 15s[/*]		[*]Energy cost: 10 → 16[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Sanctify’s unique ability to remove hostile ground effects created by enemies has proven less impactful than anticipated. As a result, we have increased its value as a traditional healing weapon.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Sanctify (Exalted Staff)	[list]		[*]Healing: 122 → 138[/*]		[*]Range: 10m → 12m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Maces[/b]

[quote][i]We have given Dreadstorm Monarch’s Eye of the Storm additional damage and resistance reduction to help it command the respect it deserves.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Eye of the Storm (Dreadstorm Monarch)	[list]		[*]1st & 2nd cast damage: 39 → 50[/*]		[*]Resistance reduction: 0.12 → 0.15[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Vendetta’s cast time has been significantly reduced to help Camlann players hit their intended targets more accurately without requiring additional setup.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Vendetta (Camlann Mace)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 0.7s → 0.25s[/*]		[*]Stand time: 0.7s → 0.2s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Nature Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]The previous changes to Soul Link have been a step in the right direction, giving Iron Root players a legitimate reason to use the Ally/Enemy effect. However, with the increase in power, the reduction to the Ally/Ally effect was too conservative. The intent is to maintain the Ally/Ally effect as the powerful and consistent option it has always been.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Soul Link (Ironroot Staff)	[list]		[*]Ally/Ally healing transfer percentage: 50% → 75%[/*]		[*]2nd cast stand time: 1s → 0s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Quarterstaffs[/b]

[quote][i]We have added more value to the 1st and 2nd casts of Phantom Twin to help the Phantom Twinblade perform more effectively as a DPS Quarterstaff.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Phantom Twin (Phantom Twinblade)	[list]		[*]Damage per tick: 36 → 41[/*]		[*]Slow: 10% → 15%[/*]		[*]Added missing energy costs: 5/5/7[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Separator is emerging as an effective tool for singling out a target. To help it succeed in that role, we have increased its single-target damage.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Separator (all Quarterstaffs)	[list]		[*]Damage to target: 125 → 157[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]War Gloves[/b]

[quote][i]Ravenstrikes have become a more viable option now that players are no longer at risk of dying without the ability to stop their own damage. Due to this increased consistency, their damage and speed while channeling have been reduced to give enemies more room to react and recover.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Earth Crusher (Ravenstrike Cestus)	[list]		[*]Self-slow: 25% → 40%[/*]		[*]0 charge damage: 175 → 155[/*]		[*]1 charge damage: 185 → 165[/*]		[*]2 charge damage: 195 → 175[/*]		[*]3 charge damage: 205 →  185[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Armors[/b]

[quote][i]Following recent buffs, we are happy with the adoption of Armor of Valor as a powerful defensive option with unique utility. However, tank items should not provide high CC, strong defenses, and significant damage in a single ability. The amount of damage it could return, particularly in 1v1 fights, was too high.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Requite (Armor of Valor)	[list]		[*]Damage: 46 → 31[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b]

[quote][i]Mage Sandals have fallen out of favor in modern Albion, so we have added a new resistance buff upon landing. Additionally, changes have been made to make it harder for enemies to predict the exact landing location.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Delayed Teleport (Mage Sandals)	[list]		[*]Now increases resistances by 0.2 for 2s after landing[/*]		[*]No longer shows the exact ending position VFX to enemies[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Mounts[/b]

[quote][i]Tanks have been using Morgana Ravens as an additional CC option, overwhelming large groups of players by chaining long-duration fears. We have made changes to Raven Scream to address these issues.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Raven Scream (Morgana Raven)	[list]		[*]Now gives feared targets immunity to consecutive Raven fears for 15s[/*]		[*]No longer inherits the rider’s bonus CC duration[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Reactive Scream has been removed as it had the potential to put the mount's rider into combat uncontrollably, hindering their ability to flee.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Reactive Scream (Morgana Raven)	[list]		[*]Removed[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Potions[/b]

[quote][i]The recent change to potion swapping has made using Fish Bait inconvenient, so we have changed the way it is consumed.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Fish Bait (all Tiers)	[list]		[*]Fish Bait is now consumable from inventory, rather than as a potion[/*]		[*]If a character had Fish Bait equipped in the potion slot prior to this patch, this will need to be removed before it can be used from the inventory[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Spell Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Vengeful Sprint (Demon Boots): Fixed issue where the active charge count VFX did not display correctly[/*]	[*]Hellfire Potion: Fixed issue where it reduced healing cast instead of healing received[/*][/list]
[b]Salvaging Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where certain items would have a lower salvage value than intended[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where non-salvageable items would display a salvage value[/*][/list]
[b]Mob Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where Keeper Bear and Giant mobs could knock players out of combat range, causing them to reset[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Morgana Fang boss would stand still while casting Splitting Claw[/*][/list]
[b]Albion Journal Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Restored progress towards the mission ‘Have the offspring of every type of animal’ that was lost with Horizons Patch 2[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Deliver a Weakened Wisp in Lethal Mists’ could not be completed in Greater Mists[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Directly sell 9999 preferred luxury goods to Caerleon’ would only count those sold in one of Caerleon’s Marketplaces[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Raise a Tier 7 Mount’ could be completed by raising a pig[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Get your very own island’ could be completed by having any type of island in your island list[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where ‘Kill or assist in killing players within one minute’ missions would not count assists[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the mission ‘Have 2 offspring from a single horse’ could not be completed[/*]	[*]Changed mission ‘Reach Guild Challenge Level 100 with your Guild’ to ‘Reach Guild Challenge Level 99 with your Guild’[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Various additional graphical, animation, terrain, audio, UI, and localization fixes[/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog: Horizons Patch 3
notes.notes:
[quote][i]This patch further refines the Horizons update with tweaks and fixes. We are also reintroducing developer notes for Combat Balance changes to provide more context for these adjustments.[/i]

[b]Note for Android users: With this patch, we are rolling back the recent platform migration introduced with the Horizons Update. This will again require a larger-than-normal installation. If you experience space issues, please uninstall the Albion Online app before performing a clean install.[/b][/quote]
[h3]Changes and Improvements[/h3]

[b]Albion Journal Missions[/b][list]	[*]Collect 20 offspring in 10 minutes on a single island → Have offspring from 10 different animals[/*][/list]
[b]HUD Editor[/b][list]	[*]Default Spells and their Transformation Spells are now always displayed	[list]		[*]If Vanity Spells are in use, they will switch to the default spells while the HUD Editor is open[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Dynamic Encampments[/b][list]	[*]Lair Maps in Solo Encampments are now hidden until the Encampment's objective has been completed by a player. Once completed, the Lair Map becomes visible to all players	[list]		[*]This change does not affect Lair Maps in Group Encampments[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b][list]	[*][Mobile] Adjusted Custom Button Slot hotkey assignments:	[list]		[*]‘Recording Mode,’ ‘Walk Up,’ ‘Walk Down,’ ‘Walk Right,’ and ‘Walk Left’ can no longer be assigned to custom buttons[/*]		[*]‘World Map’ and ‘Destiny Board’ can now be assigned[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Arcane Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Frazzle has been outshined by Enigma Blade in DPS arcane builds, even in smaller group fights. We’ve increased its burst damage to make it more competitive, even if allies don’t take advantage of the powerful damage-amplifying component.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Frazzle (all Arcane Staffs)	[list]		[*]Now reduces enemy defenses before dealing damage[/*]		[*]Damage: 103.11 → 125[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Daggers[/b]

[quote][i]Bridled Fury players have struggled to find success in ZvZs, so we’ve reintroduced some resilience penetration to make Merciless Finish live up to its name.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Bridled Fury	[list]		[*]Resilience penetration: 30% → 35%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Frost Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]Ice Storm hasn’t been very popular, despite its high damage potential. We've reduced its travel distance to boost area denial and threat to keep chokes covered longer. We've also reduced its cast and stand times to make its use smoother.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ice Storm (Glacial Staff)	[list]		[*]Cast time: 1s → 0.5s[/*]		[*]Stand time: 0.5s → 0.3s[/*]		[*]Travel distance: 18m → 12m (1.2m/s → 0.8 m/s)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b]

[quote][i]We’ve smoothed out Sacred Pulse’s animation and stand time for a better experience in both PvE and PvP.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Sacred Pulse (all Holy Staffs)	[list]		[*]Stand time: 0.5s → 0.3s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]War Gloves[/b]

[quote][i]Counter is outshined by other War Gloves’ W abilities in most contexts. Extending the powerful defense buff should provide more flexibility, allowing players to either disengage more safely or follow up confidently after a successful counter.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Counter (all War Gloves)	[list]		[*]75% defense buff duration: Up to 1.2s → always 2s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Ravenstrikes haven’t been performing well in ZvZs, despite recent buffs. A big downside is that while the damage can be reflected, the caster can't cancel the channel once the ability has started. So we’ve made the ability non-reflectable to make it less likely to die to Demon Armor in ZvZ. Since this makes it significantly more valuable, we’ve reduced its damage slightly.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Earth Crusher (Ravenstrike Cestus)	[list]		[*]No longer reflectable[/*]		[*]0.5s Charge-up damage : 179 → 175[/*]		[*]1s Charge-up damage : 190 → 185[/*]		[*]1.5s Charge-up damage : 202 → 195[/*]		[*]2s Charge-up damage : 214 → 205[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Helmets[/b]

[quote][i]Royal Helmet is currently only used by niche one-shot combo builds. To encourage tank and support use, we’ve significantly reduced its cooldown.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Ballista Support Fire (Royal Helmet)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 40s → 30s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Armors[/b]

[quote][i]Dynamic Defense is strong and popular in ZvZs as both an offensive and defensive tool. Due to the prevalence of reflect, Dynamic Defense has been putting pressure on DPS players to strongly consider only magic damage weapons, as Jacket of Tenacity would do double duty as a strong defense against enemy reflect while also providing a damage boost that brings magic damage users close to the damage levels of cloth armor. We’ve reduced the maximum damage potential, but allowed players to choose the optimal defensive buff without losing access to the bonus damage.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Dynamic Defense (Jacket of Tenacity)	[list]		[*]20% bonus damage based on opponents weapon → 10% bonus to all damage types[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b]

[quote][i]Scholar Sandals have fallen short of their promise to be a complete energy solution, so we’ve significantly increased their mana regeneration.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Focused Run (Scholar Sandals)	[list]		[*]Energy per tick: 2.63 → 4 (max 26.3 → 40)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][quote][i]Demon Boots' movement speed was previously reduced to prevent them from being a guaranteed ‘get out of jail free card’. However, since they are now a fairly underused item, we believe they deserve a cooldown in line with other sprints in their class.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Vengeful Sprint (Demon Boots)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 40s → 30s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Potions[/b]

[quote][i]Underutilized potions have been given significant buffs to make them more competitive with their alternatives.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Acid Potion (all Tiers)	[list]		[*]Increased armor and magic resistance reduction by 50%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Cleansing Potion (Tiers 3.1 and above)	[list]		[*]Added 30% movement speed buff for the duration of immunity only if CC or debuffs are removed[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Hellfire Potion (all Tiers)	[list]		[*]Added 35% healing reduction for 3s to all targets hit[/*]		[*]Increased true damage to players and mobs by 25%[/*]		[*]Cooldown 60s → 90s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Sticky Potion (all Tiers)	[list]		[*]Increased damage reduction by 50%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Tornado in a Bottle (all Tiers)	[list]		[*]Radius: 3m → 4m[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 90s → 60s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Misc[/b][list]	[*]Deflecting Spin (all Spears)	[list]		[*]No longer stops moving on usage[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Mimic (all Arcane Staffs)	[list]		[*]No longer queues auto-attacks after casting[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Spell Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where spells that activate at a certain health threshold would not be triggered by damage from potions[/*][*]Fixed issue where mounting up immediately after casting an invisibility spell would not break the invisibility[/*]	[*]Mend Wounds (all Armors): Fixed issue where it would sometimes override movement commands[/*][/list]
[b]Mob Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where Morgana Occultists in the Mists would not spawn bats after using their instant ability[/*][/list]
[b]UI Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where search filters would reset after switching tabs in the Marketplace UI[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where clicking a loadout shared in chat would also move the character to the clicked position[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Building Management UI of some tiers of Guild Halls and Houses could not be opened while inside[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Element Switch button could appear on invalid elements when opening the HUD Editor	[list]		[*]This button is no longer available on Desktop[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where selected emotes in the Key Bindings settings would reset when selecting a Custom Button Slot[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where the on-screen keyboard obstructed the Loadouts dropdown in the Marketplace UI[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where static Randomized Dungeon entrances in the Roads of Avalon would not be visible[/*]	[*]Various additional graphical, animation, terrain, audio, UI, and localization fixes[/*][/list]

notes.title: Changelog: Horizons Patch 2
notes.notes:
[quote][i]This patch makes some adjustments to features introduced with the Horizons update, along with combat balancing and some other important changes and fixes.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Season 24 Winner Statues Unveiled[/h3]

The statues to honor the winners of Season 24 are now viewable in each server’s Conqueror’s Hall. Congratulations to the triumphant guilds!

[h3]New Boss Lairs[/h3]

The Boss Lairs introduced with the Horizons update have been revamped, with new layouts and visuals that better communicate their status as a faction boss hideout.[list]	[*]There is now a new Boss Lair for each faction (Undead, Heretic, Morgana)[/*]	[*]The +200% loot bonus for Boss Lairs has been removed, but now there are 3 chests instead of 1[/*]	[*]Each Boss Lair now contains only the boss, and no other mobs[/*]	[*]Their entrances in the open world have been modified slightly[/*][/list]
[h3]Territory Raiding Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Once a banner has been dropped and channeled, the time until it is destroyed has been reduced from 5 minutes to 3 minutes[/*]	[*]Raid Banners can no longer be used to raid a territory if an older Raid Banner is already active there, or if two banners are spawned simultaneously	[list]		[*]In order to raid a territory with your own banner, older Raid Banners must first be destroyed[/*]		[*]Raid Banners that need to be destroyed first are visually distinguished on the minimap[/*]		[*]If two Raid Banners are raised within 30 seconds of each other, one must be destroyed before the other can be used to raid[/*]		[*]Raid Banners that are raised later on in the battle cannot be used to prevent raiding[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Mob Combat Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Spells and combat behavior have been updated for a number of mobs[/*]	[*]Out-of-combat status in PvE now begins when the mob is killed, rather than when its corpse disappears[/*][/list]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3][list]	[*]As a followup to our Solo Dynamic Encampment loot increases in Patch 1, Group Dynamic Encampments now award less Fame and Objective progress to players if they are solo or in very small groups	[list]		[*]Our intent with this, along with the changes in Patch 1, is to create rewarding gameplay loops both for solo players in Solo Encampments, and for group players in Group Encampments[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Mini roaming mob camps in the open world no longer spawn around World Bosses[/*]	[*]Equipping food or potions now puts all spells on a 10 second cooldown[/*]	[*]Enchantment Level 4 Treasure Resources are now more likely to unlock at Prime Time, rather than spawning at Prime Time and unlocking later[/*]	[*]Certain items are now less expensive to Journey Back or use a S.A.F.E. Portal with	[list]		[*]This mostly affects Randomized Dungeon Maps and Player Island furniture[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The radius of the Crystal Beetle’s ‘Magical Discharge’ spell has been significantly increased[/*]	[*]Hostile player count in safe regions now only counts players explicitly flagged as hostile, not unflagged players in open PvP areas[/*]	[*]Guild Codexes (guilds’ internal descriptions) can now be edited by any member with the ‘Change Guild Logo’ permission[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Axes[/b][list]	[*]Relentless Assault (Crystal Reaper)	[list]		[*]Leaving the area does not end the spell[/*]		[*]Hitting enemies while outside of the area does not reduce weapon ability cooldowns[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Sanctify (Exalted Staff)	[list]		[*]Cast Range: 8m → 10m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

[b]Quarterstaffs[/b][list]	[*]Soul Shaker (Grailseeker)	[list]		[*]Area duration: 3.5s → 4s[/*]		[*]Multicast time window: 3s → 5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shapeshifter Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Werewolf Transformation (Bloodmoon Staff)	[list]		[*]Bloody Roar lifesteal: 6% -] 8% (while below 40% health)		[list]			[*]Lifesteal is now only triggered by Werewolf form abilities[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Distortion (all Shapeshifter Staffs)	[list]		[*]Damage per tick: 54 → 48[/*]		[*]No longer reflectable[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Sinister Swipes (Prowling Staff)	[list]		[*]Range: 4m → 5m[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Spirit Bear Transformation (Primal Staff)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 5s → 10s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Tether Shift (all Shapeshifter Staffs)	[list]		[*]Dash now applies a shield to yourself which absorbs 200 damage for 1.5s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

[b]Mount fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where Phalanx Beetle and Roving Bastion dismount cooldowns were higher than intended	[list]		[*]Cooldowns are now 30 seconds[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Morgana Raven: Fixed issue where Reactive Scream’s fear would ignore forced movement immunity[/*][/list]
[b]UI fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where player count display would sometimes fail to update immediately after changing regions[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where player nametags would sometimes fail to display in safe regions[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where gathering tooltips would not scale correctly with window size[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where chat window size would reset after saving HUD changes[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Bandit Assault countdown would remain on the World Map after changing servers[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where, after an Arena battle, the Player Stats UI would open under the Arena Stats UI when clicking a player’s avatar[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where some UI elements would not function correctly after entering a Randomized Dungeon[/*]	[*]Various fixes and improvements made to the Travel Planner UI[/*][/list]
[b]Other fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where some mobs in the Hardcore Expedition ‘Fistful of Silver’ had higher resistances than intended[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Mists Encampments could sometimes contain mobs that did not count towards completing the quest[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where some Resource Guardians would grant too little Fame[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where rerolling an item’s quality would sometimes incorrectly state that the player’s inventory is full[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where saved frame rate settings would not be applied immediately after starting the game[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Forgotten General mob would perform a slide after its auto-attacks[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where guild logos on the ground of Guild Islands would appear mirrored[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Fixed issue where emotes could not be used with custom hotkeys[/*][/list]
