notes.title: Changelog: Horizons Update
notes.notes:
[quote][i]Horizons reinvigorates the open world with a more dynamic, rewarding, and accessible gameplay experience, as well as enhanced PvE challenges. It also introduces significant quality-of-life improvements, new customization options, and two new Albion Journal categories.[/i][/quote]
[h3]New Open World Objectives[/h3]

New dynamic objectives appear for a limited time across the open world, cycling through active and inactive phases. Players must explore the world to uncover these areas while they're active, as they reveal themselves only when closely approached.

[b]Dynamic Encampments[/b]

Dynamic Encampments are temporary camps settled by mobs from each Faction, who protect valuable Caches:[list]	[*]These Encampments come in two sizes: Solo for individual players, and Group for parties of about 5 players[/*]	[*]Approaching an active Encampment activates a quest for the player or party that finds it, to earn a certain amount of Fame from clearing its mobs:	[list]		[*]Fame requirements scale with an Encampment’s tier and region type		[list]			[*]Quest progress is not affected by Premium or Fame bonuses[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Party progress is shared, as long as members stay within the camp's vicinity		[list]			[*]Fame is divided among party members, meaning larger groups will need to defeat more mobs to complete the quest[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Once a quest has been started, you can leave the region and return to the camp within 60 minutes without losing your progress, provided the camp hasn’t gone inactive[/*]		[*]Camps in Yellow and Red Zones are unrestricted PvP areas[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Clearing an Encampment rewards the player or party with access to a Cache containing valuable loot, as well as Might and Favor	[list]		[*]Loot distribution and rarity is instanced for each player[/*]		[*]If unclaimed, loot is automatically removed from these Caches 10 minutes after a camp is completed[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]When a camp becomes inactive, all mobs, map markers, caches, and quest progress are immediately removed[/*][/list]
[b]Lair Maps[/b]

Lair Maps can spawn in mob camps - including Dynamic Encampments - giving players the chance to uncover a hidden Boss Lair belonging to the corresponding Faction:[list]	[*]These maps are unlocked by defeating Faction mobs within a radius around them, independent of the Dynamic Encampment’s quest[/*]	[*]Boss Lairs correspond to the size of the camp, whether solo or group	[list]		[*]Solo Lair Maps have a higher spawn rate in Solo Dynamic Encampments than in other open-world mob camps[/*]		[*]Group Lair Maps only spawn in Group Encampments[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Once a player interacts with the map, it disappears for everyone else[/*]	[*]Defeating the Lair’s Boss unlocks an additional chest, with its rarity only revealed once completed[/*][/list]
[b]Dynamic Resource Hotspots[/b]

A significantly higher density of resources now spawn in certain areas of the open world for a limited time, shifting locations on a daily basis.     

[b]Open World Coffers[/b]

New Coffers, similar to those found in the Mists, now spawn across the open world. These have a short unlock timer, offering quick opportunities for those nearby during their active phase.

[b]Further Notes[/b]

Hideouts and furniture cannot be placed where open world objectives may appear[list]	[*]Characters, Hideouts, and furniture will be removed from these areas when the update goes live:	[list]		[*]Characters and Hideouts, along with all their contents, will be automatically relocated[/*]		[*]Guilds are able to move their Hideouts for free for up to three days after relocation[/*]		[*]Furniture in the open world will be destroyed[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Outlands Changes[/h3]

[b]S.A.F.E. Portals[/b]

S.A.F.E. Portals can now be found in the Portal Towns of the Outlands, offering solo players a quick teleport to random locations within the Outlands. These portals provide a convenient way to reach the new dynamic objectives in higher-tier regions.[list]	[*]Destinations are random within each Portal Town's assigned section of the Outlands, with no overlap between S.A.F.E. Portal ranges:	[list]		[*]A map overlay highlights the portal’s assigned region, making it easy to identify the destination range[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Portal use requires a fee:	[list]		[*]This fee increases with each subsequent use within a limited time to discourage players from fishing for specific locations[/*]		[*]After using any S.A.F.E. Portal, there is a 30 second cooldown before another portal can be opened[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*] Personal portal mechanics:	[list]		[*]After paying the fee, the player is teleported instantly and appears through a personal S.A.F.E. Portal, receiving a region change protection bubble upon arrival[/*]		[*]The personal S.A.F.E. Portal location is indicated exclusively on the owner’s world and region maps, but it is visible in the game world when the owner is nearby[/*]		[*]The personal S.A.F.E. Portal remains open for 90 minutes, providing enough time for exploration and a safer, instant teleport back to the originating Portal City[/*]		[*]Using the personal S.A.F.E. Portal to return to the Portal City is free[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]S.A.F.E. Portals close under the following conditions:	[list]		[*]Its duration expires[/*]		[*]It is used to return[/*]		[*]The player dies, uses Journey Back, or travels to another safe location[/*]		[*]The player collects any items from containers or performs trades with another player[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Region Difficulty and Reward Modifiers[/b]

Rewards and mob power now increase progressively based on region quality, making higher-quality regions more challenging and rewarding:[list]	[*]There is now a bonus to gathering and fishing Fame in the Outlands, based on the quality of the Region[/*]	[*]Fame from gathering, fishing, and defeating mobs, as well as Silver and loot from mobs and chests, all scale higher towards the center of the Outlands[/*]	[*]Mobs have increased health and damage in higher-quality regions	[list]		[*]This does not apply to resource and territory mobs (such as Hide Animals and Territory Guards)[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Outlands region maps now include a dropdown with information showing reward bonuses and mob strength modifiers[/*][/list]
[b]Outlands Player Count Indicator[/b]

A new player count indicator has been added to Outlands regions, offering a rough estimate of the number of players present.
[quote][i]This feature helps smaller groups gauge the presence of larger groups, allowing players to engage in fights of a more appropriate scale with increased confidence. We will closely monitor the impact of this addition.[/i][/quote]
[h3]Other Open World Changes[/h3]

[b]Royal Continent Changes[/b][list]	[*]Some Tier 6 regions can now be found in Yellow Zones, and some Tier 5 regions in Blue Zones, giving players access to a broader range of content before stepping into full-loot PvP zones[/*][/list][quote][i]These changes are carefully balanced with the new Region Modifier system and the increased availability of Dynamic Resource Hotspots in full-loot PvP zones, ensuring the high-end economy remains intact while still offering more content for newer or risk-averse players.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Tier 7 resources now spawn in Tier 7 Red Zones[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b][list]	[*]Kill details are now suppressed for 5 minutes for everyone except the killer and the victim[/*]	[*]During a region’s Prime Time, the Next Activity Chest Value overlay now displays the current chest value instead of the upcoming one[/*]	[*]The value of Hidden Treasures has been increased by roughly 400%[/*][/list]
[h3]Mob Power Changes[/h3]

[quote][i]Player power has grown with every update, while mobs have lagged behind. This update reworks mob power progression from Tier 5 and up to match current player strength.[/i][/quote][list]	[*]Mobs from Tier 5 and above now receive incremental power boosts, starting with a 9% increase at Tier 5 and 42% by Tier 8[/*]	[*]These adjustments do not apply to:	[list]		[*]Avalonians in the Roads of Avalon[/*]		[*]Tracking targets[/*]		[*]Demons in Hellgates and Corrupted Dungeons[/*]		[*]Elite enemies in Randomized Dungeons and World Boss Areas[/*]		[*]Territory Guards[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]As mob power increases, corresponding rewards (Fame, loot, and Silver) will scale as well to offer more substantial incentives for taking on these tougher foes[/*]	[*]Note that these changes are distinct from the mob power changes mentioned above (in ‘Region Difficulty and Reward Modifiers’)[/*][/list]
[h3]Group Content Changes[/h3]

[quote][i]Albion’s group content is meant to challenge teams, but players have often found it more profitable to farm this content alone. These changes aim to make these activities more rewarding and enjoyable for groups.[/i][/quote]
[b]Reward Changes[/b]

Rewards for most group and raid activities have been adjusted:[list]	[*]Rewards now scale with group size, increasing significantly as more players are involved[/*][/list]
[b]Group Randomized Dungeon Changes[/b][list]	[*]Group Randomized Dungeon entrances now close a short time after a player enters	[list]		[*]Royal Continent: 60 seconds[/*]		[*]Outlands: 90 seconds[/*]		[*]As with Solo Randomized Dungeons, a channel is now required to enter[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Fame and loot rewards for groups of 3 or more players have been increased by approximately 50%[/*][/list]
[b]New Crystal Creatures[/b]

This update introduces two new Crystal Creatures to the Outlands, aimed at groups of about 5 players – the Crystal Beetle and the Crystal Cobra.[list]	[*]Crystal Beetle	[list]		[*]A powerful, winged enemy which can punish its attackers with lightning strikes and magical energy[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Crystal Cobra	[list]		[*]A vicious and intimidating reptile which can spit devastating, poisonous venom[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Crystal Creature Adjustments[/b][list]	[*]All Crystal Creatures, including Crystal Spiders, now spawn much more frequently; their spawn rate is adjusted based on the overall Guild Season point output[/*]	[*]Each individual Crystal Creature now yields less loot and Might, to partially counterbalance their significantly increased frequency	[list]		[*]Loot rewards have been reduced by 56%, and Might by 83%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Crystal Creatures no longer grant Favor, so that their rewards can be more focused on loot[/*]	[*]Crystal Creatures are now only marked on the map when players are nearby[/*][/list]
[h3]Quick Settings Presets[/h3]

Quick Settings Presets allow players to save different configurations of in-game options and instantly switch between them with customizable shortcuts:[list]	[*]Presets can be accessed and managed from the bottom-left corner of the main in-game Settings menu[/*]	[*]Each preset can include settings from the following categories:	[list]		[*]General[/*]		[*]Graphics[/*]		[*]Audio[/*]		[*]Interface (including the new HUD Editor layouts)[/*]		[*]Controls[/*]		[*]Social[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Players can either start a fresh preset, or duplicate an existing one	[list]		[*]A preset can then be customized by modifying settings as needed[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Up to 14 presets can be saved for specific playstyle needs or activities, such as PvP, ZvZ, PvE, or gathering[/*]	[*]Custom names and key bindings can be assigned to each preset for quick switching[/*]	[*]Presets can be exported to share with friends, guildmates, or other players[/*][/list]
[h3]HUD Editor[/h3]

The new HUD Editor allows players on both mobile and desktop to fully customize nearly all aspects of their in-game interface, allowing for a highly customizable experience tailored to individual needs and playstyles.

[b]Customization Options[/b][list]	[*]The HUD Editor can be opened from the ‘Interface’ section of the in-game settings menu[/*]	[*]When entering the Editor, all HUD elements are highlighted on the screen, even those not currently active[/*]	[*]Players can freely move and adjust most elements	[list]		[*]Selecting Align to Elements snaps components to other UI elements[/*]		[*]Selecting Align to Grid reveals a grid for precise placement[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Each element can be clicked to open a dedicated settings window	[list]		[*]Here, adjust anchor points, scale, and opacity can be adjusted[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Some elements are part of predefined groups, allowing for simultaneous movement and scaling for easier organization	[list]		[*]Each individual element within these groups can still be adjusted independently[/*]		[*]Custom groups can be created[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Some elements have additional specific settings for further customization	[list]		[*]For example, the Status Effects bar can be configured to adjust its layout in rows and columns[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]On mobile, the offset to the screen edge can also be adjusted[/*][/list]
[b]Saving and Sharing Layouts[/b][list]	[*]After making adjustments in the HUD Editor, players can save their custom HUD layouts[/*]	[*]Up to 10 layouts can be saved for different activities[/*]	[*]These can be easily switched with the new Quick Presets feature[/*]	[*]Once saved, layouts can be quickly accessed from the ‘Interface’ settings menu[/*]	[*]To share a layout, players can copy it to the clipboard and share it	[list]		[*]This layout can be imported and saved directly into the HUD Editor[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Layouts are platform-specific and can only be shared between players on the same platform (PC or mobile)[/*][/list]
[b]Changes to Interface Settings[/b][list]	[*]The scale of the HUD layout is now adjusted independently from the window scale	[list]		[*]Window scaling now refers exclusively to UI windows like menus and popups[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Due to low demand, the default layout ‘Spells on Right’ has been removed	[list]		[*]Players who wish to use this setup can recreate it manually using the HUD Editor[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Inventory and Storage Improvements[/h3]

This update brings a number of significant improvements and changes to the Inventory, Bank, and Chest UIs:[list]	[*]The equipped items display above the player’s inventory can be condensed into a compact view	[list]		[*]This allows more inventory space to view carried items[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Item sizes in the inventory can be customized, allowing more items to be visible at once[/*]	[*]Items in a player’s inventory can be sorted by the following categories	[list]		[*]Weight[/*]		[*]Tier[/*]		[*]Estimated Market Value[/*]		[*]Estimated Value by Weight[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Items can now be repaired from inside bank tabs, with the option to Repair All items in one click[/*]	[*]A new Move All button allows for easy transfers between inventory, chests and bank tabs[/*]	[*]Item search is now also available in the inventory UI[/*]	[*]The average item power of your equipped items is now displayed in the header of the inventory UI[/*]	[*][DESKTOP] When mounting or dismounting transport mounts, a visual indicator in the inventory and the HUD now shows your load capacity change[/*][/list]
[h3]New Albion Journal Categories[/h3]

Two new categories have been added to the Albion Journal:

[b]Social and Guild[/b][list]	[*]This category challenges players to participate in group and guild activities, encouraging players to work together in large-scale battles, guild missions, and other social events[/*][/list]
[b]Islands[/b][list]	[*]This category introduces missions that revolve around managing your personal and guild islands, including farming and island upgrades[/*][/list]Each category comes with its own unique rewards, which are unlocked at different stages of progress.

[b]Other Journal changes[/b][list]	[*]New subcategories and missions have been added:	[list]		[*]A new PvE subcategory for Dynamic Encampments[/*]		[*]New Exploration missions focused on S.A.F.E. Portals and Open World Coffers[/*]		[*]New Gathering missions related to Dynamic Resource Hotspots[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Improved automatic Journal mission recommendations and mission order[/*]	[*]Adjusted various mission conditions to enhance early-game progression[/*]	[*]Achievement mission progress elements in the Albion Journal UI are now fully clickable[/*][/list]
[h3]Additional Changes and Improvements[/h3]

[b]Mists Changes[/b][list]	[*]The Fame penalty applied to mobs within Mists Camps, due to them being quest NPCs with very high respawn rates, has been increased from 60% to 90%	[list]		[*]Our intention is for camps to be played once before exhausting their value and needing to move on, but due to the high concentration of champion-level enemies in the new Dynamic Encampments, their potential for becoming a Fame camp was too great due to their high respawn rate[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Removed quest completion Fame[/*]	[*]Significantly increased the amount of Tomes of Insight within Personal Chests, to counter the lost Fame from mobs and quest completion	[list]		[*]These changes should entirely counterbalance each other so that there is no change to the total amount of Fame from Mists Camps[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Ranking Improvements[/b][list]	[*]New categories to Player Rankings are available:	[list]		[*]PvP Fame - Open World[/*]		[*]PvP Fame - Mists[/*]		[*]PvP Fame - Corrupted Dungeons[/*]		[*]PvP Fame - Hell Gates[/*]		[*]PvP Fame - Roads of Avalon[/*]		[*]PvE Fame - Open World[/*]		[*]PvE Fame - Mists[/*]		[*]PvE Fame - Roads of Avalon[/*]		[*]PvE Fame - Hardcore Expeditions[/*]		[*]PvE Fame - Solo Dungeons[/*]		[*]PvE Fame - Group (Veteran) Dungeons[/*]		[*]PvE Fame - Large Group (Raid) Dungeons[/*]		[*]PvE Fame - Static Dungeons[/*]		[*]Tracking Fame[/*]		[*]Gathering Fame - Fiber[/*]		[*]Gathering Fame - Hide[/*]		[*]Gathering Fame - Ore[/*]		[*]Gathering Fame - Stone[/*]		[*]Gathering Fame - Wood[/*]		[*]Gathering Fame - Fishing[/*]		[*]Journal Missions Completed[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Fame gained prior to the Horizons Update will not count towards these new categories, but will still count towards the old ranking categories[/*][/list]
[b]Player Markers[/b][list]	[*] [DESKTOP] Players can now double the size of all markers through the party menu	[list]		[*]This ensures better visibility during large-scale battles[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Marked nametags will no longer disappear prematurely when the tagged player runs north of the screen	[list]		[*]This matches the behavior of off-screen tags in other directions[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]VFX Reworks[/b][list]	[*]The gathering animation for Wood Axes has been reworked, providing a more visually dynamic and polished look to the woodcutting process[/*]	[*]Animations for the Deadly Chop and Battle Rush abilities have been improved for all Two-Handed Axe variants[/*]	[*]The Infernal Monstrosity and Bound Molten Demon have received a visual overhaul, with updated attack animations and spell effects[/*]	[*]The first Heretic Mine Expedition has received environmental improvements[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b][list]	[*]The pursuit range of Siphoning Mages has been reduced[/*]	[*]Dropped Banners no longer reduce Fortification protection[/*]	[*]The Energy destruction rate on Territory raids has been doubled from 5% to 10%[/*]	[*]The Enchantment level of Random Dungeon Maps now matches the Enchantment level of the dungeon it spawns[/*]	[*]Destiny Board highlighting has been polished, and is less glaring when zoomed in[/*]	[*][MOBILE] The ‘Virtual Controller’ and ‘Tap Controls’ style settings in the ‘Controls → General’ section of the in-game Settings menu are now defaults for recommended Control options[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Added a new server selection UI[/*]	[*][DESKTOP] While in half-mounted radius, players now run to their mount before starting the mounting action, aligning with the existing Mobile behavior[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]

[b]Axes[/b][list]	[*]Bloody Reap (Infernal Scythe)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 20s → 25s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Fire Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Pyroblast (one-handed Fire Staff)	[list]		[*]Initial channel damage: 190 → 140[/*]		[*]Channel damage after 0.6s: 266 → 240[/*]		[*]Channel damage after 1.2s: 342 → 340[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Holy Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Generous Heal (all Holy Staffs)	[list]		[*]Heal: 132 → 100[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 2s → 1.5s[/*]		[*]Now increases all healing received by the target by 5% for 4s, stacking up to 3 times[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Holy Flash (all Holy Staffs)	[list]		[*]Heal: 130 → 117[/*]		[*]Max targets: 5 → 10[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Holy Beam (all Holy Staffs)	[list]		[*]Channel duration: 6s → 3s[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 16s → 10s[/*]		[*]Healing now starts at 60 and increases by 5 every 0.5s (previously started at 30 and increased by 30 per tick)		[list]			[*]Total possible healing: 840 → 525[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Nature Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Rejuvenating Flower (all Nature Staffs)	[list]		[*]Empower Time: 0s → 0s, 2s → 1.5s, 4s → 3s[/*]		[*]Spell effect area radius: 1m → 1.5m[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Cleanse Heal (all Nature Staffs)	[list]		[*]Max targets: 5 → 10[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Quarterstaffs[/b][list]	[*]Concussive Combo (all Quarterstaffs)	[list]		[*]The third hit is now an AoE with a radius of 4m		[list]			[*]Third hit damage: 130 → 85[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Now increases Threat Generation by 50[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Hurricane (Iron-clad Staff)	[list]		[*]Cooldown reduced by 3s (cooldown scaling by Item Power is unchanged)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shapeshifter Staffs[/b][list]	[*]Bloody Roar (Bloodmoon Staff)	[list]		[*]Life steal: 7% → 6%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Swords[/b][list]	[*]Mighty Blow (Broadsword)	[list]		[*]End position offset: -3m → -2.5m[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Armors[/b][list]	[*]Wind Wall (Knight Armor)	[list]		[*]Now purges all enemies hit[/*]		[*]Cooldown: 30s → 40s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Shoes[/b][list]	[*]Raging Blink (Stalker Shoes)	[list]		[*]Recast cooldown: 25s → 30s (single cast cooldown remains 25s)[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Mark of Sacrifice (Hellion Shoes)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 20s → 15s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Shield Charge (Knight Boots)	[list]		[*]Cooldown: 25s → 20s[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Mounts[/b][list]	[*]T3 Riding Horse	[list]		[*]Base Speed: 65% → 55%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]T4 Riding Horse	[list]		[*]Base Speed: 65% → 60%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]T5 Riding Horse	[list]		[*]Gallop Speed: 110% → 115%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]T6 Riding Horse	[list]		[*]Base Speed: 65% → 70%[/*]		[*]Gallop Speed: 115% → 120%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]T7 Riding Horse	[list]		[*]Base Speed: 65% → 75%[/*]		[*]Gallop Speed: 120% → 125%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]T8 Riding Horse	[list]		[*]Base Speed: 65% → 80%[/*]		[*]Gallop Speed: 125% → 135%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Spectral Bonehorse	[list]		[*]Base Speed: 65% → 80%[/*]		[*]Gallop Speed: 128% → 137%[/*]		[*]Time until Gallop: 4s → 3s[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]T5 Armored Horse	[list]		[*]Gallop Speed: 110% → 115%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]T6 Armored Horse	[list]		[*]Base Speed: 65% → 70%[/*]		[*]Gallop Speed: 115% → 120%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]T7 Armored Horse	[list]		[*]Base Speed: 65% → 75%[/*]		[*]Gallop Speed: 120% → 125%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]T8 Armored Horse	[list]		[*]Base Speed: 65% → 80%[/*]		[*]Gallop Speed: 125% → 135%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Morgana Nightmare	[list]		[*]Base Speed: 65% → 80%[/*]		[*]Gallop Speed: 128% → 137%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Gallant Horse	[list]		[*]Base Speed: 65% → 75%[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[b]Spell Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Storm Wall (Battle Eagle): Fixed issue where the ability would attempt to knock enemies back before purging them[/*]	[*]Groundbreaker (Polehammer): Added missing AoE escalation to the stun effect[/*]	[*]Arcane Protection (All Arcane Staffs): Fixed issue where the shield would be removed by forced movement effects[/*]	[*]Positional Drift (Shapeshifter Staffs): Fixed issue where the VFX could be spammed[/*]	[*]Bane (Demonic Staff): Fixed issue where it would keep stacking after a killing blow, instead of triggering its effect at 4 stacks[/*]	[*]Shapeshifter Staffs: Fixed issue where Awakened Weapon bonus attributes would not apply after changing regions in Shape form or transforming for the first time after a region change[/*][/list]
[b]UI Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed inaccurate rounding on Albion Journal progress bar in the summary page[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where bonus Gathering and Tracking Fame would not display in overhead messages[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where loot containers could briefly display other loot on opening[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where interacting with the Vanity Merchant could cause the inventory to open or close unexpectedly[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the playtime counter would not display the number of days if playtime exceeded one year[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where icons would disappear when rapidly changing the size of the Destiny Board or Journal tracker[/*]	[*]Fixed an issue where the Destiny Board could malfunction when loading during region changes[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the party list could not be moved when it was underneath the character avatar[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where city plot icons would sometimes not load on the region map[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the loot container would flicker when a personal chest was opened by multiple players simultaneously[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the hint window from the ‘You Are What You Wear’ tutorial could only be closed using ESC[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where awakening weapons in the Artifact Foundry could fail, leaving the Awaken button grayed out despite having all necessary resources[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where more than one item could be added to the Awakening window in the Artifact Foundry[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where player names with spaces in the Access Rights tab were not recognized correctly[/*][/list]
[b]Other Fixes[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue where Guilds would not receive the correct amount of Season Points for converted Siphoned Energy[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where selected chat channel would reset to the default channel after changing regions[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the first item in an Activity Chest would disappear after daily maintenance[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where invading another player’s Corrupted Dungeon would activate a cooldown on all spells[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where Enchanted Roasts had higher weight and nutrition values than unenchanted Roasts[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where defeating summoned mobs would count towards some Journal missions progress[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where the Armor values of some Heretic mobs in Hardcore Expeditions were too low	[list]		[*]The damage taken by these mobs is now significantly lower[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Various additional graphical, animation, terrain, audio, UI, and localization fixes[/*][/list]

[h2]Paths to Glory Patch 4 - Version 26.040.1 - September 18, 2024[/h2]

[quote][i]This patch focuses on combat balance adjustments and fixes.[/i][/quote][quote][i]Please note: a new Albion Online launcher is available to download, and the older version will no longer function as of October 26, 2024. Please ensure your launcher is updated by this date. You can download a new launcher from [/i][url=https://albiononline.com/download][i]https://albiononline.com/download[/i][/url]
[/quote]
[h3]Albion Journal[/h3]

The following Journal mission has had its conditions changed:[list]	[*]Keep a city plot you own in an auction cycle → Bid 5 million Silver on a city plot you currently own[/*][/list]

notes.title: Dev Talk: August 2024 Development Update
notes.notes:
We're back with another [b]Dev Talk[/b]! While everyone is busy filling out their Journals, [b]Game Director Robin Henkys[/b] sat down to unpack the key takeaways from Paths to Glory, and give you a sneak peek at what the team is cooking up next. With work on the next update well underway, there's a lot to be excited about!
 
[previewyoutube=2YLVcswGcYI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]After [i]Paths to Glory[/i][/h3][list]	[*]Rebalancing the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b] has led to a marked increase in both PvP and PvE activity there[/*]	[*]The next update will aim to achieve a [b]similar effect for the open world[/b][/*]	[*]The goals are:	[list]		[*]Increased attractiveness to [b]solo players[/b][/*]		[*]More rewarding [b]mid-sized group content[/b][/*]		[*]Increased [b]activity in the inner-Outlands[/b][/*]		[*]More [b]challenging and rewarding PvE[/b][/*]	[/list][/*][/list][h3][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cde6bb5fbe0f054da69ab9f8f03c25a9e5450cb9.jpeg[/img]

[/h3]
[h3]Open World Developments[/h3][list]	[*][b]New PvE objectives[/b] for solo players[/*]	[*][b]New mechanics[/b] to help solo players journey deeper into the Outlands	[list]		[*]This will [b]reduce the risk of ganking[/b] near Portal Cities[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]PvE rewards and difficulty in the inner-Outlands which [b]scale by region quality[/b]	[list]		[*]This should draw competition away from Portal Cities and into the [b]inner-Outlands[/b][/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]Increased rewards for group [b]Randomized Dungeons[/b][/*]	[*][b]Rebalanced mobs[/b] in the open world and Randomized Dungeons	[list]		[*]Higher-tier mobs will become more challenging and [b]more rewarding[/b][/*]		[*]This should bring [b]high-end PvE[/b] back to the open world[/*]	[/list][/*]	[*]Some [b]Tier 5 and Tier 6 content[/b] introduced to blue and yellow zones, respectively	[list]		[*]This will expand the content available to new players before entering full-loot PvP zones[/*]	[/list][/*][/list][h3][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0ff365467a1f03cccb504661fceed8eec0b56fc0.jpeg[/img]

[/h3]
[h3]Further Improvements[/h3]
At the same time, we’re working on many other features and improvements:
[list]	[*]Two new categories in the [b]Albion Journal[/b][/*]	[*]A more [b]customizable HUD[/b][/*]	[*]Savable [b]settings presets[/b] for quick hotkey adjustments[/*]	[*][b]Inventory management[/b] improvements[/*]	[*]The next batch of [b]Crystal Weapons[/b][/*]	[*]Enhanced[b] rendering performance[/b][/*]	[*]Strengthened [b]cheat protection[/b][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f84e1e63d914dd2f2647c26db7f16fcc3b9c7d99.jpeg[/img]

These developments are all part of our mission to make Albion Online the ultimate sandbox MMORPG, so stay tuned to hear more as we approach the next update. Meanwhile, if you have any questions or comments for us, check out the [b]full video[/b] and [b]leave them in the comments there[/b], and we’ll address the most popular comments in a future video!

notes.notes:
[h2]Paths to Glory Update - Version 26.000.1 - July 22, 2024[/h2]

[h3]The Albion Journal[/h3]
[b]Overview[/b]
[list]	[*]The Albion Journal is a personal logbook that will help you keep track of your adventures and to build up the chronicle of your journey through the lands of Albion[/*]	[*]This is a new achievement tracking feature designed to provide clear guidance and exciting goals for all players, whether you’re a seasoned veteran or just starting out[/*]	[*]The journal offers a mixture of missions that can be completed in a single play session, as well as longer-term goals that unlock valuable rewards and unique vanity items[/*]	[*]The Journal provides an overview of the game’s core activities and features, guiding players through Albion’s sandbox structure immediately after the tutorial[/*][/list][quote][i]We want every play session to have an achievable goal. Whether you're completing a quick task or taking on a more significant challenge, progress should always be within reach. With the introduction of the Albion Journal, we want to provide everyone with a quantifiable way to measure their progress while exploring all the different features Albion Online has to offer.[/i]
[i]With this update, the Journal has five main categories, and we plan to expand this with four further categories in the future.[/i][/quote]
[b]HUD changes[/b]
[list]	[*]The Albion Journal has its own section, the Journal Tracker, on the player HUD — just below the Destiny Board button[/*]	[*]The Journal Tracker displays up to three missions for you to follow your progress.	[list]		[*]You can choose which missions to follow here, or let it show recommended missions[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Journal Tracker is a collapsable menu, which notifies you when you have rewards available[/*][/list]
[b]Your Journal[/b]
[list]	[*]The Albion Journal starts with one revealed mission and gradually reveals more as you progress[/*]	[*]Missions can be completed even if they are not yet revealed in the Journal[/*]	[*]Missions are organized into categories and subcategories, with goals and rewards unlocking as you progress[/*]	[*]Main Categories included in the Paths to Glory update:	[list]		[*]PvE[/*]		[*]Gathering[/*]		[*]Economy[/*]		[*]Exploration[/*]		[*]PvP[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Some brand-new items are available as rewards as you progress through the Journal (see ‘Albion Journal Rewards’ below)[/*]	[*]Many existing Steam Achievements are now part of Journal Missions	[list]		[*]If these were completed prior to the launch of the Journal, their rewards will be ready to claim[/*]		[*]Steam Achievements will remain in the Achievements section separately[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Albion Journal Rewards[/h3]
[b]Mission Rewards[/b]
[list]	[*]Each completed mission grants a reward	[list]		[*]These rewards can be claimed in the Albion Journal UI[/*]		[*]Rewards for individual missions include Tomes of Insight, Silver, Focus Restoration Potions, Gathering Tomes, and many more![/*]		[*]A new reward item is available, Tome of Learning, which grants Learning Points when used[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Category Rewards[/b]
[list]	[*]As you progress through each of the main categories, you will unlock unique new vanity rewards at various stages	[list]		[*]20% completion: A unique Avatar[/*]		[*]40% completion: A matching Avatar Ring[/*]		[*]60% completion: A wardrobe item with a vanity spell[/*]		[*]80% completion: A brand-new mount skin[/*]		[*]100% completion: A very rare, elite version of the wardrobe item and spell[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]These vanity rewards follow the theme of each category[/*]	[*]All Category Rewards are non-tradable[/*][/list]
[h3]Dynamic Spawn Rates[/h3]
In order to provide more content during each server’s peak times, this update introduces a new feature to the open world and the Roads of Avalon: Dynamic Spawn Rates.
[list]	[*]Snapshots of each server’s activity levels will be taken ongoingly[/*]	[*]Some spawn and upgrade rates will be automatically adjusted based on this activity	[list]		[*]Spawn rates will dynamically increase during busy times and decrease during off-peak periods[/*]		[*]There are limits in place to ensure that low-activity periods don’t offer too little, and busy periods don’t offer too much[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]As a result, it should be easier to find content during the busiest times on each server. With this update, this feature will affect treasures, resources, and mobs, with the amount available more in line with each server's activity. The impact will be measured and adjusted as necessary and it may be expanded to other content in the future.
[h3]Roads of Avalon Improvements[/h3]
[quote][i]We've listened to your feedback and, as promised, we're working on the most popular change requested by the community. With these changes, we’re not looking to completely reshape the Roads of Avalon, but rather to rebalance their regions and rewards while adding new content in the form of Tracking. We will continue to monitor gameplay in the Roads after this update, to see what further changes and improvements can be made.[/i][/quote]
[b]Region Balancing[/b]
[list]	[*]The tier of Roads region you enter is now based on the zone type from which you enter	[list]		[*]Tier 4 Roads: Primarily found when entering from Blue and Yellow zones[/*]		[*]Tier 6 Roads: Typically found when entering from Red and Black zones[/*]		[*]Tier 8 Roads: Exclusive to Deep Roads and 20-Player Portals[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The number of 20-Player Portal Regions has been increased to provide more frequent connections to Roads Hideout Regions	[list]		[*]Some connections to 20-Player Portal Regions from non-Hideout Regions have been added too, to increase competition[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Group Portals within the Roads now have a 300 second recharge time[/*][/list]
[b]Content and Reward Balancing[/b]
[quote][i]We wanted to better balance Roads content and rewards with other activities in Albion. There will be fewer Roads regions for gathering, but those that do exist will have higher respawn rates to compensate. Additionally, the Roads will not be quite as powerful for leveling as in the past, but will instead be more attractive for loot.[/i]
[i]On average, Fame has been reduced by around 20-25%, while the total Silver output from the Roads (taking into account increased spawn rates) has been approximately doubled.[/i][/quote]
[list]	[*]Tracking is now possible in the Roads[/*]	[*]Group rewards have been significantly increased to encourage cooperative play, while solo rewards have been reviewed to ensure fairness compared to other content	[list]		[*]Avalonian Chests have had their value increased		[list]			[*]Tier 4 and Tier 6 chests have received a slight buff, and Tier 8 chests a significant buff[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]They now also upgrade in size over time if left untouched[/*]		[*]Small Avalonian Chests can never be rare or legendary, while Large Avalonian Chests can never be common[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The number of areas dedicated to gathering has been reduced	[list]		[*]Their respawn rate has been increased to maintain total resource output in the Roads[/*]		[*]The free spots will be used to introduce additional PvE areas and Solo Randomized Dungeon entrances[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Randomized Dungeons with fixed entrances have had their bonus loot reduced	[list]		[*]To compensate, they are always Enchanted now[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Randomized Dungeon entrances, Mobs, Chests, and Resources have been moved to offer greater diversity of content and remove ultra-specialized regions with only one resource type[/*][/list]
[b]Mob Adjustments[/b]
[list]	[*]Mob tiers are now standardized in each different Roads region	[list]		[*]With the exception of resource mobs, all Roads mobs will match the tier of the region[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Pathfinder Initiate, Ascetic and Monk’s knockback spell now has an AoE indicator and can be dodged[/*]	[*]Pathfinder Heavy Drones no longer use their spells off-cooldown[/*]	[*]Bosses protecting chests offer significantly less Fame	[list]		[*]Instead, opening a chest will reward Fame to the first group who open it[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list]	[*]Roads Portal tooltips now show the danger type of the Roads region[/*]	[*]Avalonian Chest tooltips no longer show their rarity, regardless of your proximity to them[/*]	[*]Furniture can no longer be placed in PvE and gathering areas[/*]	[*]Some areas have updated visuals, for greater variety[/*][/list]
[h3]Guild Islands Rework[/h3]
Paths to Glory updates Guild Islands to bring them in line with Personal Islands
[list]	[*]Guilds can now also own multiple islands in every city on the Royal Continent – one each in Martlock, Bridgewatch, Fort Sterling, Lymhurst, Thetford, and Caerleon –.[/*]	[*]Guild Islands have reworked visuals which reflect the atmosphere, aesthetics, and biome of their host city[/*][/list]
[h3]New Crystal Weapons[/h3]
New update, new Crystal Weapons! This update introduces the next batch of these weapons, which will be craftable at the end of Season 24:
[list]	[*]Twin Slayers (Daggers): Ring of Death throws your daggers in a ring around you, which can then be summoned back, slicing through all enemies in their path[/*]	[*]Dreadstorm Monarch (Mace): Eye of the Storm conjures a growing storm around you that slows enemies and shreds their resistances[/*]	[*]Exalted Staff (Holy Staff): Sanctify heals allies and removes ground-based damaging, debuffing, or crowd-control areas of effect[/*][/list]
[h3]Corrupted Dungeon Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Corrupted Dungeon Maps have been added	[list]		[*]These can be crafted at the Artifact Foundry[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Bat spawn times adjusted	[list]		[*]Hunter: 5 minutes → 3 minutes[/*]		[*]Stalker: 5 minutes → 3 minutes[/*]		[*]Slayer: 3 minutes (unchanged)[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[quote][i]With this update, we wanted to provide several much-requested quality of life enhancements by improving a number of important weapon functions and UI elements, along with some other frequently-requested changes and additions.[/i][/quote]
[b]Weapon Improvements[/b]
Based on your feedback, two important changes have been made to weapon functionality:
[list]	[*]Weapons now have all of their spells unlocked from Tier 4 upwards, to increase gameplay variety[/*]	[*]Items can now be overcharged twice in combat, increasing overcharge duration at a  greater risk of breaking the item	[list]		[*]This will allow for prolonged ZvZ battles beyond the 30-minute mark[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Party Ready Check[/b]
A new system allows party leaders to check on the readiness of their group members, to help in activities which require coordination.
[list]	[*]A party leader can initiate a Ready Check in two ways:	[list]		[*]From their character drop-down menu[/*]		[*]By typing /readycheck in the chat[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]All party members, regardless of location, receive a notification asking if they are ready or not[/*]	[*]Responses are displayed to all party members	[list]		[*]Green check-mark: Ready[/*]		[*]Red cross: Not ready[/*]		[*]White question mark: Pending/AFK[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]If a member does not respond in 60 seconds, they are marked as Pending/AFK[/*]	[*]Responses remain on-screen for 30 seconds after the end of the Ready Check	[list]		[*]If a new Ready Check is initiated in this time, the original responses are overwritten[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]UI Improvements[/b]
[list]	[*]The Destiny Board has improved scaling and zooming[/*]	[*]All players in a Randomized Dungeon now receive a message when the entrance closes	[list]		[*]No more counting to 90 and guessing if an entrance is gone![/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Daily Bonus Tracker in the HUD can now be collapsed[/*]	[*]Last Death Recap can now be accessed from the Player Menu at any time during the same play session[/*]	[*]Siege UI:	[list]		[*]The Siege UI is now accessible at any time when using the Siege Banner item[/*]		[*]Improved information display that better reflects the requirements necessary for Siege Banner use[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Added a market value estimation of equipment when inspecting a player	[list]		[*]The estimated value includes equipped items only, not items in inventory[/*]		[*]Displayed value is a rounded number; hovering over estimated value shows the exact amount[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Player Rankings UI:	[list]		[*]Added options to filter rankings by “Guild Members only” and “Friends List only”[/*]		[*]When a player ranks outside the top 10,000, their position along with the two players immediately above and below them are displayed[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Party and guild management:	[list]		[*]Player markers are now displayed in front of other elements (such as health bars) and are easier to distinguish from the background, improving the visibility of marked players in large battles[/*]		[*]Player pings now appear as system messages in chat[/*]		[*]Added button to Guild UI to copy Guild Member list to the clipboard[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Territory Activity Chest world map overlays added, showing:	[list]		[*]Average Activity Chest Value[/*]		[*]Next Activity Chest Value[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Trade UI now displays projected character weight after a prospective trade[/*]	[*]Added confirmation popup message when using Journey Back to better inform about Silver costs[/*]	[*]Added an opacity setting for the chat box in focused mode[/*]	[*]Improved search function by allowing variation in words instead of requiring an exact match[/*]	[*]Improved target dummy DPS view to be more consistent and closer to actual damage timing[/*][/list]
[h3]Additional Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]In order to create some economic space and bring greater parity to Albion’s various features, various slight adjustments have been made to the Mists and Knightfall Abbey:	[list]		[*]Boss and Shrine chest values in Knightfall Abbey reduced by approximately 10%		[list]			[*]Duo Mists’ chests have had their bonus values adjusted to offset this change, and are unaffected[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Resolved an issue where some mobs in Knightfall Abbey gave too little Silver		[list]			[*]This has resulted in a ~9% overall increase in Silver from mobs[/*]		[/list]		[/*]		[*]Already small loot chances from mobs removed to offset increased Silver and protect chests from further reductions[/*]		[*]Arcane Spiderling spawn chances in the Mists reduced by 18%[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Veteran and Elite mobs now regenerate health in combat, making them less profitable when engaged by fewer players	[list]		[*]Their overall health has been reduced to maintain the time needed for a group to kill them[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Mobs with very long respawn times (e.g. Ancient Resource Mobs) will spawn at more unpredictable intervals[/*]	[*]Reworked animations and VFX for Quarterstaffs and Scythes[/*]	[*]The following spells have also been visually redesigned:	[list]		[*]Threatening Smash (all Maces)[/*]		[*]Slowing Charge (two-handed Hammers)[/*]		[*]Rending Strike (two-handed Axes)[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]A-key can now be used to exit islands[/*]	[*]Dynamic Events added for the Mists, Roads of Avalon, and Tracking[/*]	[*]Territory Activity Chests are now lootable by anyone after a Raid if the Territory has no owner[/*]	[*]Players who are inactive during a Faction Warfare week will no longer receive a weekly report[/*]	[*]Removed recipes that use Arcane Essences and Faded Essences from the Artifact Foundry	[list]		[*]Arcane Essences can now be salvaged for Silver[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Crystal Gladiator vanity items are no longer available from Crystal League chests	[list]		[*]These are now only available via Albion Journal Crystal League Missions[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Spawn buff prevention no longer counts down while between regions[/*]	[*][MOBILE] Added S, W, and E indicators to Minimap[/*]	[*][CONTROLLER] Moved "Emotes" to the D-pad action wheel[/*]	[*][CONTROLLER] Added a "Travel Mode Settings" controller button action to the Region Map[/*][/list]
[h3]Steam and Mobile Achievement Conditions[/h3]
With the launch of the Albion Journal, the conditions for certain Steam and Mobile achievements have been changed. Your progress in these achievements has not been reset, after the changed condition.
[list]	[*]Successfully finish an Expedition → Finish a Tier 3 Solo Expedition[/*]	[*]Enter a Randomized Dungeon → Finish a Tier 3 Solo Dungeon[/*]	[*]Enter 1,000 Randomized Dungeons → Finish 1,000 Solo Dungeons[/*]	[*]Complete your first hunt → Track down a rare solo creature[/*]	[*]Track down and kill one of each creature type →  Track down 7 different rare solo creatures[/*]	[*]Kill a Guardian Aspect from every biome → Harvest resources from Guardian Aspects in every biome[/*]	[*]Defeat a Guardian in a Road of Avalon → Harvest resources from a Guardian in the Roads of Avalon[/*]	[*]Defeat the final boss in a Corrupted Dungeon→ Defeat the final boss in a Hunter Corrupted Dungeon[/*]	[*]Gain 100,000 Infamy in any Hellgate type → Gain 100,000 Infamy in 2v2 Hellgates[/*]	[*]Gain 250,000 Infamy in any Hellgate type → Gain 250,000 Infamy in 2v2 Hellgates[/*]	[*]Win a Crystal League Match → Win a 5v5 Crystal League Match[/*]	[*]Win a Crystal League Match of Rank 3 → Win a Rank 3 5v5 Crystal League Match[/*]	[*]Win a Crystal League Match of Rank 7 → Win a Rank 7 5v5 Crystal League Match[/*][/list]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
[quote][i]Our main focus with this update was to adjust the resilience curve, which addresses the survivability of melee and ranged weapons in large scale battles. The goal is to make these fights less focused on melee brawl compositions, and give ranged damage-per-second more room to succeed.[/i][/quote]
[b]Resilience[/b]
The impact of Resilience on large-scale fights has been reduced significantly, making melees less tanky with higher numbers of attackers. This means that all players (including ranged players) deal greater damage to melees. To compensate for this, the resilience penetration for various long range melee weapons has been reduced. This is aimed at large-scale fights - for up to five attackers melee Resilience values are unchanged.

The Resilience curve has also been normalized for ranged weapons, to use the same Resilience values as melees and make both these weapon types more competitive in all group sizes.

notes.title: Colossal Steam MMO Albion Online unveils next big free update
notes.notes:
Albion Online is a game that has a huge following across the world but largely manages to stay off the radar. The free-to-play MMO continues to grow and evolve, with several years of updates behind it and a promised long future ahead. The next big update has just been unveiled via a developer diary video, and it's chock-full of quality of life tweaks and more.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: The “Foundations” Update is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a223dfd54182c21ade978aec1a41480233a668a7.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Foundations[/b] are ready for a new era in warfare! With mighty [b]Fortifications[/b], rousing [b]Siege Banners[/b], overflowing [b]Territory Activity Chests[/b], and a lot more, Albion’s latest update lays the groundwork for fierce battles all across its lands.

In anticipation of what’s about to unfold, we’ve produced a brand-new trailer for the occasion. Check it out here:

[previewyoutube=vTj-NaMx4gs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Man the Barricades[/h3]
This update introduces[b] Fortifications[/b] to territory warfare. Guilds can upgrade the walls, gates, and guards protecting their territories, providing progressively more staunch barriers to would-be attackers. [b]Siege Banners[/b], meanwhile, change the dimensions of territory battles, forcing attackers and defenders alike to rethink their tactics - attackers must carry a banner to the territory tower to be victorious, but defenders have the opportunity to end an attack early by controlling the banner themselves, until it’s destroyed.

For more on these exciting new features, check out this [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-fortifications][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/59d13a9a8dcbb7422c3e263421827979ce58ca79.jpeg[/img]
[h3]New Incentives[/h3]
[b]Territory Activity Chests[/b] accumulate loot based on activity levels in surrounding regions. This encourages guilds to be active around their holdings, and even to ensure outsiders operate in safety there. But with greater riches comes an incentive for rivals, who can loot the chests and make off with the spoils themselves.

Foundations also introduces the next three[b] Crystal Weapons[/b] in the game: the[b] Arctic Staff[/b], [b]Phantom Twinblade[/b], and [b]Crystal Reaper[/b]. With unique, powerful spells, these weapons offer a prestigious reward for players who are successful in the Conqueror’s Challenge.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/baf7453dd7db33e06c38b58a8acbfeb8bb1d3a23.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Further Features[/h3]
A much-anticipated [b]Spectator Mode[/b] gives creators and streamers the ability to broadcast their own Custom Matches, allowing them to organize their own, exciting tournaments however they want to. [b]Hammers[/b] have been refreshed with [b]new spells[/b], ready to strike down opponents on Albion’s battlefields. And a host of further features have been added across the game, such as solo [b]Tracking [/b]improvements, [b]new territory layouts[/b], and a number of combat balance changes.

Foundations is live now, so log in and check out these new features! For a full rundown of the changes in this update, read the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/foundations][b]patchnotes[/b][/url], and see the [b]official update page[/b] for more info:

[url=https://albiononline.com/update/foundations]LEARN MORE[/url]

notes.title: Upcoming Guild Season Changes
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7f55ae8006b1f0c456141500c734abfd0bf10d85.jpeg[/img]

The current Guild Season is reaching its climax, and it’s time to start preparing for the next. With the launch of the [url=https://albiononline.com/europe][b]Albion Europe[/b][/url] server on [b]April 29[/b], some significant changes are coming to the way seasons operate. Read on for an overview of these changes, so you can get ready to assemble your forces and fight your way to glory.

[b]Season Names[/b]

Starting with the upcoming Guild Season, we’re simplifying the naming conventions for seasons across the three servers. For this reason, next season will be called Season 23 [b]on all servers[/b], avoiding a confusing situation where the season has a different name on each server.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ba6757ec1816af3d2b34bf1f018869ab9ac247ab.jpeg[/img]

[b]Prime Times[/b]

With the launch of Albion Europe, we’re taking the opportunity to rework Prime Times across all three servers in order to better suit activity periods on each. Each server will now have [b]six Prime Time slots[/b] (rather than seven), and the windows on Albion Americas are now more condensed, encouraging constant action from start to finish. Albion Europe’s Prime Times fit this pattern, covering [b]ten hours in total[/b].

Here is an overview of Prime Times across the servers (click to expand):

[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7c96f6d6c71b0f0b91a0d84845cb5b6769a214c3.jpeg][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d0d4089dc4f7decd32f8b1f7fafade189b77f40b.jpeg[/img][/url]

As you can see, Castle and Castle Outpost chests unlock [b]one hour before [/b]each server’s Prime Time window, [b]one hour after[/b], and [b]on every hour between Prime Times[/b]. With this in mind, the lock duration of Castle chests has been reduced from [b]120 to 60 minutes[/b].

Additionally, it should be noted that [b]World Bosses on Albion Asia[/b] will now spawn every even-numbered hour (UTC), to avoid colliding with the maintenance window.

[b]Season Winner Statues[/b]

With three servers from Season 23 onwards, Season Winner Statues will be the same across all servers, and will no longer be designed by the guilds themselves but rather by the Sandbox Interactive art team.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4cc727135faacdf65f74bfa8fd2668ab7e34b85e.jpeg[/img]

With [url=https://albiononline.com/news/dev-talk-fortifications][b]Fortifications[/b][/url], [b]Siege Banners[/b], and all the other changes coming to territory warfare with the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/foundations][b]Foundations[/b][/url] update, Season 23 promises to be truly action-packed. For the season schedule and rewards, check out [b][url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/194638]this forum post[/url][/b]. See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: The “Foundations” Update Launches April 15
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a223dfd54182c21ade978aec1a41480233a668a7.jpeg[/img]

As the current Guild Season reaches its climax, it’s already time to get ready for Albion’s next major content update. On [b]April 15[/b], [b]Foundations[/b] will launch, bringing with it a host of new developments and improvements. [b]Fortifications [/b]are upgradable defensive features for territories, and [b]Siege Banners[/b] offer possibilities for attackers and defenders alike. [b]Territory Activity Chests[/b] offer enticing rewards for territory owners - as well as their rivals. [b]New Crystal Weapons[/b] are coming, with a range of powerful spells. And a [b]Spectator Mode [/b]allows Albion’s creators to broadcast Arena battles and tournaments. With all this and more, Foundations opens the gates to new forms of warfare in Albion.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/451d5ca1489731a7a73517cf3ae7ef7e7e6c4bcb.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Raise the Banner[/h3]
[b]Fortifications[/b] offer formidable defensive structures for guilds of all sizes, and will bring forth new tactics and strategies in territorial combat. These structures, and their guards, can be further [b]upgraded[/b] by guilds who invest the time and resources, becoming mighty barriers against those who seek to raid and conquer. In addition, [b]Siege Banners[/b] complement this, adding a new twist to territory fights by providing opportunities for attacking and defending guilds alike.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e5b8e2e96e69701d179d3e0cdefb828cd6f88e5e.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Territories Transformed[/h3]
[b]Territory Activity Chests[/b] encourage constant activity around territories - but the more value they accrue, the more enticing they become to potential attackers. Territories in the Outlands also now have [b]new layouts[/b]. Meanwhile, [b]Prime Times[/b] have been adjusted across the different servers, to provide more consistent action for each region.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a1df58574894e6b882cda6507728b7bd34fb8c2c.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Let Battle Commence[/h3]
[b]New Crystal Weapons[/b] are coming, offering an array of powerful and prestigious prizes to top season performers. [b]Hammers[/b] are getting fresh and formidable new spells too, shaking up the combat meta. And a new [b]Spectator Mode[/b] gives creators the freedom to set up and broadcast their own Arena battles, opening the door to exciting, player-run tournaments.

With all this, [b]Foundations[/b] lays the groundwork for some exciting new developments to warfare in Albion. For more details, check out the [b]official update page[/b]:

[url=https://albiononline.com/update/foundations]LEARN MORE[/url]

notes.notes:
[url=https://albiononline.com/update/crystal-raiders][b]Crystal Raiders[/b][/url] launches January 8, bringing new life to guild warfare in Albion. In our second Feature Focus, we take a look at the new Crystal Weapons, the changes coming to the Conqueror’s Challenge, and more.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cd6d51f9da5d7ac6ac93d173203f08973143add6.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Crystal Weapons[/h3]
Crystal Raiders introduces three brand-new [b]Crystal Weapons, [/b]the first in an entirely new weapon tree.

[b]What are Crystal Weapons?[/b]
[list]	[*]Crystal Weapons are powerful new weapons created from Artifacts[/*]	[*]Their design takes a "form follows function" approach with clear shapes and prominent crystal elements[/*]	[*]The Artifacts used to create them are awarded at the end of each Guild Season in Conqueror’s Challenge Chests, meaning the first three weapons will be craftable at the end of Season 22 West / 4 East[/*]	[*]Higher-level chests award higher-tier Artifacts[/*]	[*]Each Guild Season will introduce three new Crystal Weapons, with older Artifacts still given out but in decreased quantities[/*]	[*]Unlike other weapons, the usage and crafting of Crystal Weapons benefits all other weapons in the same Destiny Board tree (Warrior, Hunter, Mage)[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/565654b3cdfe1d06d639bc2888e45f8a82666261.png[/img]

[b]What are the first three weapons?[/b]

Crystal Raiders introduces the first three Crystal Weapons, each with its own unique spell:
[list]	[*][b]Infinity Blade (Sword):[/b] the "Limitbreaker" ability allows you to charge up your sword and run into enemy forces, then inflict a devastating double strike[/*]	[*][b]Rift Glaive (Spear):[/b] the "Razor’s Edge" ability fires a massive projection of the spear’s blade, which pierces through crowds and deals massive damage[/*]	[*][b]Astral Staff (Arcane Staff):[/b] the "Starfall" ability rains a shower of deadly stars down on enemies[/*][/list]These are just the beginning: as seasons are now synced with updates, each will introduce three additional weapons in this ever-expanding and diversifying weapons tree.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3db493578e1fb6cc45e619029230b22d1ca2fe52.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Conqueror’s Challenge Changes[/h3]
With the Crystal Raiders update, the Conqueror’s Challenge has been updated to directly reward players for both their individual progress and their guild’s progress. The former guaranteed Battle Mount rewards have been replaced with new Conqueror’s Chests, which in addition to potentially still containing Battle Mounts also contain Crystal Weapon Artifacts and other valuable rewards. The value of these chests increases in two separate ways:
[list]	[*]Individual progress in the Conqueror’s Challenge gives access to increasingly more valuable chests[/*]	[*]Guild progress (Season Ranking) upgrades the chests earned, expanding and increasing their loot pools	[list]		[*]To unlock Guild-based upgrades, players must qualify for season rewards (be part of the guild for at least 51% of the season)[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Players are in this way incentivized to boost both their own and their guild’s progress[/*]	[*]10% of the rewards from weekly reward chests have been moved into the new Conqueror’s Chests[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3f8dc5923ab1b70f3f075eb990ce0e80011cfc35.jpeg[/img]

[list]	[*]For each day in which an owned territory generates Siphoned Energy, all Guild Members get a Daily Might Bonus[/*]	[*]This Might can be claimed via the Conqueror’s Challenge UI[/*]	[*]The Might received depends on the amount of energy generated[/*][/list]
