notes.title: Feature Focus: Territory Changes
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e77f3a3a5cf68b51b5493fc68cb07adc871290e1.jpeg[/img]

With [url=https://albiononline.com/update/crystal-raiders][b]Crystal Raiders[/b][/url] on the horizon, it’s time to take a closer look at some of the update’s main features. Here, we delve into the changes coming to territories, with Raiding, Control Costs, and more.
[h3]Territory Raiding[/h3]
Crystal Raiders introduces [b]Raw Energy [/b]to Albion’s territories. This is generated by Siphoning Mages and refined into [b]Siphoned Energy [/b]over time, but it also brings an opportunity to other guilds, as it can be stolen in [b]Territory Raids[/b]:
[list]	[*]Each day at prime time, a territory’s [b]Energy Storage[/b] becomes attackable[/*]	[*]A territory can be raided during prime time if all Siphoning Mages and the Sentry Mage are defeated[/*]	[*]After a successful Raid, 50% of the Stored Energy is stolen in the form of four Raw Energy Cores, which can be transported back to another guild’s territory[/*]	[*]However, if they don’t reach a new territory [b]within 30 minutes[/b], these Raw Energy Cores will revert back to their original territory[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a744b210c3bbcbe0ba8adac4f20755815445375d.png[/img]

With higher frequency than other territory warfare mechanics, Territory Raiding opens new avenues for Albion’s guilds and encourages action throughout the day:
[list]	[*]Since each Raid has to happen in a territory’s prime time, there is a good chance of a [b]defending force amassing[/b], leading to a battle[/*]	[*]However, since these are happening every day, across all prime times, they are more likely to have [b]smaller defending forces[/b] than territory invasions[/*]	[*]This brings greater opportunities for[b] impromptu, guerilla-style warfare[/b] in the Outlands[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/32472a3b5e7b9142e39ec96587eaeae284557ccb.png[/img]
[h3]Further Territory Changes[/h3]
Changes have been made to territory prime times, to ensure territory-owning guilds are not under pressure to defend their territories around the clock:
[list]	[*]Territory prime times have been reduced to one hour[/*]	[*]Siphoning Mages can now only be attacked during prime time[/*]	[*]Territory Attacks can now only be scheduled during prime time[/*][/list]
Territories now also have [b]Control Costs[/b] associated with them:
[list]	[*]Territories closer to Portal Towns have higher Control Costs[/*]	[*]Once a Control Cost of 15 has been exceeded by a guild or alliance, the [b]Siphoned Energy Drain[/b] applies, and when a Control Cost of 25 is exceeded all individual members face Fame and Silver penalties[/*]	[*]In this way, large guilds who seek to dominate the outer ring of the Outlands will be punished, and [b]encouraged to compete[/b] further in[/*]	[*]This in turn gives newer and smaller guilds a better chance at finding a foothold in the outer ring[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f0eb4f68ffda2c10f504f8c513c10233e0167c91.png[/img]

Further changes also address the relative value of territories:
[list]	[*]The [b]Siphoned Energy[/b] and [b]Season Point[/b] output of territories has a more pronounced weighting towards the inner circle of the Outlands[/*]	[*][b]Territory attack costs[/b] increase with a region’s quality and tower level[/*]	[*]Territories begin a season with a certain amount of [b]Stored Energy[/b] depending on their region quality level[/*][/list]
And the way Stored Energy is paid out has been changed:
[list]	[*]After each prime time, a percentage of Stored Energy is paid out as [b]Season Points[/b] and [b]Siphoned Energy[/b], depending on region and tower level[/*]	[*]Conquering or giving up a territory [b]no longer reduces Stored Energy[/b][/*]	[*]There is a new, [b]fourth and final Invasion Day[/b] at the end of each season, where all Stored Energy is paid out directly as Season Points[/*]	[*]Prior Invasion Days no longer pay out Stored Energy[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5df883f4bc2ff424b0d8c82725e53b097e208d44.png[/img]

All this will encourage guilds to compete over valuable territories deep in the Outlands, whether through outright control or unexpected Territory Raids, and bring ongoing conflict to Albion’s Guild Seasons. We’re excited to see how this plays out with the start of the next season on January 13, along with the other big changes coming with the update. For a full season schedule, [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/190011][b]click here[/b][/url], and stay tuned for another [b]Feature Focus[/b] coming soon!

notes.title: Dev Talk: 2024 Update Plan
notes.notes:
With[b] [url=https://albiononline.com/update/wild-blood]Wild Blood[/url][/b] having expanded Albion’s gameplay significantly, it’s already time to look forward to what the future will bring for the game. In this new Dev Talk, [b]Game Director Robin Henkys [/b]shares some of our thoughts and impressions about the update, and what that means for Albion going forward.

[previewyoutube=PMjlJSQljWM?rel=0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]The Wild Blood Update[/h3]
Wild Blood took longer than most updates to produce, for a number of reasons:
[list]	[*]The launch of [b]Albion East[/b], and the various challenges this presented[/*]	[*]Multiple [b]groundbreaking features[/b]	[list]		[*][b]Shapeshifter Weapons[/b] work differently to any previous weapon line[/*]		[*][b]Awakened Weapons[/b] added new stats to the combat system[/*]		[*][b]Tracking[/b] brought new quest and spawning systems to the open world[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Working on [b]many features in parallel [/b]means they slow each other down somewhat[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/237152502d2a714f4b9358697588cbae08a650da.jpeg[/img]
[h3]New Update Cycle[/h3]
With this in mind, we’re looking at ways to get updates out more quickly and reliably:
[list]	[*]Updates will be tied to the Guild Season schedule, coming roughly [b]every three months[/b][/*]	[*]Updates will be smaller, and targeted at a [b]specific area of the game[/b][/*]	[*]Other changes being worked on can be released [b]as and when they are ready[/b][/*][/list]
Updates will therefore vary in size depending on how many features are completed in each cycle, and the next update will never be far off. This way we can focus on the key features of each, ensuring they are delivered to the highest possible standard.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4788cb5355c987e0f913cc2db05819fec2ce6584.jpeg[/img]
[h3]The Next Update[/h3]
Our first update on the new schedule will release in January:
[list]	[*]It will focus on [b]Guild Seasons[/b][/*]	[*]It will feature a [b]new line of rewards[/b], which expands every season	[list]		[*]These can be earned by helping your guild climb the season rankings[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The way [b]territories [/b]produce Season Points will be reworked[/*]	[*]A new territory [b]raiding mechanic [/b]will drive conflict between guilds[/*]	[*]Individual players will be rewarded with a [b]daily Might bonus [/b]for successful territory control and raiding[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b81566b502b08ce449a6d6d076b6fe017ed1249b.jpeg[/img]

Additionally, there will be various tweaks and rebalancing, including revisiting [b]Hideouts and Headquarter Hideouts[/b], to increase competition for Power Cores.

We’ll have more information for you as we approach January’s release date, so stay tuned for more!

notes.title: The Knightfall Patch is Here
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e5f94be72bea8da12fb6e7fa972b5cde8b18b8b3.png[/img]

[b]Knightfall[/b] is here! This major patch expands and improves on the features introduced with the [b]Beyond the Veil[/b] update - and to mark the occasion, we've produced a brand-new trailer:

[previewyoutube=xhLxGK0MvnA;full][/previewyoutube]
To celebrate the launch, we’re also holding a contest where you can share your perfect Knightfall build. Head over to The [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/albiononline/comments/138gt05/share_your_knightfall_abbey_build_and_win/][b]Albion Online Subreddit[/b][/url] and submit yours for a chance to win!

And to keep the celebration going, we're also offering [b]double Twitch Drops[/b] from May 8-15. These additional drops can be earned by watching any Albion stream that has Drops enabled. (To learn more about Twitch Drops, click [url=https://albiononline.com/twitch][b]here[/b][/url].)

Read on to learn what's new with Knightfall…

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f9aa57328280d0c57afcc0b7b352785bbd893c39.jpeg[/img]

[h3]The Mists: Opportunity and Mystery[/h3]

Knightfall brings some major new features and improvements to the Mists, offering players of all types and levels a chance at big rewards. [b]Coffers[/b] are treasures that only reveal their location to nearby players, and [b]Caches [/b]offer individualized loot for clearing mob camps. [b]Knightfall Abbey[/b], a mysterious dungeon hidden within the Mists, is an atmospheric realm of crumbling stone and beautiful stained-glass windows. Seek out treasures and ancient shrines that offer powerful buffs, because you'll need all the help you can get - not only against other adventurers, but against the dungeon’s former residents as well.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b5dd84959a7ffcc0605bd8af639b49e4867992e3.jpeg[/img]

[h3]New Items, Traders, and Standing[/h3]

Knightfall also brings brand-new items and crafting components, plus a new face in Brecilien, [b]Eralia Wayfarer[/b], who will trade with adventurers with sufficient standing. New [b]Avalonian[/b] and [b]Brecilien Capes[/b] offer unique defensive capabilities, [b]Mystic[/b] [b]Owl mounts [/b]carry you swiftly through the world, and new currencies and items await your discovery. The [b]Roads of Avalon[/b] have also been updated with new enemies, new paths, and greater mob density, with some mobs now dropping Avalonian Energy to further link the Roads to the new cape lines.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b27a6c76b1bf3aa5a57dca3d599eafa6c945813e.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Major Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Extensive combat balance changes[/*]	[*]Optional WASD movement system[/*]	[*]Characters' gender can be changed for Gold[/*]	[*]New "Travel Mode" offers transparent map overlay while traveling[/*]	[*]Items can now be repaired directly via the Marketplace UI[/*]	[*]New guild logos, Season Winner statues, and skill icons[/*]	[*]Major optimizations to mobile and controller gameplay[/*]	[*]…and much more[/*][/list]For the complete list of changes, see the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/knightfall][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Dev Talk: 2023 Development Update
notes.notes:
The new [b]Albion East[/b] server opened to players worldwide March 20, offering a Singapore-based server with an untouched version of Albion. The launch attracted throngs of new and old players to the server, and we're thrilled to see this new version of Albion take shape day-by-day. 

With the launch a success, Game Director [b]Robin Henkys[/b] discusses what's next for the world of Albion in our newest Dev Talk (subtitles are available for all supported languages):

[previewyoutube=QIOAQ5EVch8;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]What's Next in the Short Term?[/h3][list]	[*][b]Rites of Spring[/b] event: Similar to 2022, but with a new, bad-tempered counterpart to the Spring Cottontail[/*]	[*][b]Beyond the Veil Content Patch[/b]: New features for the Mists, adjustments to the Roads of Avalon, usability improvements[/*]	[*]"[b]Dungeons in the Mists[/b]": Central feature; will be discussed in a forthcoming Dev Talk[/*]	[*]After that: Next [b]major content update[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/64c8ac7169e58b25b69a84378209f1c6ef6a9df7.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]Albion's Development Strategy[/h3]
Albion has become quite large and complex, requiring a development strategy that allows us to maintain, improve and revolutionize the game at the same time.

[u][b]Better Basics[/b][/u]

Consistent improvement of [b]core aspects[/b] of the game, especially where most impactful:
[list]	[*][b]Improved Marketplace experience[/b]: Repair All, Sell All, improved filtering and easier large-scale purchases[/*]	[*][b]More stable loot experience[/b] by optimizing [b]Black Market[/b][/*]	[*][b]Improving Stone market,[/b] reworking [b]crafting capacity[/b] and [b]crafting on player islands[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b8a6fbecac6643137aaadefbbe7e34e4954aaed0.jpeg[/img][/b]

[u][b]Continuous Content[/b][/u]

Expanding on features [b]already in the game[/b]:
[list]	[*][b]New gear choices[/b] for the "You are what you wear" system[/*]	[*][b]Rites of Spring + Content Patch[/b] (both with new items)[/*]	[*][b]New Weapon Line[/b] for the Hunter tree[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/38585d9e1599e23c6e92f535c398a4e7b4502e06.jpeg[/img]

[u][b]Fantastic Features[/b][/u]

[b]New features[/b] that expand the scope of Albion Online (these are always in flux, but a few are in progress):
[list]	[*][b]Legendary Weapons[/b]: Weapons can attain "Legendary" status through use, and be given a [b]unique name[/b]; these have a chance of being added to the [b]loot pool [/b]on death, thus leaving a lasting mark on Albion[/*]	[*]Improved spell behavior around [b]walls and height differences[/b]: Precursor to proper [b]castle and siege fights[/b] that may include [b]player-made fortifications[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/731312e687c9e63de8c607de57527b3fa7cd5afc.jpeg[/img][/b]

That's it for today - stay tuned for more Dev Talks covering these themes and Albion’s next major update!

notes.title: Beyond the Veil Patch 3 is here!
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0b0763538113b43c5611f3096def7545c7988b03.jpeg[/img]

[b]Beyond the Veil Patch 3[/b] has arrived! This patch continues to improve the Roads of Avalon, as well as introducing Streamer Mode, various Combat Balance changes, and more. Read on for details…

[h3]Roads of Avalon Improvements[/h3]
Following player feedback after the Beyond the Veil update, the [b]Roads of Avalon [/b]have undergone some significant changes to improve their playability for all group sizes, including solo players. Avalonian Camps have been rebalanced for [b]different group sizes[/b], and are once again [b]marked by a chest icon [/b]on the map. Furthermore, mobs surrounding chests in the Roads will [b]upgrade in line with the chests[/b], and with each upgrade all dead mobs around the chest will [b]respawn[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/373090e22886d1b1f596d5ff83ca85a85323d9da.jpeg[/img]

These changes should make the Roads more appealing to a wider range of players, and in turn ensure they’re a lively, well-populated part of Albion. And alongside these improvements, the Roads have received a long-awaited [b]visual overhaul[/b], making them more aesthetically in-tune with the rest of Albion while highlighting their unique character.

[h3]Streamer Mode[/h3]
To improve the experience of those who stream Albion, as well as their viewers, a new [b]Streamer Mode [/b]has been introduced. This can be toggled on and off in the Settings menu, and when activated hides certain UI features that can identify the streamer’s location to viewers. This will help streamers avoid stream-snipers while broadcasting, as well as hide login details when disconnected.

[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Changes to the [b]home removal debuff[/b], allowing more freedom for small-scale travel[/*]	[*]Various [b]Combat Balance changes[/b][/*]	[*]New [b]Crystal Realm map [/b]for Season 18[/*]	[*]… and more[/*][/list]For a complete list of changes, see the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/beyond-the-veil-patch-3][b]official patch notes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Into the Fray Patch 6 is Live
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/21aa301c72b57f409c428bdb9abd2aea52911c23.jpeg[/img]

[b]Into the Fray Patch 6[/b] is here! This patch brings [b]Japanese[/b] and[b] Italian [/b]language support, introduces a brand-new[b] Guild Finder[/b], and more. Read on for a summary…

[h3]Japanese and Italian Added[/h3]
This patch expands Albion Online’s supported languages to include Japanese and Italian, with the game now [b]fully playable[/b] in both of these languages. It also includes dedicated[b] in-game chat [/b]channels for each language, and new [b]language-specific subforums[/b]. All articles and patchnotes will now be translated into these languages to keep you fully updated, and if you wish to change the language in which you receive our newsletters you can update this in your [url=https://albiononline.com/profile][b]Account Settings[/b][/url]].

We hope to make playing Albion Online a more immersive and user-friendly experience for our existing Japanese and Italian-speaking players. And to those who are joining the game for the first time now:[b] welcome[/b]!

[h3]Guild Finder[/h3]
Along with new languages, this patch brings a massive new quality-of-life improvement: a brand-new [b]Guild Finder[/b]!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c0382c2d79f31c3784e4999981282473b4c6e54e.png[/img]

Players will be able to search for a specific guild by name, or browse guilds by filters such as language, time zone and activity. And if you’re a guild member looking to recruit, you can set criteria by which players can easily find you and apply for membership - or join directly if you prefer. This feature will help beginners and experienced players alike to team up and access Albion’s high-level content together. Please note that the Guild Finder wil not be available immediately, but we'll announce once it's fully up and running.

[h3]Guild Season Changes[/h3]
Albion’s seventeenth Guild Season is coming [b]September 17[/b], with some important changes. The [b]Crystal Arena[/b] ranking system will include more substeps than previously, and players will no longer rank down completely at the end of a season. [b]Headquarters Hideouts[/b] boosters will be more easily accessible to guilds, making it easier for new guilds to establish an Outlands HQ. Open-world [b]Treasure Chests[/b] will generally contain greater loot, in order to make them more rewarding for all players. And additionally, there will be quality-of-life improvements to [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b] and the [b]Guild Rewards[/b] system.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c81256d50c64dac5b47f5906ebe6dd8b59e82abe.jpeg[/img]

For full details of the Season 17 changes and rewards, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/168529][b]this forum post[/b][/url].

For more detailed patchnotes, [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/into-the-fray-patch-6][b]click here[/b][/url].

notes.title: Dev Talk: Development Update
notes.notes:
It's been a while since our last Dev Talk, and many of you have been eagerly awaiting updates. In our newest video, Game Director [b]Robin Henkys[/b] introduces some of the major new features coming to Albion with the next content update, including changes to the [b]Roads of Avalon[/b], a massive new feature called the [b]Mists[/b], and a [b]new line of artifacts[/b] for trade and crafting.

[previewyoutube=HKS-6vuo7SA;full][/previewyoutube]
Prefer a written summary? Then read on…
[h3]Roads of Avalon Changes[/h3]
Following player feedback, the Roads of Avalon are set to receive a rework in our next major update:
[list]	[*]Roads will be focused on [b]small group gameplay[/b][/*]	[*]It will be [b]easier to establish a Hideout[/b] in the Roads, but more difficult to control an entire Hideout region[/*]	[*]It will be more difficult to control high-value zones, making Roads exploration [b]more competitive and exciting[/b][/*]	[*]Rewards will focus more on group gameplay and [b]enemies that upgrade over time[/b][/*]	[*]The Roads will also receive a [b]visual update[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d6756d06967d9fedf7b490c242db5e997a4f7470.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]The Mists[/h3]
The Mists will be a brand-new environment with its own gameplay possibilities:
[list]	[*]Accessed via a network of [b]unpredictable and temporary connections[/b], like the Roads[/*]	[*]Each entrance will only allow a [b]single player[/b] to enter before it disappears[/*]	[*]A single Mists region will have [b]multiple entrances[/b], allowing for chance encounters between solo players[/*]	[*]Gameplay will be a mixture of[b] solo PvE and solo PvP[/b], with an emphasis on exploration and risk-taking[/*]	[*]Visually and thematically will be the most magical area of Albion so far, with [b]all-new music[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/02b333906ff606f4dae630093be749991d90e303.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]New Artifacts and Items[/h3][list]	[*]Within the Mists players can encounter a new range of [b]fantastical creatures[/b][/*]	[*]These drop [b]new artifacts[/b] that can be used to craft[b] brand-new items[/b][/*]	[*]The items needed to craft these new items are [b]unique to these creatures[/b] in the Mists, adding new dimensions to trading, crafting, and PvE[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/69f4e4eaf82f5fa6bb16e6275ab50f4ff441757e.jpeg[/img]
[h3]The City in the Mists[/h3]
A new City exists within the Mists, acting as a hub for trading and other activities:
[list]	[*]This City has [b]no fixed, physical location[/b], but can be said to ‘drift’ in the Mists[/*]	[*]Entrances can sometimes be found in the Mists and the Roads, but [b]not all will be able to enter[/b][/*]	[*]This City will offer [b]instant access[/b] to the Roads, Mists, and other forms of small-scale content that can be encountered elsewhere[/*]	[*]It will serve as an ideal base for advanced[b] solo and small group adventurers[/b][/*][/list]
[b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c37782425d148845babc250e70d4ae183a1eb541.jpeg[/img][/b]

We hope you enjoyed this glimpse at some of the forthcoming features we’re working on, and we can’t wait for you to try them out and discover exciting new ways to play. We’ll be going into further detail about these in future Dev Talks - and until then, see you in Albion!

notes.title: The Arcane and Frost Patch is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/449fc025c76ca24f953313257d2a2b0da39d4ccf.jpeg[/img]

Into the Fray Patch 4, AKA The [b]Arcane and Frost Patch,[/b] is here! This patch brings the long-awaited reworks to the final two Magic Staff lines, as well as unveiling a new season winner statue, introducing changes to Black Zone looting, and much more. Read on for details…

[h3]Magic Staff Overhaul: Arcane and Frost Staffs[/h3]
This patch completes the overhaul of the [b]Magic Staffs[/b] weapon line that was kicked off with the Into the Fray update. With entirely revamped visuals and animations, along with new and reworked abilities, Arcane and Frost players will enjoy a fully refreshed and revitalized combat experience. For full details of the spell changes, see the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/into-the-fray-patch-4][b]patchnotes[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/13b2b791c7af4cae263b27cdd0ab2537b3444732.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Season 15 Winner Statue Unveiled[/h3]
With the statues safely back home in Conquerors’ Hall following the Living Legacy event, a new face has joined them! So congratulations to Season 15 winners [b]Elevate[/b], whose statue now sits at the entrance to the Hall, along with the banners for second and third-place guilds [b]Team Pilas [/b]and [b]RAQ[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5f69916ffc44f14f6619ae81fc495a0fc397ca66.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Black Zone Looting Changes[/h3]
To give active PvP participants a better chance at gaining and keeping the spoils of their battles, changes have been made to loot restrictions in the Black Zone. For the first 90 seconds after a black-zone kill, the dead player can only be looted by their own allies, the player who dealt the killing blow and their allies, or the player who dealt most damage and their allies. After 90 seconds anyone can collect the loot again.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/cff1ed74346af6eb8c7032e9e161e8606ddddaae.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Updated Building Nutrition and Trade UIs[/*]	[*]Might from Castle and Outpost Chests now distributed in a wider radius[/*]	[*]Buffer zones added around open-world furniture[/*]	[*]… and more[/*][/list]
For a full list of changes, read the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/into-the-fray-patch-4][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Into the Fray Patch 3 is Live!
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2b2b6ab34b500873d69a1b9158c081f878986fa4.jpeg[/img]

Into the Fray Patch 3 is live! This patch brings changes and improvements to the [b]Arena and Crystal Arena[/b], [b]Training Dummies[/b], the [b]Journey Back[/b] ability, and more. Read on for details…
[h3]Arena & Crystal Arena Changes[/h3]
This patch brings some refinements to the Crystal Arena, with [b]Rank Point calculations[/b] adjusted to better place players in an appropriate rank bracket, and Crystal Arena matchmaking now matching players of a similar ranking. Additionally, Arena losses now give fewer Adventurer’s Challenge points, to ensure players cannot reach their daily bonus with one Arena defeat. And Arena rewards are now displayed at the end of a match.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/243d7dd1ebda095f6ae5c0216646bbdddb1ac43f.png[/img]
[h3]Training Dummy UI[/h3]
[b]Training Dummies[/b] now display a small UI when being attacked or healed which displays useful information, as follows:
[list]	[*]Total Damage / Total Healing[/*]	[*]Damage Per Second / Healing Per Second[/*]	[*]Last Hit Damage / Last Heal Healing[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b8cdfcea33210d2d2e5457ee1f6c39972b48a1e1.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Journey Back Ability Changes[/h3]
Some important changes have been made to the [b]Journey Back cost calculation[/b] in this patch:
[list]	[*]It now uses the [b]average zone modifier[/b] for the zones you would have traveled through, rather than only the zone you are currently in[/*]	[*]It uses what would be the [b]cheapest route[/b], rather than the shortest[/*][/list]
To balance these cost reductions, zone type and item value now have a greater impact, while distance has less effect on the cost.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2acec2eb6c905cff3bdd79bdf9928c2872bcfba3.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*][b]Access rights[/b] after undeclaring a Headquarters Hideout are now restricted for 7 days, rather than 14[/*]	[*][b]Rare Castle and Castle Outpost chests[/b] will no longer reroll their rarity, and simply be Rare[/*]	[*]Various [b]mobile[/b] optimizations and fixes[/*]	[*]…and more[/*][/list]
For a full rundown of all the changes in this patch, check the official [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/into-the-fray-patch-3][b]patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Into the Fray Patch 2 is Here
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5368aafa7c820964d76b4140bc50d9b6f6042c4b.jpeg[/img]

Into the Fray Patch 2 is live! This patch brings updates to the Crystal League, some significant UI and audio improvements, a number of combat balance changes, and more. Read on for a summary…

[h3]Crystal League Changes[/h3]
Time slots for Crystal League battles have been updated with this patch, for non-lethal 5v5 and for Levels 1-3 20v20. Level 2 and 3 tokens for both the Lethal and non-Lethal League can once again be purchased from the Energy Manipulator, and old Level 2 and 3 tokens can be used again. Season-bound Level 2 and 3 tokens can be salvaged for their Silver purchase price, while Level 4 and 5 tokens are tradable again.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/911dcd27d7137fdd26c387fa91f61c00ba76c281.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
This patch continues to add to the significant quality-of-life improvements introduced since the Into the Fray update, with new changes including:
[list]	[*]Laborer Journals can now be purchased in bulk[/*]	[*]Active gathering yields are now displayed in the Character Details UI[/*]	[*]Daily Production Bonuses (from Dynamic Events) are now included in the Local Production Bonuses UI on the zone map[/*]	[*]Sounds created by remote players in Cities, particularly chests and player/mount footsteps, have been reduced[/*]	[*]…and more[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3f62750de37449b1711f0b1a93cc50fb439ded80.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
Improvements have been made to some of the reworked Magic Staff abilities, for example:
[list]	[*]Grudge (Cursed Staffs) Damage has been increased, and the Cursed Tar hit delay reduced[/*]	[*]Thorns (Nature Staffs) area Damage has been increased, and the Rejuvenating Flower growth interval reduced[/*][/list]Additionally, Corrupted Dungeons have seen adjustments, with Mephits made more effective at preventing players from kiting excessively. Some heavily used weapons in this game mode  have also been toned down to diversify the meta here.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fcc72c82b96e35b64638626f2421961e1488b758.jpeg[/img]

[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Castle chests now include rarity effects on the world map[/*]	[*]Castle world map icons now indicate when they are under attack[/*]	[*]Crystal Arena rank icons now display a tooltip showing ranking points[/*]	[*]…and more[/*][/list]For a full rundown of all the changes in this patch, check the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/changelog/into-the-fray-patch-2][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Dev Talk: Castle Changes and Dynamic Events
notes.notes:
[url=https://albiononline.com/update/into-the-fray][b]Into the Fray[/b][/url], Albion's next major content update, launches on [b]June 8[/b]. In our last Dev Talk before the update goes live, Game Director Robin Henkys discusses the huge changes coming to [b]Castles[/b], the new [b]Dynamic Events[/b] system, and [b]Twitch Drops[/b], which include [b]Victory Emotes[/b].

[previewyoutube=hanVARdLGug;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Castles[/h3]
Castles have been an iconic element of Albion Online since the early Alpha. With Albion’s Fifth Anniversary coming up, they have been reworked to make them even more fun and appealing:
[list]	[*][b]Overhauled graphics[/b]: new gates and destruction effects, new interiors[/*]	[*][b]New layouts[/b] allowing for more varied tactics and multiple fronts (2 different layouts depending on biome)[/*]	[*][b]Demolition Hammers[/b] now used directly from inventory like tools, capture mechanics now similar to Faction Outposts[/*]	[*][b]Updated rewards[/b]: instead of scoring Season Points regularly, Castles and Outposts now have a chance to spawn chests regularly[/*]	[*]Chests provide [b]Might [/b]and update a guild's Might Level, generating Season Points and creating new opportunities for smaller guilds[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ca4e313ffea095c193f7333ae9d6a0d3eef5a2c3.jpeg[/img]

All in all, you can look forward to more action around Castles all throughout the week – and if you liked the previous system, the massive weekend loot chests remain in place.

[h3]Dynamic Events[/h3]
A new Activities UI provides a one-stop overview of all the game's timed activities. It offers two event types:

[b]1. Activity Events[/b]
[list]	[*]Shown in the upper left[/*]	[*]Give temporary bonuses to existing activities (e.g. Fame in Randomized Dungeons, increased Faction Points, Fame and Loot in Hellgates)[/*]	[*]These bonuses are randomized and last several days, with the next bonuses visible 24 hours in advance[/*][/list][url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/08821041942600616b87f0bd0c1c62e9ad229c45.jpeg][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/7a375319923ffac73c62adc9c5b4b7d20bd81c82.jpeg[/img][/url]

[b]2. Daily Production Bonuses [/b]
[list]	[*]Shown in the upper right[/*]	[*]Give daily changing production bonuses to two different item or resource lines[/*]	[*]Globally increase resource return rates for producing these items on that day[/*]	[*]Bonus is usually moderate, but on rare occasions can become significant[/*]	[*]Rewards crafters for diversifying their crafting capabilities, adds additional market fluctuations for traders[/*][/list]We’re very much looking forward to seeing how both Activity Events and Daily Production Bonuses affect daily life in Albion, as we have many ideas for how we could expand on these concepts in the future.

[h3]Twitch Drops[/h3]
Albion Online has a dedicated group of content creators, and to support them and grow the Albion Online community, we’ve integrated [b]Twitch Drops[/b].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/8c8bd4a65a83957a5104fa33668041b742bf3a83.jpeg[/img]
[list]	[*]Players can link their Twitch account to their Albion account and earn rewards for watching official content creators[/*]	[*]Up to 7 Community Reward Chests can be earned per week – contain a wide variety of vanity items and unlocks[/*]	[*]Unlocks include existing vanity skins and entirely new exclusive variations[/*]	[*]Can be salvaged into Community Tokens, which can be spent at the Vanity Merchant in each 'y[/*][/list][h3]Victory Emotes[/h3]
Victory Emotes are a new type of audio-visual expression of your victory over another player, played at the location of your defeated opponent at the moment of your victory.
[list]	[*]Each time an emote is played, it consumes a single charge[/*]	[*]Charges can be earned from Community Chests, crafted with Community Tokens, or bought with Gold[/*]	[*]Premium players can also trade Victory Emote Charges earned from Community Chests via the in-game marketplace[/*]	[*]Launching with a small selection, will be expanded in the future[/*]	[*]Can be turned off in Settings at any time.[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e06f5b8bbd7792335d3c1abc1122e8cdeb052f69.jpeg[/img]

And with that we conclude our look at the features coming to Albion Online with the “Into the Fray” Update. We’re very ex'ed about all the improvements coming to Albion Online with this update and are looking forward to seeing you in-game on June 8th, when “Into the Fray” releases.

notes.title: Lands Awakened Patch 8 is Here
notes.notes:

[b]Lands Awakened Patch 8[/b] is here! This patch brings extensive [b]combat balance changes[/b], improved [b]Arena matchmaking[/b], and more. Read on for details…

[h3]New Season Winner Statue[/h3]
First up, there’s a new face in Conquerors’ Hall! You can now check out the statue dedicated to [b]IAMNIUBI[/b], who claimed their first crown in [b]Season 14[/b]. The banners of 2nd and 3rd-place runners up [b]Elevate[/b] and [b]Judicate[/b] are also now on display.

[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
This patch brings far-reaching combat balance adjustments, to overhaul some underused weapons and abilities and help others to perform better in the current meta.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0c80143a9d4961703c81dce0da5be1dcc3087d6f.jpeg[/img]

Here are some of the changes:

Various changes have been made to the [b]Arena matchmaking system[/b] in order to speed up the formation of teams in queues. Solo DPS players in particular should see their waiting times significantly reduced.

[h3]Controller Support Beta[/h3]
This patch marks the beginning of [b]controller support testing[/b], which will be optimized over the coming months. Players will be able to use Xbox controllers, Playstation Dualshock, and other PC-compatible controllers with the game. Additionally, Steam players will be able to use the [b]Steam Deck[/b]. [b]Lands Awakened Patch 4[/b] is now live! This patch brings some important quality-of-life improvements, extensive combat balance changes, adjustments to Static Dungeon mobs, and much more. Read on for details…
[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]
This patch sees some very welcome quality-of-life improvements introduced, for example:
[list]	[*][b]Party markers[/b] now persist when changing zones[/*]	[*]An overhead message displays when the [b]effects of food[/b] expire[/*]	[*][b]Silver piles[/b] now behave like loot bags with their visual effects, no longer showing the "rising particle" effect until lootable[/*]	[*]Certain visuals in [b]Royal Cities [/b]have been reworked and improved, in line with the reworked biomes that came with the Lands Awakened update[/*]	[*][b]And much more…[/b][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a1beb4113d9b9ca55690c3cb45dadfe3b123b690.jpeg[/img][h3]Static Dungeon Mob Rebalancing[/h3]
In order to better balance the performance of certain Static Dungeon mobs, and allow more counterplay opportunities, some adjustments have been made to their abilities. For example:

In light of these adjustments, changes have also been made to some weapons and armors - such as [b]Cursed Staff[/b] and [b]Cleric Robe[/b] - in order to keep their gameplay fair and competitive.

Numerous further changes have also been made, including:
[list]	[*]Various [b]War Glove E-abilities[/b] improved[/*]	[*][b]Rain of Arrows[/b] channel duration decreased and damage increased[/*]	[*][b]Capes [/b]with effects triggered by auto-attacks no longer activate while Hostile Dismount status is active[/*][/list]
