notes.title: Lands Awakened Patch 1 is Here
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f059da297d41e97c2281c3fad8b28b619a271aec.jpeg[/img]

The first [b]Lands Awakened[/b] patch is now live! This patch updates the requirements for Headquarters Hideouts, brings combat balance changes to War Gloves, Maces and other weapons, introduces UI improvements and guild invite spam protections, and much more. Here’s a summary of what’s new:

[h3]Headquarters Hideout Requirements Updated[/h3]
The requirements for declaring a [b]Headquarters Hideout[/b] have been updated. Most notably, you can now designate a Headquarters immediately when the Season Point threshold has been reached - you no longer need to wait until the following season to declare a Headquarters. Furthermore, the top-600 ranking requirement has been removed.

For more details, as well as the current point requirements by zone quality and tier, see this forum post: [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/157670]https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/157670[/url]

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5bb077a829cf483d2091ea993245a7364d8303a6.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Energy Surge Season Winner Statues Unveiled[/h3]
The winners of the standalone [b]Energy Surge Season[/b] have had their statues unveiled, and this time they are placed in the open-world! Here are the winners and where you can find their statues:
[list]	[*]First Place:[b] The Lonely Men, Redtree Enclave[/b][/*]	[*]Second Place:[b] Hadoop, Drybasin Oasis[/b][/*]	[*]Third Place:[b] Be Careful, Sunstrand Quicksands[/b][/*][/list][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/28bd1e7af72aa89598e81cba9c91eafddc209f19.jpeg[/img][/b]
[h3]New Guild Invite Spam Protections[/h3]
To prevent players from being spammed with guild invitations, a limit has been placed on how many invitations can be sent out at a time. In addition, sending too many declined guild invitations in a short space of time now applies a guild-wide cooldown on sending invitations. Along with these changes, there is also clearer feedback on whether a guild invitation has been accepted or rejected.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0c80143a9d4961703c81dce0da5be1dcc3087d6f.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
With Lands Awakened having introduced a brand-new weapon line in [b]War Gloves[/b], Patch 1 makes some slight adjustments to ensure they are competitive in the combat meta, with a broad range of abilities across the line improved. [b]Maces[/b] have also been adjusted so that they don’t clearly outperform other, similar weapon types, with the Threatening Smash and Deep Leap abilities reworked somewhat.

Further changes:
[list]	[*]Whirlwind (Great Axes) speed increase removed[/*]	[*]Blood Ritual (Demonfang) self-damage decreased[/*]	[*]Channel time to enter a Hideout increased[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ad323966dfef6ab733acfe1f0fca9f9c15d60902.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Introduced a [b]Static Dungeon UI[/b] showing mob types and tiers[/*]	[*][b]Adventurer’s Challenge Daily Bonus[/b] upgraded to an Adept’s Tome of Insight (10,000 Fame)[/*]	[*][b]Hideout Power Levels[/b] are now viewable in the Guild Estates UI[/*]	[*][b]Power Cores and Energy Crystals[/b] can be carried through Passages in the Outlands[/*]	[*]…and much more[/*][/list]As always, you can read the full list of changes in the [b][url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/LANDS%20AWAKENED%20PATCH%201]official patchnotes[/url][/b].

notes.title: The Lands Awakened Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/609572c88c45d10ef11f0069d8fd8cab05ad9416.jpeg[/img]

The massive [b]Lands Awakened[/b] update is now live! This update brings a new era of [b]open-world gameplay[/b] to Albion with reworked [b]dungeons, mobs,[/b] and [b]treasure sites[/b], new open-world [b]PvP objectives[/b] for groups of all sizes, hugely improved [b]visuals and layouts[/b] for all five biomes, [b]War Gloves[/b], reworked [b]Guild Seasons[/b], numerous [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b], and much more.

To celebrate the occasion, we've created a brand-new trailer:

[previewyoutube=0GksQhov0kY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Reinvigorating Albion's Open World[/h3]
Lands Awakened brings a completely overhauled open-world experience, including [b]massively improved visuals and layouts[/b] in all five biomes, mobs that become [b]stronger and more rewarding[/b] over time, reworked [b]static dungeons[/b], and [b]treasure sites[/b] that spawn randomly throughout the world. Whether you're a brand-new player or a seasoned veteran, Albion's lands are home to countless new opportunities awaiting discovery.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bda0aec195dfd1d9d5260a4b3b69f5a8aaa1c57e.jpeg[/img][h3]New Weapons, Elite Levels, Faster Fame[/h3]
The all-new [b]War Gloves[/b] offer thrilling brawler-style combat for small-, medium-, and large-scale fights, along with numerous options for PvE. [b]Elite Levels[/b] add twenty additional mastery levels to each weapon and armor piece, with corresponding medals to let you show off your accomplishments. And the amount of [b]Fame [/b]granted for nearly all activities has been boosted significantly, shortening the time needed to unlock new skills and rewarding perseverant players.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/e114239ebd87303075e7a3a1f7c4f26287bce247.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Reworked Guild Seasons[/h3]
[b]Power Cores[/b] and [b]Energy Crystals[/b] introduce open-world capture-the-flag gameplay with huge rewards. [b]Headquarters Hideouts[/b] offer protected bases for dedicated guilds. And the [b]Conqueror's Challenge[/b] allows all players to earn [b]Might[/b] and [b]Favor[/b] for a wide range of activities, unlocking rewards for themselves and their guilds. Overall, Lands Awakened shifts the focus of Guild Seasons from passive territory control to active personal progress, offering dedicated players and guilds a chance at massive rewards.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d764348ff614f2576fbd26aff42e198a63d79195.jpeg[/img]
[h3]The Druid Vanity Bundle is Here[/h3]
The Lands Awakened update also brings the new [b]Druid Vanity Bundle.[/b] This premiere bundle is available in the in-game store, and includes a full [b]costume set[/b] plus a matching [b]Stag mount skin[/b]. The costume skins feature a thick, forest-green cape and a crown of antlers, and both the costume and mount skins are decorated with a glowing aura of fireflies.

The Druid Bundle includes the following vanity skins, which work on male and female characters alike:
[list]	[*][b]Druid's Horns[/b][/*]	[*][b]Druid's Garments[/b][/*]	[*][b]Druid's Shoes[/b][/*]	[*][b]Druid's Cape[/b][/*]	[*][b]Druid's Stag[/b][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0a4b4dd48c81535e3dda49c3187553fdd0c8b085.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Additional Improvements[/h3][list]	[*][b]Loadouts[/b] can now be purchased directly from the Marketplace[/*]	[*][b]Large resource nodes[/b] now spawn as treasure sites, appearing on the map to those nearby[/*]	[*]Improvements to [b]farming, rerolling,[/b] [b]building fees,[/b] and [b]party commands[/b][/*]	[*]Numerous [b]combat balance changes[/b][/*]	[*]Massively expanded [b]soundtrack[/b] with 17 new tracks[/*]	[*][b]Real estate plots[/b] added to Outlands towns[/*]	[*]New [b]Artifact resources[/b][/*]	[*]Bug fixes, mobile optimizations, new icons and achievements, and much more[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/650daa1653ea2fd2686be761a3b392de15f0d42b.jpeg[/img]

For more details, check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/update/lands-awakened][b]official update page[/b][/url] or the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/LANDS%20AWAKENED%20UPDATE][b]update patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Season 14 Brings Big Changes
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9a118fb11509f9409491df69452668baaa884588.jpeg[/img]

The [b]Lands Awakened[/b] update goes live on November 24, bringing revamped open-world visuals and gameplay, the new War Gloves weapon line, Elite Levels for weapon mastery, numerous quality-of-life improvements, and more. Alongside these changes, the update also ushers in a new era of [b]guild warfare[/b], with a completely new Guild Season structure that offers countless ways for resourceful players of all types to make seasonal progress and earn rewards, even those not affiliated with a guild. Traditional guild activities such as territory control and ZvZs will still provide a path to success, but individual players – and their guilds in turn – will also benefit from playing other smaller-scale activities.
[list]	[*]For the complete Season 14 Schedule, click [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/157080][b]here[/b][/url].[/*]	[*]For a detailed breakdown of the changes listed in this article, and the reasoning behind them, see [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/157165][b]this forum post[/b][/url].[/*][/list][h3]Introducing the Conqueror's Challenge[/h3]
To make Guild Seasons more about player activity and less about territory control and passive income, this season introduces the [b]Conquerors' Challenge[/b]. This dynamic, season-long system for tracking progress opens Albion's higher-level activities to guild members and non-guild-affiliated players alike, and introduces two new reward systems, [b]Might [/b]and [b]Favor[/b] (details below).

The Conqueror's Challenge offers players the freedom to earn Season Rewards in countless different ways, with a wide range of activities contributing to progress. Ultimately, any player willing to put in the work during a season will have a chance to unlock some of the most valuable and powerful rewards in the game.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d25b9963083e64ab69ab3843b78aa11bf4fd2f37.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Might, Favor, and Might Levels[/h3]
As part of the revamped Guild Seasons, this season brings two new concepts to the game: [b]Might[/b] and [b]Favor[/b], which measure the success of individuals and guilds during the season and unlock fantastic rewards.
[list]	[*][b]Might[/b] is earned by participating in [b]activities which carry the risk of PvP[/b], and allows players to progress towards personal season goals and unlock valuable rewards like battle mounts and unique avatars.[/*]	[*][b]Favor[/b] is a [b]new currency[/b] which is also earned in most cases where Might is earned, and can be used to purchase Siphoned Energy and additional reward chests.[/*][/list]Alongside personal Might, guild-affiliated players’ activities will contribute towards their [b]Guild Might Level[/b], which rewards guilds with Season Points, and their members with further Might and Might Boosts.

Additionally, a new [b]Season Overview UI[/b] will show a guild’s current rank, how its Season Points were earned, and which members contributed the most Might.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/56e038db5c878e8407dc56386a7290c4f8c3ed2c.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Headquarters Hideouts, Power Cores and Energy Crystals[/h3]
To further encourage exciting power struggles in the Outlands and keep things competitive for smaller guilds, [b]Headquarters Hideouts[/b] have been introduced. Earning enough Season Points in the preceding season allows a guild to designate one of its Outlands Hideouts as an HQ, making it invulnerable. This status must be maintained, however, through capturing new [b]Power Cores[/b] as they appear across the landscape. Alongside [b]Energy Crystals[/b], which can be used to boost Territories, this will bring a whole new dynamic and competitive edge to Guild Seasons. For more information on these new features, see this [url=https://albiononline.com/news/devtalk-guild-season-changes][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url].

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/79d9996b72126f15186ee89902023cb5812fabbf.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Additional Season 14 Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Killing Siphoning Mages, Crystal Spiders, etc. no longer directly gives Season Points, as these are now earned through the corresponding Might Levels[/*]	[*]Territory levels rebalanced[/*]	[*]Castles, Castle Outposts, and Guild Challenge no longer grant Siphoned Energy[/*]	[*]Crystal League rewards rebalanced, Season Rewards now based on Conqueror's Challenge[/*][/list]

notes.title: Dev Talk: Guild Season Changes
notes.notes:
The [url=https://albiononline.com/update/lands-awakened][b]Lands Awakened update[/b][/url] arrives November 24, bringing massive open-world changes, a new weapon line, an updated soundtrack, and more. In today's Dev Talk, Game Director Robin Henkys discusses the huge changes coming to [b]Guild Seasons[/b] with this update.

[previewyoutube=sg-6Ho_Wuyk;full][/previewyoutube]
No time to watch the video? Read on for a summary...
[h3]Primary Goals[/h3][list]	[*]Allow players to earn Season Points for their guild via [b]small-scale activities[/b][/*]	[*]Grant [b]personal as well as guild rewards [/b]for making progress[/*]	[*]Shift the focus of Guild Seasons from [b]passive territory control[/b] to [b]player activity[/b][/*][/list][h3]Conqueror's Challenge[/h3][list]	[*]The Conqueror's Challenge replaces the existing Guild Season reward system[/*]	[*]Runs for the duration of a Guild Season[/*]	[*]Available to all Premium players, whether in a guild or not[/*]	[*]Uses a new type of points called [b]“Might”[/b][/*]	[*]Earning Might unlocks powerful and unique rewards, including new Seasonal Avatars for multiple levels, Battle Mounts, and Fame Boosts[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/72f229fce20c299ff3896efe85d41b3390267d79.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Might[/h3]
Might is earned by participating in activities with a [b]risk of PvP[/b]:
[list]	[*]Killing mobs / gathering in the Outlands or Roads of Avalon[/*]	[*]Opening Treasure chests[/*]	[*]Killing Siphoning Mages / Crystal Spiders[/*]	[*]Playing Hellgates / Crystal League[/*]	[*]Winning Corrupted Dungeon matches[/*]	[*]Capturing Territory Energy Crystals (see below)[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/defec3b9fc06fdf1286cb1d88c07d172d2eee797.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Favor[/h3][list]	[*]When a player earns Might, in most cases they will also earn [b]Favor[/b][/*]	[*]Favor is a [b]currency[/b] which can be used to purchase Siphoned Energy and additional reward chests[/*]	[*]Favor thus offers a [b]direct economic benefit[/b] to earning Might[/*][/list][h3]Guild Might Levels[/h3]
As players earn Might and Favor for themselves, they contribute to another new feature, [b]Guild Might Levels[/b]:
[list]	[*]Guilds earn Season Points for each Might Level they complete[/*]	[*]All members contribute to these together[/*]	[*]Each activity has its own Might progress, allowing players numerous ways to contribute while earning Might and Favor for themselves[/*][/list]
[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/543422fd66df70244fe57f72b3344ff244c18439.jpeg][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d66d0ef12d8fa7e1c7cfca0fd52225ebd9441f3e.jpeg[/img][/url]

Guild Might Levels in turn benefit guild members:
[list]	[*]With each new bracket unlocked, members are rewarded with a significant amount of [b]personal Might[/b][/*]	[*]Members also get a [b]bonus [/b]to Might generated for the rest of the season[/*]	[*]A new Season Overview allows players to see their guild’s current ranking, where its Season points came from, and which players contributed the most Might[/*][/list][h3]Energy Vortices[/h3][list]	[*]Like Open World Treasures, these spawn unpredictably in the Outlands[/*]	[*]Marked on the world and local map for everyone within a few regions[/*]	[*]After a time dependent on its strength, the storm dissipates, dropping a [b]Territory Energy Crystal[/b][/*]	[*]Crystals can be picked up and carried on foot to an owned territory[/*]	[*]Crystals transported successfully can be "captured" at the Tower[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/63a5a92eb9e90860b6a94940222dcda52cef40c6.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Territory Energy Levels[/h3]
[b]Captured Crystals[/b] boost the Territory's energy, which:
[list]	[*]Increases its Tower level[/*]	[*]Improves the rate at which Siphoned Energy and Season Points are generated[/*]	[*]Boosts guard strength[/*]	[*]Boosts enchanted resource spawn rate / gathering yield in the zone[/*][/list]Over time, Territory energy diminishes, so guilds must remain active to get maximum Territory benefits. [b]Crystal League Matches[/b] played from Territory towers continue to supplement energy as well.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ec893664b00fb6557de69c84e620371e83a4b3cf.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Territory Rebalancing[/h3]
To encourage active Outlands play, Territories now generate far fewer Season Points if they are low on energy, but have a much higher maximum potential if they stay at maximum level. Season success is thus less dependent on passive income, instead requiring guilds to remain active around their Territories. Of course, players participating in this are also rewarded with significant Might and Favor themselves.
[h3]In Summary[/h3]
The [b]Conqueror’s Challenge, Might Levels[/b] and [b]Energy Vortices[/b] allow players to push their guild towards victory with smaller-scale activities, while earning rewards for themselves and enjoying new [b]open-world PvP objectives[/b].

Stay tuned for the next Dev Talks, where we'll discuss Headquarters Hideouts, Power Cores, War Gloves and more!

notes.title: Call to Arms Patch 11 is Here
notes.notes:
Call to Arms Patch 11 is live! This patch brings substantial combat balance changes, improvements to the Black Zone map display and Faction Warfare UI, and more. Read on for details...

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/242d972fdb91518d8e10467f95fa0b3fe66c79c1.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
Combat balance changes are a major focus of this patch, with numerous weapon line updates. In particular, there’s an emphasis on diversifying the ZvZ meta, with improvements to long-overlooked weapons and adjustments to some already popular ones to keep group fights fair and exciting. Here are just some of the changes:
[list]	[*][b]Maces: [/b]To increase their tank potential, Maces have been reworked: Guard Rune makes allies immune to knockback or stun; Slow added to Sacred Ground; Battle Howl cooldown reduced[/*]	[*][b]Mounts: [/b]Tower Chariots reworked to increase their support appeal: Health Factor increased; standtime removed from Energy Cloud; Toxic Crystal Waste standtime decreased[/*]	[*][b]Staffs:[/b] Numerous updates to Arcane, Cursed, Fire, Holy and Nature Staffs[/*]	[*][b]Swords:[/b] Re-buffed Galatine Pair to increase its appeal for ZvZ; Crescent Slash multi-stack effects increased[/*]	[*][b]Hammers: [/b]Iron Breaker and Power Geyser rebalanced; Tackle stun duration reduced[/*]	[*][b]...and much more[/b][/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b30997d30af473a9c4cdcbb63a0bf64be9ef35b3.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Black Zone Map Improvements[/h3]
Black Zone map headers now display the [b]Zone Quality Level[/b] when you hover over them. Since this determines the season point multipliers for Territories, Castles, Castle Outposts and mobs, as well as Energy Storage by territory, this change allows this important information to be easily obtained via the ingame UI.

[url=//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/46432f49924ce8a9105701440194499392ad8392.png][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/0c5adf984966ef6e11def3c602048ab6469e431a.jpeg[/img][/url]
[h3]Other Changes and Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]To better reflect the current state of play, [b]Faction Warfare Player Rankings[/b] have been adjusted to only show players who have been active within the previous week.[/*]	[*]The Season 13 Winner Statue for [b]Blue Army[/b] is now in Conquerors’ Hall, and Season Winner Furniture Items are now placeable.[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/93b0b4e2a682f52c44d51174815a8309d1912ab8.jpeg[/img]

As always, you can read the complete list of changes in the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/CALL%20TO%20ARMS%20PATCH%2011][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Call to Arms Patch 10 is Here
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b600e134d677a8c7cea00e91848e05798b263ad8.jpeg[/img]

The [url=https://albiononline.com/news/energy-surge][b]Energy Surge Season[/b][/url] starts September 25, featuring a shorter 6-week structure, accelerated point multipliers, and unique one-of-a-kind rewards for the top guilds. In anticipation of this unique standalone season, today's patch brings changes to Guild and Faction Warfare, quality-of-life improvements including new Nametag options and better Usage Fee notifications, and new artifact drops in the open world.
[h3]New Artifacts Added[/h3]
As part of the brand-new [b]War Gloves[/b] weapon line coming with the next major content update, new artifacts have been added to mob and chest drops in the open world.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9c7357c4978fb08e9a5102e86242108125a97171.jpeg[/img]

These artifacts cannot yet be used for crafting, and only appear in limited quantities for now, but they already offer economic and PvE players a new item line to start collecting and trading.

For more on War Gloves and these new artifacts, watch the latest [url=https://albiononline.com/news/devtalk-war-gloves-hq-hideouts][b]Dev Talk[/b][/url].
[h3]Guild and Faction Warfare Changes[/h3][list]	[*]Entering Hideouts now requires a channel for players who have not set the Hideout as Home[/*]	[*]Removed doors of Castle Outposts to make them easier to conquer by smaller groups, reduced warning messages when outposts are under attack[/*]	[*]Level 6 Crystal League Tokens (5v5 and 20v20) are now non-tradable[/*]	[*]Decreased penalties for enlisting with Factions with low recruitment rates, increased value of red zone Faction kills[/*]	[*]Increased values of areas previously owned by non-Caerleon Factions during Bandit Assault[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/817348698287c66736db119ef15733a27550e389.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3][list]	[*]Added option to display guild names of other players without displaying player names, and players flagged to the same Faction now appear as allies[/*]	[*]Added "Tomes" category and "Mount" subcategories to Marketplace[/*]	[*]Popup message now displays when the Usage Fee of a crafting station was recently changed[/*]	[*]When both players in a Corrupted Dungeon are knocked down, get-up time is greatly reduced[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1282f912f22332ac9db77cab28e5cc306ecd0c11.jpeg[/img]

On top of the changes listed above, there are also numerous [b]Combat Balance Changes[/b], [b]bugfixes[/b], and other improvements. As always, you can read the complete list of changes in the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/CALL%20TO%20ARMS%20PATCH%2010][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: The Season 13 Balance Patch is Here
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/78a52766bb7618b5aae346c02f6ec4da3a6c2d6b.jpeg[/img]

Call to Arms Patch 9, AKA the [b]Season 13 Balance Patch[/b], is now live! This patch brings updates to Corrupted Dungeons as well as combat balance changes and quality-of-life improvements galore. Read on for more...
[h3]Corrupted Dungeon Changes[/h3]
To keep combat between different playstyles fair while discouraging endless cooldown resets, several changes have been made to Corrupted Dungeons:
[list]	[*]The new [b]Corrupted Mephit[/b] mob now appears after a set amount of time and debuffs the first player passing it, allowing some time to adjust tactics while discouraging constant disengages[/*]	[*][b]Shrine [/b]must be activated within 45 seconds[/*]	[*][b]Healing Cast[/b] reduced by a further 10%[/*]	[*]All [b]cooldowns [/b]reset at invasion start[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fcc72c82b96e35b64638626f2421961e1488b758.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
This patch includes changes to numerous weapon and armor lines, which are intended to bring some lesser-used items and abilities back into the spotlight and keep combat exciting and fair across a diverse array of builds. Here are just a few of the changes:
[list]	[*][b]Axes[/b]: Bloody Reap reworked into AoE execution tool; Rending Rage and Adrenaline Boost buffed[/*]	[*][b]Daggers[/b]: Deadly Swipe now consumes more energy when used purely for mobility, but is more energy efficient in fights[/*]	[*][b]Fire Staffs[/b]: New Q-ability, [b]Searing Flame[/b], added: shots deal moderate damage, fourth successful shot becomes [b]Furious Flame[/b] for greater damage[/*]	[*][b]Swords[/b]: Mobility increase returned to Heroic Charge, various E-ability cooldowns reduced, Hamstring reworked, new [b]Crescent Slash[/b] ability for Clarent Blade[/*]	[*][b]Armors[/b]: Energy Drain (Royal Armor) no longer steals enemy energy, renamed [b]Energy Source[/b][/*]	[*][b]Shoes[/b]: Royal March improved, effective uptime of Battle Frenzy and Premonition increased[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/817348698287c66736db119ef15733a27550e389.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Hideout, Zone Skipping, and Quality of Life Improvements[/h3][list]	[*][b]Reduced recovery time[/b] of items from destroyed Hideouts, [b]halved[/b] recovery fee[/*]	[*]Overall [b]zone skipping wait times[/b] reduced, as well as the [b]personal [/b]zone skip cooldown[/*]	[*][b]Marketplace notifications[/b] improved with clearer information about orders[/*]	[*]Four new [b]ability icons[/b] added[/*]	[*][b]Guild Season Winner popup[/b] now only shows for 3 days after season end[/*][/list]
As always, you can read the complete list of changes in the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/CALL%20TO%20ARMS%20PATCH%209][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Call to Arms Patch 8 is Here
notes.notes:
Call to Arms Patch 8 is here, bringing a range of improvements and fixes. First up, though, there's a new face in Conquerors' Hall...

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d9da74d35a30282a6bcd59353d7a2f1908057ec9.jpeg[/img]
[h3]New Winner Statue: SUN[/h3]
Congratulations to [b]SUN[/b], winners of Guild Season 12! Check out their brand-new statue at the entrance to Conquerors' Hall in the Royal Cities. The statue also includes guild logos of the second and third place winners, [b]MudHouse[/b] and [b]MAHARLIKA[/b]. While you're there, be sure to pay your respects to past winners on multiple floors, and click on their statues to read their stories.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b83e0f7fec9626e7f6713f3e9f946aebfd955787.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Lethal Hellgate Rewards Increased[/h3]
The Call to Arms update brought new depth and complexity to PvE in Hellgates. To make the PvE experience in higher-risk [b]Lethal Hellgates[/b] more worthwhile, the overall value of chest loot in these Hellgates has been boosted: 
[list]	[*]2v2: +10%[/*]	[*]5v5: +20%[/*]	[*]10v10: +30%[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3bcb3c0d6f4d2ca27e77ed7265b956f8c9fdf39f.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Condensed Marketplace Notifications[/h3]
To reduce the number of Marketplace notifications and make them more meaningful, notifications are now only sent when a Buy or Sell Order is [b]completely fulfilled[/b] or [b]expires[/b]. These mails contain a summary of all relevant transactions in one easily-readable message, letting you check the status of orders on the go without excessive clicks.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/fa7ed396ea3e74ad56f376919f29f37e7e86bc90.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Other Changes and Fixes[/h3][list]	[*]Balance changes to Axes and Maces[/*]	[*]Faction Warfare: improved feedback when capturing Outposts, and Outposts no longer claimable while mounted[/*]	[*]Corrupted Dungeon tutorial popup no longer appears each time a new dungeon is entered[/*]	[*]Various localization, animation, and terrain fixes[/*][/list]
For a complete list of changes, check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/CALL%20TO%20ARMS%20PATCH%208][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Roadmap Update and Mobile Launch Recap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/3c740e523824d650203a8cb5ec19ffbe98683f7b.jpg[/img]

It's been an exciting few weeks for Albion Online: after years of anticipation, the game has officially launched worldwide on the [b]App and Play Stores[/b]. In our newest Dev Talk, Game Director Robin Henkys takes a look back at the mobile launch and gives a preview of some of the big changes coming to Albion with the next major [b]content update[/b].

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VcJcUMVVZyw
Prefer a written summary? Then read on...
[h3]Fulfilling the Cross-Play Promise: Albion Goes Mobile[/h3]
Albion Online's mobile version [b]officially launched June 9[/b], bringing hundreds of thousands of new players to the game. Albion's player population [url=https://albiononline.com/news/albion-onlines-popularity-record-level][b]shattered its previous record[/b][/url] this month, and tens of thousands of new players continue to discover the game daily. For those who have not yet tried the mobile version, the [b]Chimera Mount Skin Cross-Play Reward[/b] remains available for logging into desktop and mobile with the same account.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/dcd0097aef7fb34ddbd4160f0ae1ee2d5054aea6.png[/img]
[list]	[*]For more information about the launch and rewards, and to watch the new live-action trailer, [url=https://albiononline.com/news/mobile-version-out-now][b]click here[/b][/url][/*]	[*]For device requirements and store links, [url=https://albiononline.com/download][b]click here[/b][/url][/*]	[*]Read answers to [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/150321][b]Frequently Asked Questions[/b][/url] about the mobile version[/*][/list]
[b]Guild Season 13[/b] is also now underway, bringing various balance changes and improvements and giving veteran players the chance to show the newcomers how it's done.
[h3]Roadmap: The Next Content Update[/h3]
The next major content update for 2021 has the major overarching theme of bringing [b]open-world gameplay[/b] back to Albion. Note that all features discussed here are still in development, and may change greatly over the coming months.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/045c474d41c6cd5e591882fc48d2d81e9271c626.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Updating Albion's Look and Feel[/h3][list]	[*][b]Biome appearance upgrade:[/b] upgrading old graphics to look cleaner, further defining the visual identity of each biome[/*]	[*]Improving graphics of [b]higher-tier areas[/b] to make these stand out and feel more exciting[/*]	[*]Reworking region [b]layouts[/b], making them easier to navigate while adding strategic choke points for PvP[/*]	[*]Ensuring each biome type has [b]a clear theme[/b] recognizable from the region map[/*][/list][h3]New and Upgraded Activities[/h3][list]	[*][b]Treasure sites[/b] changed from static locations to dynamic spawns, rewarding players for actively roaming the world[/*]	[*][b]Open-world mobs[/b] will also receive a general rework, with a chance to upgrade into stronger versions over time, increasing value of unexplored regions[/*]	[*][b]Upgraded world map[/b] with different overlays which show the current availability of resources and high-value creatures[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/79c990f055477fe19e7d1ca0ab6cefafb290f76a.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Improvements for Veteran Players[/h3][list]	[*][b]Elite levels[/b] which allow players to spend Fame credits to further push weapon specializations[/*]	[*]Mastery levels [b]displayed to others[/b] upon inspection[/*]	[*]New [b]personal challenge[/b] concurrent with guild seasons:	[list]		[*]Players can earn points for participating in various PvP and Outlands PvE activities, which can be spent on additional rewards[/*]		[*]Points earned this way will improve their guild's season score as well, so players can contribute to their guild’s success while earning personal rewards[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][h3][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5eb1559a3fd90b58054b3782593cb374e206a4b7.jpeg[/img][/h3][h3]New Open-World Objective: Power Vortices[/h3][list]	[*][b]Power Vortices[/b] appear unpredictably in the Outlands and produce a power crystal[/*]	[*]Picking up a crystal makes the player its carrier and forces dismount[/*]	[*]Crystals can be carried to Territories or Hideouts to boost their level or crafting bonuses, respectively[/*]	[*]The carrier’s position will be [b]marked on the region map[/b][/*]	[*]Other players can pick up dropped crystals, creating “capture the flag” type gameplay in the Outlands[/*][/list]
That's all for today, but there’s much more coming, which we'll cover as development continues.

Thanks for watching!

notes.title: Call to Arms Patch 7 is Here
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/1957905f0fe184f22f277148f99ca4f81e0d61ea.jpeg[/img]

Call to Arms Patch 7, AKA the [b]Season 13 Patch[/b], is now live! This patch brings big changes and improvements to [b]competitive open-world gameplay[/b] in Albion. As Albion's next major content update will be focused on improving the overall [b]open-world experience[/b] (more about that soon!), we've decided to bring some of those changes to the game already, in anticipation of the start of [b]Guild Season 13[/b] this Saturday.
[h3]New Mobs: Crystal Spider and Treasure Drone[/h3]
The [b]Crystal Spider[/b] is a new rare boss that randomly spawns throughout the Outlands, intended for groups of 3-5 players. In addition to Fame, killing a Crystal Spider grants up to 30 [b]Season Points[/b]. [b]Treasure Drones[/b] are rare mobs that transport Avalonian Chests through the open world, and are defeatable by solo adventurers. They have similar rarity levels to dungeon chests, with higher-tier drones dropping increasingly valuable [b]Avalonian loot[/b].

Other mob changes include world boss spawn times being doubled to two hours, as well as [b]double Season Points[/b] for killing world bosses and [b]double Fame[/b] for all open-world faction mobs and Siphoning Mages.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/599e830da9e5ef1cb10fc01160d557357baa640a.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Resource and Transmutation Changes[/h3]
The spawn rate of enchanted resources has increased, with rare resources [b]doubled[/b] and exceptional resources [b]quadrupled[/b]. [b]Resource transmutation prices[/b] have overall been increased, as has the respawn rate of all [b]T5+ resources[/b] in the open world. At the same time, transmutation prices for Runes, Souls, and Relics have been [b]significantly reduced[/b] to make high-level Artifacts cheaper to craft and more accessible.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a5123f87baa91d724097dda131bf1a00a8c0458b.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Additional Changes[/h3][list]	[*][b]Castle layouts[/b] adjusted; [b]Castle Outpost chest loot[/b] doubled[/*]	[*][b]20v20 Crystal League schedule[/b] adjusted[/*]	[*][b]Disarray (Zerg debuff) curve adjusted[/b] to be much steeper[/*]	[*][b]Shield bubbles from instances[/b] shortened[/*]	[*]Corpses can no longer be looted while Hellgate [b]PvP [/b]is active[/*]	[*]Four new [b]Avatar Rings[/b] added to Vanity Merchant[/*]	[*][b]Combat Balance[/b] adjustments[/*]	[*]...and much more[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/28d13609f838b81e67931b362a2d067fa8106b2b.jpeg[/img]

You can check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/changelog/CALL%20TO%20ARMS%20PATCH%207][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url] for the complete list of changes, improvements, and fixes.
[h3]Season 13 Starts Saturday[/h3]
Albion's next Guild Season is almost upon us, with incredible rewards for ranking guilds including the [url=https://albiononline.com/news/season-13-rewards][b]Phalanx Beetle[/b][/url]. You can check out the full Season 13 schedule right [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/150011][b]here[/b][/url]. We'll see you soon ingame!

notes.title: Albion Online's Mobile Version is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/dcd0097aef7fb34ddbd4160f0ae1ee2d5054aea6.png[/img]

After years of anticipation, the day is finally here: [b]Albion Online is now available worldwide [/b]on the [b][url=https://play.albiononline.com/JK4M/17ac5413]Apple App Store[/url] [/b]and [url=https://play.albiononline.com/JK4M/b2c7a3b][b]Google Play Store[/b][/url]! This momentous occasion has been many years in the making – and to celebrate, we've released a brand-new live-action trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7MEvv81i3ek
Ready to jump in and play? Here's a rundown of all the important links:
[list]	[*]Albion Online on the [url=https://play.albiononline.com/JK4M/17ac5413][b]Apple App Store[/b][/url][/*]	[*]Albion Online on the [url=https://play.albiononline.com/JK4M/b2c7a3b][b]Google Play Store[/b][/url][/*]	[*][url=https://albiononline.com/download][b]System Requirements and download links[/b][/url] for all platforms[/*]	[*][url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/150321][b]Frequently Asked Questions[/b][/url] about the mobile version[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c8dbf5ad8455bf2bbe51b739c940791173322616.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Claim Your Chimera and 100,000 Fame[/h3]
To celebrate Albion's status as a fully cross-platform MMORPG, starting today you can log into the mobile and desktop version with the same account to unlock an exclusive cross-play reward: the [b]Chimera Riding Horse Skin[/b] and [b]100,000 Fame[/b]:
[list]	[*]This reward is available to [b]all players[/b], and does not require pre-registration, Premium, or any other special account status[/*]	[*]To receive the reward, log into the [b]mobile version[/b] and the [b]desktop version[/b] anytime after the official launch with a single account[/*]	[*]Rewards can be unlocked with any combination of mobile/desktop platforms (iOS + PC, Android + Linux, etc.)[/*]	[*]The [b]Chimera Riding Horse Skin[/b] will be automatically unlocked in the Appearance Menu for [b]all characters[/b] on the account, and can be used on any Riding Horse base mount[/*]	[*]The non-tradable [b]Tomes of Insight[/b] can be claimed by [b]one character[/b] on the account via the "Claim Rewards" tab[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/3932a271c4e893aa54e0f57ed97fbc741d2a6edf.jpeg[/img]
[h3]A Major Milestone[/h3]
The mobile launch is the last major step in fulfilling the game's original cross-play promise, and brings a new level of accessibility to the game for veteran and starting players alike. With a game as huge and dynamic as Albion Online, development of both the desktop and mobile versions will of course be an ongoing process.

For now, we're incredibly proud of what we've accomplished along with our community, our supporters, and all our past and present team members who made this incredible milestone – for both the game, and the genre as a whole – possible. A heartfelt [b]thank you[/b] from the entire Albion Online team!

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/f5a6e6b6d986ee3e61ed5ee7b305f792b2bd7bf4.jpeg[/img]

As always, we look forward to your feedback – once you've had a chance to try out the mobile version, swing by our [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/][b]forums[/b][/url] and let us know what you think.

We'll see you ingame soon!

notes.title: Patch 4 Brings Big Hellgate and Balance Changes
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/dffe36cf0c3bcb3687bfed2057eb626260504446.jpeg[/img]

Call to Arms Patch 4, AKA the [b]Call to Arms Balance Patch[/b], is here! First and foremost, this patch brings big changes and improvements to all types of [b]Hellgates[/b], including [b]massively increased rewards[/b], improved [b]matchmaking[/b], an automatic [b]cooldown reset[/b] when invaded, and streamlined [b]knockdown mechanics[/b].

Additionally, Patch 4 brings a huge array of [b]Combat Balance Changes[/b] across numerous weapon and armor lines, along with updates and improvements to [b]Faction Warfare[/b], the [b]20v20 Crystal League[/b], the [b]Black Zone Fame Buff[/b], and more.
[h3]Hellgates: Better Rewards and Matchmaking[/h3]
We've made numerous improvements to the overall experience in all sizes and types of Hellgates based on testing and community feedback. Here are some of the biggest changes:
[list]	[*][b]Significantly increased rewards[/b] across all Hellgate modes[/*]	[*]Chests now [b]always spawn[/b] once a Hellgate is complete, whether or not PvP occurred[/*]	[*][b]Cooldowns and Health [/b]now reset after an invasion[/*]	[*]Removed matchmaking delay in [b]chained Hellgates[/b][/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/2e3338400750ef56e57d10ffb880fa1a5418a75d.jpeg[/img][h3]Combat Balance Changes[/h3]
Michael Schwahn, Albion's Combat Designer, sums up the balance changes in this patch:

[i]"This patch aims to bring a wider variety of healing staffs into the meta while reducing the dominance of certain items in specific content, like Dagger Pairs in 2v2 Hellgates and Quarterstaffs in Corrupted Dungeons. Sustain damage provided by the axe line is also reduced, to bring them more in line with other melee weapons. This patch also offers reworks of abilities that have been out of the spotlight recently."[/i]

Here's a partial list of what's new:
[list]	[*][b]Axes:[/b] Updated numerous skills to increase importance of positioning and timing[/*]	[*][b]Cursed Staffs:[/b] Buffed various skills to improve performance in PvP[/*]	[*][b]Nature Staffs:[/b] Added a burst-heal W-slot ability[/*]	[*][b]Armors:[/b] Updated Life Steal Aura and Self-Ignition[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/c666be2ddf88b11e28f238ab6cdce2907b87aad1.jpeg[/img][h3]Other Changes[/h3][list]	[*][b]Improved load times[/b] between zones on all platforms[/*]	[*][b]Faction Warfare: Respawns[/b] now happen in batches to help rally forces; [b]Bandit Assault[/b] is more frequent and unpredictable[/*]	[*][b]20v20 Crystal League: [/b]Increased [b]artifact rewards[/b] in final chests[/*]	[*][b]Black Zone Fame Buff [/b]persists when [b]moving between zones[/b][/*]	[*][b]Mobile Version:[/b] Further optimizations and UI improvements[/*]	[*]… and much more[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/947cb7027ae6bc9a3ae0cab562dbb17383ad40a5.jpeg[/img]

Finally, for this patch, we're also trying something new: offering [b]detailed explanations of combat balance changes[/b] under each weapon and armor type, to show the reasons and goals behind them. As always, you can check out the full list of changes, including these detailed balance change descriptions, in the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/changelog/CALL%20TO%20ARMS%20PATCH%204][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Population Update: Spring 2021
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/4f4cb9437947e63fdc4eab6d5f585829a406bf14.jpeg[/img]

2020 saw Albion's population grow bigger than ever before, with Daily Average User counts increasing consistently throughout the year. Starting with the Queen Update in January and growing further during the worldwide lockdowns that followed, the population hit a new milestone nearly every month. The massive [url=https://albiononline.com/en/update/rise-of-avalon][b]Rise of Avalon[/b] [b]update[/b][/url] followed in August, bringing a host of new features and two new languages to the game, and by September the Daily Average User count surpassed[b] [url=https://albiononline.com/en/news/population-update-september-2020]125,000 players[/url][/b].

This trend continued into 2021, reaching a new peak of [b]135,000 players[/b] in February. Then, on March 17, the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/update/call-to-arms][b]Call to Arms[/b][/url] update went live, bringing a ground-up rework of [b]Faction Warfare[/b], completely revamped [b]Hellgates[/b], [b]Loadouts[/b], and much more. The combined influx of new and returning players with this launch pushed Albion's daily average population to over [b]140,000[/b], and also saw some of the game's highest-ever numbers on Twitch and Youtube.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9b8153d392cfdcd06d0850b6a780411dbd673461.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Looking Forward to 2021[/h3]
So what's next for the world of Albion? First off, we're hard at work on the [b]mobile version[/b], and are putting the final pieces in place for the [b]official Apple and Google store launches[/b]. We'll have some exciting updates soon on the mobile version, so stay tuned. And of course, we're already looking forward to the next big steps for the game, including our next major content update later this year, which will focus on improving and deepening Albion's open world.

To veteran and returning players, thanks for being part of the world of Albion and making it what it is today. And to new players, we would like to extend a warm welcome to the Albion community – be sure to visit our [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/][b]forum[/b][/url] with any questions, and keep an eye out for [b]new player video guides[/b] coming soon!

notes.title: Call to Arms Patch 1 is Here
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bad5c3bb49ca5f0cfb38be8ba38b17eb0587b1c5.jpeg[/img]

The first patch of the [b]Call to Arms[/b] update is now live! This patch brings optimizations and adjustments to the update's two primary features, [b]Faction Warfare[/b] and [b]Hellgates[/b], along with other changes and fixes and a brand-new [b]Premiere Mount Skin[/b]. Read on for all the details...
[h3]New Riding Horse Skin: Hell Mare[/h3]
The new [b]Hell Mare[/b] Mount Skin turns any Riding Horse base mount into a dark and demonic infernal beast. This skin is available in the ingame store, and once purchased can be applied to all characters on your account forever. Pick one up today and blaze a fiery path across Albion!
[h3]Guild Season Winner Statue Added[/h3]
Congratulations to [b]Black 0rder[/b] on their second consecutive season win! You can check out their statue at the entrance to Conquerors' Hall.
[h3][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/89af6ee16de84f069c0ca7d808eece6291dc161e.jpeg[/img][/h3][h3]Faction Warfare Changes[/h3]
The launch of Call to Arms saw a massive influx of players participating in [b]Faction Warfare[/b], which exceeded even our high-end expectations. As the system is based on a set number of points for players to fight over, we've [b]significantly increased the overall points available[/b] to give individual players a better return on their efforts. We've also greatly reduced the [b]point requirements[/b] for daily Faction Campaign bonuses, and we'll be reducing the overall campaign milestone requirements as well starting next month.

We're thrilled at the overwhelming response to the Faction Warfare rework, and we'll continue to keep an eye on this feature to make sure it remains fun, challenging, and rewarding for all players.
[h3]Crystal League Updates: Artifacts and No-Show Points[/h3]
Level 2 and higher 20v20 Crystal League rewards now always include [b]artifacts[/b], with a rare chance of being extremely valuable [b]Avalonian artifacts[/b]. Additionally, if no matchup is found, both 5v5 and 20v20 teams will now receive [b]80% of the available Season Points[/b] (previously 60%).

For a complete list of changes, check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/changelog/CALL%20TO%20ARMS%20PATCH%201][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: The Call to Arms Update is Here
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/2eff2b1ebe3c9c9694d2b1c0c493a00a866fabc2.jpg[/img]

The [b]Call to Arms[/b] update is now live! To mark the occasion, we've created a brand-new trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/embed/54OBbmUfBP4
Albion's tenth major content update brings a host of new features:
[h3]Faction Warfare Re-Envisioned[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/a1b30e2fbf71d9fd763634deabcacb35316b09f7.jpeg[/img]

[b]Faction Warfare[/b] has been reworked to offer a much more in-depth experience, rewarding loyalty and perseverance while still allowing freedom of choice. Claim Outposts and whole zones, repel Bandit Assaults, ride into battle on six new Elite Faction Mounts, participate in Faction Campaigns, and rise through the ranks to become a legend of your city. Or throw in your lot with the bandit clans of Caerleon, where the opportunities for wealth are unlimited... as long as you keep one eye on your back.

[h3]Hellgates 2.0[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bfc70070c1c0d8a841d8d0a2549524921765fbcb.jpeg[/img]

The next phase of [b]Hellgate [/b]gameplay is here, with a new map-based entry system, ten all-new layouts, and new demonic foes for exciting and varied PvE. PvP takes on new dimensions as well, with the ability to [b]chain Hellgates[/b] and a new [b]rising lava[/b] mechanic. And new [b]10v10 Hellgates[/b] offer thrilling, high-stakes midsize PvP for new and veteran players alike.

[h3]Loadouts, Tooltips, and More[/h3]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d242556e6d68a92fb0b8d6a975653c8571f4cf5c.jpeg[/img]

Call to Arms brings major quality-of-life improvements like [b]Loadouts[/b], updated [b]ability tooltips[/b], and [b]animated vegetation[/b] alongside numerous additional improvements, fixes, balance changes, and optimizations.

For the full list of features, improvements and changes, see the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/changelog/CALL%20TO%20ARMS%20UPDATE][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url] or check out the [b][url=https://albiononline.com/en/update/call-to-arms]update page[/url][/b]!

notes.title: The Season 12 Patch is Here
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/657cfe6697cfbc182f378490b2ddf239751efbc4.jpeg[/img]

Guild Season 12 kicks off on [b]Saturday, March 13[/b]. In anticipation of this, [b]Rise of Avalon Patch 15[/b], AKA the [b]Season 12 Patch[/b], brings changes to make ownership of territories more significant and create incentives for more Outlands activities outside of large-scale battles. It also brings improvements to the new 20v20 Crystal League alongside other improvements and fixes.

Here's a rundown of what's new:
[h3]Season Point Changes[/h3][list]	[*][b]Territory Season Points[/b] are still given [b]daily[/b] for owned Outlands territories, and have been [b]increased[/b] overall, with the point difference between the outer and inner parts of the Outlands somewhat flattened[/*]	[*][b]Castle Season Points[/b] are still given [b]every six hours[/b] for owned castles and have been [b]increased[/b] overall[/*]	[*][b]Castle Outpost Season Points[/b] are now given [b]every three hours[/b] for owned Outposts and have likewise been [b]increased[/b] overall[/*][/list][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9c4a363d95435364b9af2c12b18aa6e22588168c.png[/img]
[h3]World Boss and Static Dungeon Changes[/h3]
The PvE Fame buff in these locations now comes primarily from [b]Elite mobs[/b] instead of the bosses themselves, and stacks incrementally with each mob killed. By repeatedly defeating mobs in the area, players in a party can stack the buff up to [b]+50% bonus Fame[/b] while remaining in the zone.
[h3]Other Changes[/h3][list]	[*][b]20v20 Crystal League Changes:[/b] Starting Points per team and point value per player kill increased, new level added between the former Levels 1 and 2 – there are now 7 total levels[/*]	[*][b]Treasure Chest Changes:[/b] Overall loot value of Castle Chests increased, and Lesser Outland Treasure Chests now spawn more often[/*]	[*][b]Guild Challenge Change:[/b] Reduced Season Points for lower Guild Challenge levels put more emphasis on open-world objectives like territories[/*]	[*][b]Bracket Season Point Thresholds Updated:[/b] The points required for each bracket (Crystal, Gold, etc.) have been updated in tandem with these changes[/*]	[*][b]Fixes:[/b] Corrected map tooltips for Outlands treasures and fixed some cases where Hideouts could not be set as Home[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/362707882da027970bd1ce1398291dc467c5f50c.jpeg[/img]

For the full list of fixes, changes, and improvements, check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/changelog/RISE%20OF%20AVALON%20PATCH%2015][b]official Patchnotes[/b][/url].

For the Season 12 Schedule, [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/144466-Guild-Season-12-Schedule/][b]click here[/b][/url].

notes.title: Patch 13 is Here
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/dae55ab0fe0b3255e68e5de9b8ca7cf9534669ab.jpeg[/img]

Patch 13, AKA the [b]Rise of Avalon Balance Patch[/b], is now live! This patch brings numerous changes to Avalonian mobs, big meta changes to combat balancing, a long-awaited quality of life improvement, and more. Here's what's new:
[h3]Updated Avalonian Mobs[/h3]
Patch 13 improves the overall experience of [b]Elite Dungeons[/b], offering a more streamlined combat experience while fighting Avalonians while retaining the challenge of these high-level enemies. Most high-damage Avalonian spells can no longer be reflected, the Construct's "blind spot" has been removed, and the skills of the [b]High Priestess[/b], [b]Crystal Basilisk[/b], and [b]Sir Bedivere[/b] have been updated to keep you on your toes.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/911dc1ec75af35c531494c2ad247bc73d29b11d3.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Keeping the Meta Fresh[/h3]
This patch contains numerous changes to combat abilities across a wide range of weapons, armor, and equipment, with the primary goal of addressing the meta in[b] small-scale PvP[/b] and [b]Corrupted Dungeons[/b]. A new Mace ability, [b]Guard Rune[/b], has been added, the Guardian Helmet's Emergency Heal has been reworked as [b]Emergency Shield[/b], and several [b]Battle Mounts[/b] have reduced cooldowns to keep them competitive in open-world combat.
[h3]Rejoice: The Use-All Button is Here[/h3]
Free yourself from the tyranny of endless clicking, and use all your Silver Bags and Tomes with [b]a single button click[/b]. Patch 13 introduces the [b]Use All Button[/b], perhaps Albion's most-requested feature of all time. If you missed the teaser trailer, you can watch it in all its glory here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S5h8XjI9O0c
[h3]Additional Changes[/h3][list]	[*][b]Political View[/b] is once again available on the World Map[/*]	[*]Updates to setting a [b]Hideout [/b]as Home - details [url=https://forum.albiononline.com/index.php/Thread/143364][b]here[/b][/url][/*]	[*]Fixes to the [b]Estimated Market Value[/b] display[/*]	[*]Improvements and optimizations to the [b]mobile version[/b][/*]	[*]...and much more[/*][/list]

notes.title: Dev Talk: Year-End Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/8808deb994af79fa655a1e7d65c89a6d71ba6f71.jpg[/img]

2020 was Albion's biggest year yet, with numerous patches and updates, a host of major new features, and an ever-growing player population. In the final Dev Talk of the year, Game Director Robin Henkys looks back at the past year in the world of Albion before looking ahead to what's coming in 2021.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LxosGPJl3f4&feature=emb_logo
To take the year-end survey mentioned in the video, [url=https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/runner/AlbionOnlineRoadmap2021Survey][b]click here[/b][/url].

No time to watch the video, or prefer a written summary? Then read on...
[h3]2020: Albion's Biggest Year Yet[/h3]
The past year brought some major changes, improvements, and new features to the world of Albion:
[list]	[*]Complete Outlands overhaul[/*]	[*]Introduction of Hideouts[/*]	[*]Open-World Territory Battles[/*]	[*]Avalonians and Elite dungeons[/*]	[*]Crystal League[/*]	[*]Avalonian Weapons and Armor[/*]	[*]Roads of Avalon[/*]	[*]Wardrobe Skins[/*]	[*]Corrupted Dungeons[/*]	[*]Outlands Banks[/*]	[*]Updated UIs[/*]	[*]2 new languages[/*]	[*]Combat Balance Improvements[/*]	[*]Mobile improvements: New mobile HUD and control scheme, auto-updating, beta of the Google Play Store version[/*]	[*]20v20 Crystal League battles and other Season 11 adjustments[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/83b4d8b415a591fd50b7f8a7d9ca11d3420efcfd.jpeg[/img]

In total we released 29 updates and patches with the majority happening out of our homes. Albion now consistently has over 500,000 active players every month, and player numbers are still growing.
[h3]Looking Forward to 2021[/h3]
Major changes coming in the next year include:
[list]	[*]A complete [b]Faction Warfare[/b] rework to bring open-world warfare to every player[/*]	[*]Improving [b]Hellgates [/b]to make fair, smaller-scale PvP widely accessible and rewarding[/*]	[*][b]Loadouts[/b], which allow you to save, share and quick-equip item sets on your character[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d559527583eda16bafbefe4c38b43c0157279951.jpeg[/img]

Improvements to the [b]open world[/b] and [b]world design[/b] of Albion:
[list]	[*]Reworking the fundamental building blocks of the world[/*]	[*]Improving visual quality while reducing dead ends and nonsensical layouts[/*]	[*]Improving open-world locations like large static dungeons, making them high-value hotspots[/*]	[*]Making treasures appear less predictably to trigger smaller-scale fights as intended[/*]	[*]Improving the world map with more information about ongoing activities[/*][/list]
[b]Quality-of-Life [/b]Improvements:
[list]	[*]Loadouts for quick-equipping items[/*]	[*]Additional functionality to quick-buy Loadouts from Marketplaces[/*]	[*]Adding better information about actual costs to crafting UIs[/*]	[*]Tackling long-standing convenience issues like a “Use All” functionality for Tomes and Silver bags[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/63388b2d0406fe8ce20b6ac4460051ce4a35ad50.jpeg[/img]

[b]Combat [/b]improvements:
[list]	[*]Giving each type of mount, even non-rare mounts, their own spells and abilities[/*]	[*]Further expansion of equipment choices available to players[/*][/list]
[b]Mobile [/b]version:
[list]	[*]2021 will be the year Albion Online officially releases for phones and tablets[/*]	[*]Will launch on both iOS and the Google Play Store[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/d0bf470efa02870fbe4a827e37c173c3636bdf66.jpeg[/img]

Additional goals:
[list]	[*]Long-needed Castle improvements[/*]	[*]Siege equipment and defensive structures[/*]	[*]Roaming mob improvements[/*]	[*]Additional content and exploration goals for the Roads of Avalon[/*][/list]
Game systems:
[list]	[*]Expansion of options and visual improvements for Destiny Board[/*]	[*]Trade contracts allowing players to offer Silver for item delivery[/*]	[*]Revisiting the role of laborers and offering additional features and variety on player islands[/*]	[*]Legendary item crafting to leave a permanent mark in the world of Albion[/*]	[*]New mounts and equipment (gathering mounts, potential new resource tier)[/*][/list]
Goals for PvE, guild leaders, and data enthusiasts:
[list]	[*]More lore and quests[/*]	[*]Special collectible rewards for completing quests[/*]	[*]Increased capabilities for guild management[/*]	[*]Improved Web API[/*][/list]
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/817348698287c66736db119ef15733a27550e389.jpeg[/img]

For guilds in general, we want to expand on Hideouts with additional open-world buildings guilds could use to protect territories, collect resources or provide combat support in the open world. And for beginning players, we want to introduce a mentoring program called the Albion Academy.
[h3]We Need You![/h3]
As usual at the end of the year, we’re looking for your opinions about Albion Online. What are we doing well? What do we need to improve? And what features would you like to see? You can tell us in our [b]end-of-year survey[/b] which we’ll be sending to active players who have opted-in to receive the newsletter in the coming weeks, or fill out our Roadmap Survey [url=https://ec.europa.eu/eusurvey/runner/AlbionOnlineRoadmap2021Survey][b]here[/b][/url].

Your feedback will help us decide which features to prioritize as we continue our journey to make Albion Online the best Sandbox MMORPG in the world.

Thank you for your continued support, and we'll see you in 2021!

notes.title: Rise of Avalon Patch 10 is Here
notes.notes:
[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/947cb7027ae6bc9a3ae0cab562dbb17383ad40a5.jpeg[/img]

Rise of Avalon Patch 10, AKA the [b]Season 11 Patch[/b], is now live. This patch brings major changes and improvements to guild warfare in Albion, starting with the Season 11 kickoff on [b]Saturday, December 5[/b].

Here's an overview of what's new:
[h3]20v20 Crystal League Battles[/h3]
[b]20v20 Crystal League battles[/b] allow players of all levels to participate in thrilling 20v20 battles. Level 1 battles are knockdown only, providing the perfect training ground for newer players, while higher-level fights are full loot, with correspondingly higher rewards. The 20v20 league has 6 levels, with the final Level 6 match taking place at the end of the season.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/bd6c5c344ed9ea485189f2d4aaa67f19b1b26391.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Crystal League Point Adjustments[/h3]
Season Points for midlevel Crystal League matches have been rebalanced, and there is now a [b]daily limit for Season Points earned from the Crystal League[/b]. This limit makes it less desirable to accumulate elite Crystal League teams in one guild and instead creates an incentive for top teams to spread across various guilds.
[h3]Smart Cluster Queue Changes[/h3]
When a cluster is overcrowded and the Smart Cluster Queue activates, players can now either [b]join the queue[/b] or [b]skip the overcrowded cluster entirely[/b]. Additionally, the distance players can move from the entrance before being kicked from the queue has been greatly increased.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/ea19b7ec31fb01f6f29d799212929e008ec74b2a.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Castle Scoring and Minimum Distance Changes[/h3]
Castle scoring now starts at 00:00 UTC regardless of a zone's prime time, and Castles and Castle Outposts give points every 6 and 3 hours respectively. Additionally, Castles are now at least 4 zones apart, making it harder for larger guilds to defend numerous objectives simultaneously.
[h3]World Boss and Raid Zone Changes[/h3]
Fame for all Elite mobs in World Boss Raid Zones, including World Bosses themselves, has been massively increased. World Bosses now spawn once per hour instead of once per day, and killing them gives a 20% Fame buff within the same cluster. Elite mobs in these zones also respawn much faster, and their distribution within the zones has been updated.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/45cccb9763319dac86816dfde10efeb56e8ebe88.jpeg[/img]
[h3]Combat Balance Changes and More[/h3][list]	[*]Axes get a new Q-slot ability, Rending Rage, to improve mobility and crowd control[/*]	[*]Various buffs for Axes, Spears, and Arcane Staffs[/*]	[*]Cooldown reductions for Royal Robe and Royal Armor[/*]	[*]Timers for point scoring and treasures in Castles and Castle Outposts now display as both countdowns and fixed UTC time[/*]	[*]Numerous bug fixes[/*][/list]
For the full list of changes, check out the [url=https://albiononline.com/en/changelog/RISE%20OF%20AVALON%20PATCH%2010][b]official patchnotes[/b][/url].

notes.title: Dev Talk: Season 11 Changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/fd5ada97ea2fc81763481c336f87edc35e9cd468.jpg[/img]

Albion Online's 11th Guild Season starts on [b]Saturday, December 5[/b]. This season will bring major new features along with changes to existing systems. In our newest Dev Talk, Combat Designer Michael Schwahn discusses these changes and how they will affect guild warfare in Albion.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Do-WTEBSQw
No time to watch or prefer a written summary? Then read on...
[h3]20v20 Crystal League[/h3]
This Season introduces the [b]20v20 Crystal League,[/b] allowing all players to join fair and exciting 20v20 battles.
[list]	[*]Tokens can be bought at the Energy Manipulator and used for one of [b]3 slots each day[/b][/*]	[*]Match rules are similar to the 5v5 League, where both teams need to control and hold more orbs than the enemy[/*]	[*]20v20 matches will use an [b]entirely new map[/b] with a layout similar to the old city fight map[/*]	[*][b]As in the 5v5 League, Level 1 matches are knockdown only [/b]and offer perfect training for newcomers[/*]	[*][b]High-stakes, full-loot[/b] matches are also available, increasing toward the end of the season[/*][/list][h3]Crystal League Point Limit[/h3]
To make sure the Crystal League doesn't dominate the entire season at the expense of other activities, we're rebalancing its [b]Season Point rewards[/b] and introducing a [b]daily limit[/b] for Season Points gained via Crystal League. The limits are separate for 5v5 and 20v20 matches, and vary based on the amount of points available on a given day. This keeps high-level matches rewarding while ensuring seasons can’t be won solely via elite Crystal League squads.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/9c4a363d95435364b9af2c12b18aa6e22588168c.png[/img]
[h3]World Boss Raid Zones[/h3]
To add high-value open world objectives, we have overhauled World Boss Raid Zones:
[list]	[*]World Bosses now spawn [b]every hour[/b][/*]	[*]Defeating a World Boss gives every team member a [b]PvE Fame buff[/b] while remaining in the zone, as an additional incentive for groups to stand their ground when they meet an enemy group[/*]	[*]To further make these areas into Fame Farming hotspots, their [b]Elite mobs[/b] are now much stronger, but also way more rewarding, and they respawn much faster[/*]	[*]These spots are limited, which should lead to more [b]small and midsized open-world fights[/b][/*][/list][h3][b][img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/5459ecec3f2143cc95fa2e2c75645618a08f01e2.png[/img][/b]Castles[/h3]
With Season 11, Castle and Castle Outpost timers will be the same for all clusters in the game. This means treasure spawning and scoring now occur independently of the cluster prime time.
[list]	[*]Castles score [b]every 6 hours[/b][/*]	[*]Castle Outposts score [b]every 3 hours[/b][/*]	[*][b]Castle Chests[/b] appear on Saturdays at 12:00 and 18:00 UTC and Sundays at 00:00 UTC[/*]	[*][b]Castle Outpost Chests[/b] appear [b]every 6 hours[/b][/*][/list]
We've also increased distances between Castles by removing tunnels and cluster connections to ensure they are always at least four zones apart.

These changes will put pressure on bigger power blocks to split their forces if they want to contest more than one objective. This will hopefully lead to fewer overcrowded cluster battles.
[h3]Skip Overcrowded Clusters[/h3]
The Cluster Queue was originally designed as a tool to handle edge cases with too many players, but queued battles have become more and more frequent and many battles now revolve around this system. This is especially frustrating for players who might not get a chance to participate in the fight at all.

To improve this, players can now [b]skip overcrowded clusters[/b]. You can now select any connected entrance to jump to, and find new battles instead of waiting outside as a potential backup. This essentially allows two battles at once: one in the overcrowded cluster, and another between queued players.

The queue entrance range will also increase, letting players travel further without leaving the queue. And if two clusters in a row are overcrowded, you can skip through both.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/db818bb7e71d2dd660f10c5e919b912ef07c63e5.png[/img]
[h3]Combat Balancing[/h3]
Finally, for Season 11 we will also roll out a [b]combat balance update[/b]. This includes the new Axe ability [b]Rending Rage[/b], a combo where you swing your blade and then leap forward and root the enemy. This gives Axes a Q-slot option for mobility and crowd control. This patch also contains buffs for Axes, Spears and Arcane Staffs along with various adjustments to other abilities.

There are quite a lot of changes in Season 11, and we are excited to see how players interact with them. Hopefully we'll see some fierce competition for the top spots this season.

Thanks for watching!

notes.title: Dev Talk: Development Update, November 2020
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32445805/6b31a5976a0a03456f2a023e89d5926f5e88b709.jpg[/img]

[url=https://albiononline.com/en/news/brimstone-and-mist-is-here][b]Brimstone and Mist[/b][/url] launched on October 21, bringing significant improvements to Corrupted Dungeons, the Roads of Avalon, and large-scale combat. In our newest Dev Talk, Game Director Robin Henkys discusses major improvements coming to [b]Faction Warfare[/b] and [b]Hellgates [/b]with the next content update.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LOiprC3H1Cc
No time to watch the video, or prefer a written summary? Then read on...
[h3]1. Faction Warfare[/h3]
We’ve long wanted to expand [b]Faction Warfare[/b] into a major activity for players of all levels. We want players without large guilds to experience the excitement of massive battles, while also allowing maintaining Faction Warfare as a valuable and rewarding activity for experienced players.

To achieve this, we’re changing the following:
[list]	[*][b]Faction Conquest:[/b] In addition to Outposts, factions will be able to conquer [b]entire zones[/b]. To provoke large-scale battles, Factions will only be able to attack Outposts and zones that border another Faction.[/*]	[*][b]Faction Points:[/b] Points will be awarded not only for taking Outposts and zones, but also for [b]killing enemy defenders[/b]. Loyalty to a faction will become more important via [b]Faction ranks[/b] and weekly/monthly [b]Faction Campaigns[/b] with valuable rewards.[/*]	[*][b]Core System Changes:[/b] To encourage beginning and mid-level players to participate, Faction Warfare in blue/yellow zones will be [b]non-lethal[/b], instead allowing knocked-out players to rejoin the fight from their nearest Outpost. At the same time, the [b]red zones[/b] will contain the highest-value Faction Warfare areas, and will offer a unique [b]red zone battle event[/b] to encourage high-value, full-loot Faction Warfare.[/*][/list]
With these changes, we think Faction Warfare will become the perfect way for new Albion players to get their first experience of large-scale warfare, while offering a deep and interesting activity for veteran players who don’t have an Outlands guild or want to enjoy large-scale warfare even when their guild is not currently fighting.

[img]//assets.albiononline.com/uploads/media/default/media/b5b473dd1c222367bf61256a809554dbbd9b6b86.jpeg[/img]
[h3]2. Hellgates[/h3]
[b]Hellgates[/b] are an integral feature of Albion Online, letting players participate in high-stakes PvP in a challenging but balanced battleground. Hellgates were developed during the Alpha phase of Albion Online, and it's finally time to give them the attention they deserve.
Goals of the new Hellgates:
[list]	[*][b]Make them more accessible[/b] by adding [b]Hellgate maps[/b], which lead to a Hellgate in the open world (similar to Dungeon Maps) whenever your group is ready.[/*]	[*][b]Make them more rewarding[/b] by adding a [b]ranking system[/b] and an [b]Infamy-like[/b] system that boost your rewards as your ranking increases.[/*]	[*][b]Make them more competitive[/b] by reworking the matchmaking system, ensuring you get matched with challenging opponents and don't receive rewards without fighting. We’re also adding all-new [b]10v10 Hellgates[/b].[/*]	[*][b]Make them more polished[/b] via a complete rework of their [b]visuals[/b] and their [b]PvE experience[/b]. The new Hellgates will offer varied PvE challenges and rewards while waiting for an enemy team, as well as a variety of different Hellgate layouts.[/*][/list]
I hope you’re as excited about these major improvements to Faction Warfare and Hellgates as we are – we’ll share more details as development continues.

In the meantime, you can look forward to our upcoming [b]Play Store beta[/b] as well as major changes for [b]Season 11[/b] (including updates to [b]Season Point scoring[/b] and the [b]Outlands map[/b]) which we’ll cover in an upcoming Dev Talk.

Thanks for watching!
